哦.zh: 哦？你是说明天的会议改到下午了吗？
哦.en: Oh? You mean tomorrow's meeting has been moved to the afternoon?

头.zh: 这张桌子是用木头做的，摸起来很结实。
头.en: This table is made of wood and feels very solid.

如.zh: 这里的风景美丽如画，每年都吸引很多游客。
如.en: The scenery here is as beautiful as a painting and attracts many tourists every year.

同.zh: 这件事我同你说过好几次了，你怎么还忘了？
同.en: I've told you about this several times; how could you still forget?

如此.zh: 他每天都练习到深夜，正因为如此，他才取得了今天的成绩。
如此.en: He practises late into the night every day; it's precisely because of this that he has achieved what he has today.

处.zh: 山上有一处温泉，冬天去泡最舒服了。
处.en: There's a hot spring up on the mountain; soaking in it in winter is the best.

其.zh: 这本书很受欢迎，其作者是一位年轻的大学老师。
其.en: This book is very popular; its author is a young university teacher.

曾.zh: 这位老人年轻时曾当过兵，至今还保持着早起的习惯。
曾.en: This old man once served in the army when he was young and still keeps the habit of getting up early.

面.zh: 这张纸正反两面都写满了字，一点空白都没有。
面.en: Both sides of this sheet of paper are covered in writing, with no blank space at all.

靠@6.zh: 坐飞机的时候，我习惯选靠窗的座位。
靠@6.en: When I fly, I usually choose a window seat.

现场.zh: 记者第一时间赶到事故现场进行报道。
现场.en: The reporter rushed to the scene of the accident right away to cover it.

超.zh: 你的行李超重了五公斤，需要另外付费。
超.en: Your luggage is five kilos overweight, so you need to pay an extra fee.

及.zh: 请把你的姓名、电话及地址写在这张表上。
及.en: Please write your name, phone number and address on this form.

拥有.zh: 这位年轻的科学家已经拥有二十多项发明专利。
拥有.en: This young scientist already holds more than twenty invention patents.

伤.zh: 医生说他的伤不严重，休息一周就能好。
伤.en: The doctor said his injury isn't serious and will heal after a week of rest.

眼.zh: 村子中间有一眼老井，至今还有清水。
眼.en: In the middle of the village there is an old well that still has clear water.

令.zh: 警方已下令关闭这条道路，直到事故处理完毕。
令.en: The police have ordered the road closed until the accident has been dealt with.

抓@6.zh: 小猫跳起来想抓那只蝴蝶。
抓@6.en: The kitten jumped up trying to catch the butterfly.

力.zh: 学外语需要很强的记忆力和耐心。
力.en: Learning a foreign language requires a strong memory and patience.

数@6.zh: 全班同学里，数他跑得最快。
数@6.en: Of all the students in the class, he runs the fastest.

交易.zh: 这两家公司达成了一笔价值十亿元的交易。
交易.en: The two companies struck a deal worth one billion yuan.

随.zh: 游客们随导游走进了古老的寺庙。
随.en: The tourists followed the guide into the ancient temple.

度.zh: 这位导演曾两度获得最佳导演奖。
度.en: This director has twice won the Best Director award.

单.zh: 这次吃饭我来买单，你们谁都别跟我抢。
单.en: I'm paying the bill for this meal; don't anyone try to beat me to it.

至.zh: 这条高速公路从广州至深圳全长约一百公里。
至.en: This expressway runs from Guangzhou to Shenzhen, about 100 kilometres in total.

人民.zh: 他一生都在为国家和人民服务，深受大家尊敬。
人民.en: He spent his whole life serving his country and the people, and is deeply respected.

事件.zh: 这起网络安全事件导致上万用户的信息被泄露。
事件.en: This cybersecurity incident led to the information of tens of thousands of users being leaked.

据.zh: 据统计，今年来这里旅游的人比去年多了一倍。
据.en: According to statistics, the number of visitors here this year is double last year's.

选手.zh: 这名年轻选手第一次参加奥运会就拿到了金牌。
选手.en: This young athlete won a gold medal at his very first Olympics.

亲.zh: 她是我的亲姐姐，我们从小一起长大。
亲.en: She's my own (biological) older sister; we grew up together.

投.zh: 很多人往许愿池里投硬币，希望愿望成真。
投.en: Many people throw coins into the wishing pool, hoping their wishes will come true.

客户.zh: 这家银行为重要客户提供一对一的服务。
客户.en: This bank provides one-on-one service for its important clients.

称@6.zh: 她每天早上都要称一下体重。

原.zh: 他从原单位辞职后，开了一家自己的公司。
原.en: After resigning from his former employer, he started his own company.

集.zh: 昨天晚上那一集特别精彩，你看了吗？
集.en: Last night's episode was especially great. Did you watch it?

权.zh: 这件事我无权做主，你还是去问问经理吧。
权.en: I have no authority to decide this; you'd better ask the manager.

或许@6.zh: 你别着急，或许他只是路上堵车了。
或许@6.en: Don't worry; perhaps he's just stuck in traffic.

媒体@6.zh: 这位歌手很少接受媒体的采访。
媒体@6.en: This singer rarely gives interviews to the media.

意识.zh: 病人已经恢复了意识，可以和家人说话了。
意识.en: The patient has regained consciousness and can talk with his family.

追@6.zh: 他追了她两年，她终于答应做他女朋友了。
追@6.en: He pursued her for two years, and she finally agreed to be his girlfriend.

机构.zh: 这份调查报告是由一家独立的第三方机构完成的。
机构.en: This survey report was produced by an independent third-party organisation.

反.zh: 吃了药以后，他的病不但没好，反而更重了。
反.en: After taking the medicine, his illness didn't get better; on the contrary, it got worse.

传.zh: 请把这些试卷传给后面的同学。
传.en: Please pass these test papers back to the classmates behind you.

伤害@6.zh: 说话前要多想想，别伤害别人的感情。
伤害@6.en: Think before you speak, and don't hurt other people's feelings.

副.zh: 他被提升为公司的副总经理，负责销售部门。
副.en: He was promoted to deputy general manager of the company, in charge of the sales department.

事业.zh: 他年轻时就开始创业，现在事业非常成功。
事业.en: He started his own business when he was young, and now his career is very successful.

怪.zh: 这个人真怪，大热天还穿着厚外套。
怪.en: This guy is really strange, wearing a thick coat on such a hot day.

分享.zh: 我想跟大家分享一个好消息：我们的项目成功了！
分享.en: I'd like to share some good news with everyone: our project succeeded!

架.zh: 他把看完的书都整齐地放回了书架上。
架.en: He put all the books he had finished neatly back on the bookshelf.

成员.zh: 这个乐队的每一位成员都会弹好几种乐器。
成员.en: Every member of this band can play several instruments.

测试.zh: 老师下周要测试一下大家的听力水平。
测试.en: Next week the teacher is going to test everyone's listening level.

级.zh: 这座塔一共有三百多级台阶，爬上去要半个小时。
级.en: This tower has more than three hundred steps; it takes half an hour to climb up.

代.zh: 请代我向你父母问好，祝他们身体健康。
代.en: Please say hello to your parents for me and wish them good health.

网络@6.zh: 现在通过网络就可以买到各种各样的东西。
网络@6.en: Nowadays you can buy all kinds of things over the internet.

式.zh: 这家餐厅提供正宗的西式牛排。
式.en: This restaurant serves authentic Western-style steak.

调.zh: 电视声音太大了，把音量调小一点吧。
调.en: The TV is too loud; turn the volume down a bit.

队伍.zh: 长长的迎亲队伍敲锣打鼓地走进了村子。
队伍.en: A long wedding procession came into the village to the sound of drums and gongs.

命.zh: 他总说自己命不好，其实是不够努力。
命.en: He always says he was born unlucky, but really he just doesn't work hard enough.

烧.zh: 他不小心把饭烧焦了，厨房里全是糊味。
烧.en: He accidentally burned the rice, and the whole kitchen smelled scorched.

事故.zh: 工厂加强了安全管理，今年没有发生一起事故。
事故.en: The factory tightened its safety management and has not had a single accident this year.

安.zh: 考试结果还没出来，他心里一直很不安。
安.en: The exam results aren't out yet, and he has been feeling uneasy.

藏.zh: 他把钱藏在一本旧书里，结果自己也忘了。
藏.en: He hid the money in an old book and then forgot about it himself.

协议.zh: 他在租房前仔细阅读了租房协议的每一条内容。
协议.en: Before renting, he carefully read every clause of the rental agreement.

配.zh: 他觉得自己配不上她，一直不敢表白。
配.en: He feels he isn't good enough for her, so he has never dared to confess his feelings.

老婆@6.zh: 他老婆做的红烧肉特别好吃。
老婆@6.en: The braised pork his wife makes is especially delicious.

占@6.zh: 女生占了我们班人数的一半以上。
占@6.en: Girls make up more than half of our class.

超级@6.zh: 这个包超级轻，带着出门很方便。
超级@6.en: This bag is super light, so it's very convenient to take out.

意味着.zh: 红灯亮起意味着所有车辆必须停下来。
意味着.en: A red light coming on means all vehicles must stop.

保.zh: 为了保住这份工作，他每天都加班到很晚。
保.en: To keep this job, he works overtime until late every day.

抽.zh: 这里是公共场所，请不要抽烟。
抽.en: This is a public place; please don't smoke.

需.zh: 办理护照需带上身份证和照片。
需.en: To apply for a passport you need to bring your ID card and photos.

合.zh: 收到录取通知书，他笑得合不拢嘴。
合.en: When he received the acceptance letter, he couldn't stop grinning.

投入@6.zh: 她演奏钢琴时非常投入，完全忘了周围的人。
投入@6.en: When she plays the piano she is completely absorbed and forgets everyone around her.

胜.zh: 这场比赛谁胜谁负，现在还很难说。
胜.en: It's still hard to say who will win and who will lose this match.

确保.zh: 工程师每天检查设备，确保工厂安全生产。
确保.en: The engineers check the equipment every day to ensure the factory operates safely.

建.zh: 学校旁边正在建一座新的图书馆。
建.en: A new library is being built next to the school.

足够.zh: 只要给我足够的时间，我一定能把这件事做好。
足够.en: As long as you give me enough time, I'll definitely get this done well.

拍摄.zh: 博物馆里禁止拍摄，请大家把相机收起来。
拍摄.en: Filming and photography are forbidden in the museum; please put your cameras away.

区域.zh: 这片区域是专门给游客停车的。
区域.en: This area is reserved for tourist parking.

愿.zh: 但愿明天天气好，我们就可以去爬山了。
愿.en: Let's hope the weather is good tomorrow so we can go hiking.

难以.zh: 那次旅行的经历让我至今难以忘记。
难以.en: I still find that trip hard to forget, even now.

运.zh: 这些水果要用冷藏车运到北京。
运.en: This fruit has to be shipped to Beijing in refrigerated trucks.

重大@6.zh: 他的研究在医学上有重大的发现。
重大@6.en: His research made a major discovery in medicine.

具有.zh: 这种植物具有很高的药用价值。
具有.en: This plant has high medicinal value.

医疗.zh: 政府加大了对农村医疗的投入，看病越来越方便了。
医疗.en: The government has increased investment in rural healthcare, and seeing a doctor is getting easier.

戏.zh: 这出戏讲的是一个古代爱情故事。
戏.en: This play tells an ancient love story.

处于.zh: 病人仍处于危险期，需要继续观察。
处于.en: The patient is still in a critical condition and needs further observation.

展示.zh: 这家商店在橱窗里展示了最新款的冬装。
展示.en: The shop displayed its newest winter clothes in the window.

强大.zh: 这台电脑功能强大，运行速度也很快。
强大.en: This computer is powerful and also runs very fast.

替.zh: 听说你考上了大学，我真替你高兴！
替.en: I heard you got into university. I'm so happy for you!

最佳.zh: 她凭这部电影获得了最佳女演员奖。
最佳.en: She won the Best Actress award for this film.

员工@6.zh: 公司每年都会给员工组织一次体检。
员工@6.en: Every year the company arranges a health check for its employees.

内部@6.zh: 这座建筑外面看起来很旧，内部却非常现代。
内部@6.en: This building looks old from outside, but the interior is very modern.

在于@6.zh: 这两种方法的区别在于速度不同。
在于@6.en: The difference between these two methods lies in their speed.

初.zh: 他初来这座城市时，一个朋友都没有。
初.en: When he first came to this city, he didn't have a single friend.

社区.zh: 这个社区的图书馆周末也对居民开放。
社区.en: This community's library is open to residents at weekends too.

手段.zh: 价格战是很多商家吸引顾客的常用手段。
手段.en: A price war is a common tactic many businesses use to attract customers.

即将.zh: 飞机即将起飞，请大家系好安全带。
即将.en: The plane is about to take off; please fasten your seatbelts.

宝.zh: 在奶奶眼里，这些旧家具都是宝，一件也舍不得扔。
宝.en: In Grandma's eyes, this old furniture is all treasure; she can't bear to throw away a single piece.

欧洲@6.zh: 法国和德国都是欧洲国家。
欧洲@6.en: France and Germany are both European countries.

贴.zh: 请把照片贴在报名表的右上角。
贴.en: Please stick your photo in the top right-hand corner of the application form.

尽快@6.zh: 我的签证快到期了，得尽快去办手续。
尽快@6.en: My visa is about to expire, so I need to sort out the paperwork as soon as possible.

药物.zh: 有些药物不能和酒一起服用。
药物.en: Some medications shouldn't be taken with alcohol.

进一步.zh: 警方正在对事故原因进行进一步调查。
进一步.en: The police are carrying out a further investigation into the cause of the accident.

防.zh: 晚上出门要注意安全，特别要防小偷。
防.en: Be careful when you go out at night, and especially watch out for thieves.

舞台.zh: 演出结束后，演员们一起走到舞台前向观众鞠躬。
舞台.en: After the show, the actors came to the front of the stage together and bowed to the audience.

化.zh: 随着全球化的发展，各国之间的联系越来越紧密。
化.en: With the development of globalization, ties between countries are becoming ever closer.

领.zh: 你的衬衫领子脏了，换一件吧。
领.en: Your shirt collar is dirty; put on another one.

结.zh: 鞋带打了个死结，我怎么也解不开。
结.en: My shoelace has got into a tight knot, and I just can't undo it.

讲话.zh: 他的讲话很简短，但给大家留下了深刻的印象。
讲话.en: His speech was short, but it left a deep impression on everyone.

付出.zh: 父母为我们付出了那么多，我们应该好好孝顺他们。
付出.en: Our parents have given so much for us; we should take good care of them.

哎@6.zh: 哎，你怎么现在才来？我们都等你半天了。
哎@6.en: Hey, why are you only getting here now? We've been waiting ages for you.

好运.zh: 他觉得这枚硬币能给他带来好运，一直放在钱包里。
好运.en: He believes this coin brings him good luck, so he always keeps it in his wallet.

治.zh: 医生说他的病能治好，让他别太担心。
治.en: The doctor said his illness can be cured and told him not to worry too much.

生物.zh: 她上大学时选择了生物专业，现在在医院做研究。
生物.en: She majored in biology at university and now does research at a hospital.

迷.zh: 这孩子一玩起游戏就着迷，叫他吃饭都听不见。
迷.en: Once this kid starts playing games, he's so absorbed he doesn't even hear you call him for dinner.

主题@6.zh: 这次画展的主题是城市和自然。
主题@6.en: The theme of this art exhibition is the city and nature.

主任@6.zh: 李主任今天去外地开会，明天才回来。
主任@6.en: Director Li has gone out of town for a meeting today and won't be back until tomorrow.

量.zh: 这种药一次吃的量不能太多。
量.en: You mustn't take too large a dose of this medicine at once.

试验.zh: 这种新型汽车正在进行安全试验。
试验.en: This new type of car is undergoing safety tests.

闹.zh: 春节期间，街上到处都很热闹。
闹.en: During the Spring Festival, the streets are lively everywhere.

品牌.zh: 很多年轻人买东西时更看重品牌。
品牌.en: When shopping, many young people care more about the brand.

录.zh: 这段视频是用手机录的，所以不太清楚。
录.en: This video was recorded on a phone, so it's not very clear.

惊喜.zh: 打开盒子的那一刻，她脸上露出了惊喜的表情。
惊喜.en: The moment she opened the box, a look of delighted surprise appeared on her face.

签@6.zh: 快递到了，快递员让我在单子上签个名。
签@6.en: The parcel arrived, and the courier asked me to sign the slip.

尝试.zh: 这次失败了没关系，我们还可以换个方法再尝试一次。
尝试.en: It doesn't matter that this failed; we can try once more with a different method.

疾病.zh: 夏天蚊子多，会传播很多种疾病。
疾病.en: There are lots of mosquitoes in summer, and they spread many kinds of disease.

女子.zh: 她在全国女子马拉松比赛中获得了冠军。
女子.en: She won the national women's marathon.

类似.zh: 这次只是个意外，但类似的事情以后绝对不能再发生了。
类似.en: This time it was just an accident, but nothing like it must ever happen again.

高度.zh: 领导对这个项目给予了高度重视。
高度.en: The leadership has given this project a high level of attention.

挑.zh: 这孩子吃饭太挑了，这也不吃那也不吃。
挑.en: This child is so picky about food; he won't eat this or that.

连续@6.zh: 这部电视剧已经连续播了两个月。
连续@6.en: This TV series has been airing continuously for two months.

老公.zh: 她和老公结婚十年了，感情一直很好。
老公.en: She and her husband have been married for ten years and have always got on well.

背后.zh: 有意见可以当面提，不要在背后说别人的坏话。
背后.en: If you have complaints, raise them to people's faces; don't speak ill of others behind their backs.

当中.zh: 这几个方案当中，你觉得哪个最好？
当中.en: Of these plans, which one do you think is best?

男子.zh: 他获得了男子一百米比赛的第一名。
男子.en: He won first place in the men's 100 metres.

躲.zh: 他一看到老师就躲开了，好像做了什么坏事。
躲.en: As soon as he saw the teacher he ducked out of sight, as if he'd done something wrong.

来源.zh: 农业是这个村子主要的收入来源。
来源.en: Farming is the village's main source of income.

生存.zh: 骆驼能在缺水的沙漠里生存很长时间。
生存.en: Camels can survive for a long time in deserts with little water.

大会.zh: 这次大会吸引了来自三十多个国家的代表。
大会.en: This conference attracted delegates from more than thirty countries.

或是.zh: 你可以坐地铁去，或是打车去，都很方便。
或是.en: You can take the subway or a taxi; either is convenient.

实力.zh: 比赛结果证明了我们队的真正实力。
实力.en: The result of the match proved our team's true strength.

拼.zh: 比赛还剩最后五分钟，队员们都在拼命地跑。
拼.en: With five minutes left in the match, the players were all running as hard as they could.

湖.zh: 这个湖很深，游泳的时候一定要注意安全。
湖.en: This lake is very deep, so be careful when you swim.

居民.zh: 这座古城里大部分居民以种茶为生。
居民.en: Most residents of this ancient town make their living growing tea.

恭喜@6.zh: 恭喜你们结婚，祝你们永远幸福！
恭喜@6.en: Congratulations on your wedding; I wish you happiness forever!

前往.zh: 乘客们请注意，前往上海的航班即将起飞。
前往.en: Attention passengers: the flight to Shanghai is about to take off.

分手@6.zh: 她和男朋友分手以后，难过了好几个月。
分手@6.en: After she broke up with her boyfriend, she was sad for several months.

歌曲.zh: 他写的歌曲大多是关于家乡和亲人的。
歌曲.en: Most of the songs he writes are about his hometown and his family.

团队.zh: 他很善于和别人合作，有很强的团队精神。
团队.en: He's good at working with others and has a strong team spirit.

模式.zh: 手机开启飞行模式后就不能打电话了。
模式.en: Once your phone is in airplane mode, you can't make calls.

维持.zh: 警察在现场维持秩序，防止发生混乱。
维持.en: Police kept order at the scene to stop things getting chaotic.

必.zh: 他这么做必有原因，你先别急着批评他。
必.en: He must have a reason for doing this, so don't rush to criticize him.

古.zh: 爷爷收藏了很多古钱币，每一枚都有自己的故事。
古.en: Grandpa has collected many ancient coins, and each one has its own story.

工程.zh: 他大学学的是土木工程，现在在建筑公司工作。
工程.en: He studied civil engineering at university and now works for a construction company.

实施.zh: 这个计划听起来不错，但实施起来困难很多。
实施.en: This plan sounds good, but carrying it out involves a lot of difficulties.

湿.zh: 地板刚拖过，还有点湿，小心别滑倒。
湿.en: The floor has just been mopped and is still a bit wet, so be careful not to slip.

类型@6.zh: 这种类型的题目考试中经常出现，一定要多练习。
类型@6.en: This type of question comes up often in exams, so be sure to practise it a lot.

造.zh: 这艘船是一百年前造的，现在已经成了博物馆。
造.en: This ship was built a hundred years ago and has now become a museum.

前进.zh: 大雾天气里，车辆只能慢慢前进。
前进.en: In heavy fog, vehicles can only move forward slowly.

他人.zh: 在公共场所大声打电话会影响他人。
他人.en: Talking loudly on the phone in public places disturbs others.

守.zh: 我们约好了时间，你一定要守时。
守.en: We've agreed on a time, so you must be punctual.

滑@6.zh: 这块肥皂太滑了，一下子从我手里掉了下去。
滑@6.en: This bar of soap was so slippery that it suddenly fell out of my hand.

操作.zh: 这款软件界面简单，老人也能轻松操作。
操作.en: This app has a simple interface, so even elderly people can operate it easily.

达成.zh: 只要全队一起努力，我们一定能达成今年的目标。
达成.en: As long as the whole team works together, we will surely achieve this year's goals.

本人.zh: 这封信必须由收信人本人签收。
本人.en: This letter must be signed for by the recipient in person.

舞蹈.zh: 她在晚会上表演的民族舞蹈赢得了热烈的掌声。
舞蹈.en: The folk dance she performed at the party won warm applause.

发布.zh: 气象台发布了今年第一个高温预警。
发布.en: The weather bureau issued this year's first high-temperature warning.

忍.zh: 邻居天天半夜唱歌，我实在忍不了了。
忍.en: My neighbour sings in the middle of the night every day; I really can't stand it anymore.

退出.zh: 玩完游戏以后，记得退出账号。
退出.en: Remember to log out of your account after you finish playing.

库.zh: 他把车停进了车库，就上楼休息了。
库.en: He parked the car in the garage and went upstairs to rest.

奖励.zh: 公司奖励了今年销售成绩最好的员工一次旅行。
奖励.en: The company rewarded this year's best-performing salesperson with a trip.

齐.zh: 他把书架上的书摆得很整齐。
齐.en: He arranged the books on the shelf very neatly.

市民.zh: 很多市民对这项新政策表示支持。
市民.en: Many residents have expressed support for this new policy.

顺.zh: 你顺着这条路一直往前走，就能看到地铁站。
顺.en: Follow this road straight ahead and you'll see the subway station.

登.zh: 请乘客们拿好行李，准备登机。
登.en: Passengers, please take your luggage and prepare to board.

不幸.zh: 听到这个不幸的消息，大家都很难过。
不幸.en: Everyone was very sad to hear the unfortunate news.

领先.zh: 这家公司的技术在全世界处于领先地位。
领先.en: This company's technology leads the world.

上升.zh: 今年这家公司的销售额上升了百分之二十。
上升.en: This year the company's sales rose by twenty percent.

围.zh: 一群人围在路边，不知道在看什么。
围.en: A crowd had gathered at the roadside; I couldn't tell what they were looking at.

路线.zh: 这条旅游路线经过好几个著名景点。
路线.en: This tour route passes several famous sights.

碰@6.zh: 真巧，我昨天在超市碰到了多年不见的老同学。
碰@6.en: What a coincidence: yesterday at the supermarket I ran into an old classmate I hadn't seen for years.

在乎@6.zh: 只要你过得开心，钱多钱少我都不在乎。
在乎@6.en: As long as you are happy, I don't care whether you earn a lot or a little.

飞行.zh: 经过十个小时的飞行，我们终于到达了伦敦。
飞行.en: After a ten-hour flight, we finally arrived in London.

较.zh: 这家店的东西价格较高，但质量很好。
较.en: Prices at this shop are relatively high, but the quality is very good.

福.zh: 一家人身体健康、平平安安，这就是最大的福。
福.en: For the whole family to be healthy and safe is the greatest blessing.

族.zh: 现在很多年轻人成了“上班族”，每天早出晚归。
族.en: Nowadays many young people have become office workers, leaving early and coming home late every day.

全新.zh: 搬到国外以后，他开始了全新的生活。
全新.en: After moving abroad, he started a completely new life.

地下.zh: 这个地区的地下水资源非常丰富。
地下.en: This area is very rich in groundwater resources.

违法.zh: 他因为违法经营，被罚了五万元。
违法.en: He was fined fifty thousand yuan for running his business illegally.

长期.zh: 我们希望和贵公司建立长期的合作关系。
长期.en: We hope to establish a long-term partnership with your company.

品.zh: 这位画家的作品在国内外都很有名。
品.en: This painter's works are famous both at home and abroad.

收集.zh: 警方正在收集证据，争取早日破案。
收集.en: The police are gathering evidence, hoping to crack the case soon.

深入.zh: 这个问题我们需要更深入地研究一下。
深入.en: We need to study this problem in more depth.

情感.zh: 他是个不善于表达情感的人，很少说“我爱你”。
情感.en: He's not good at expressing his emotions and rarely says "I love you".

称为.zh: 这座城市因为桥多，被人们称为“桥城”。
称为.en: Because it has so many bridges, people call this city "the City of Bridges".

车辆.zh: 这条路正在维修，禁止车辆通行。
车辆.en: This road is under repair and closed to vehicles.

当年.zh: 他还是当年那个样子，一点都没变。
当年.en: He looks just the way he did back then; he hasn't changed a bit.

使得.zh: 网购的发展使得人们的生活更加方便。
使得.en: The growth of online shopping has made people's lives more convenient.

人群.zh: 一听说明星来了，人群一下子涌了过来。
人群.en: As soon as they heard the star had arrived, the crowd surged forward.

依靠.zh: 这个国家的经济主要依靠旅游业。
依靠.en: This country's economy relies mainly on tourism.

产.zh: 这种茶叶产自云南，味道很特别。
产.en: This tea comes from Yunnan and has a very special flavour.

报警.zh: 听到楼下有人喊救命，她立刻报警了。
报警.en: Hearing someone downstairs shout for help, she immediately called the police.

争.zh: 这两支球队正在争冠军，比赛非常激烈。
争.en: These two teams are fighting for the championship, and the match is very intense.

划@6.zh: 他不小心被玻璃划破了手指。
划@6.en: He accidentally cut his finger on a piece of glass.

移.zh: 他的目光一直没有从那幅画上移开。
移.en: His eyes never left that painting.

测.zh: 你去医院测一下血压吧，最近你总说头晕。
测.en: Go to the hospital and get your blood pressure checked; you keep saying you feel dizzy lately.

剪.zh: 他把报纸上那篇文章剪下来贴在了本子上。
剪.en: He cut that article out of the newspaper and stuck it in his notebook.

物品.zh: 机场规定，危险物品不能带上飞机。
物品.en: Airport rules say dangerous items can't be taken on the plane.

止.zh: 这种药可以止痛，但不能多吃。
止.en: This medicine can stop pain, but you shouldn't take too much.

保安.zh: 他在一家银行当保安，晚上要值班。
保安.en: He works as a security guard at a bank and has to do night shifts.

实验室.zh: 实验室里有很多危险的化学品，不能随便进。
实验室.en: There are many dangerous chemicals in the lab, so you can't just go in.

全体.zh: 请全体同学起立，向老师问好。
全体.en: All students, please stand up and greet the teacher.

挤.zh: 电影票今天打折，售票处门口挤满了人。
挤.en: Movie tickets are discounted today, and the ticket office entrance is packed with people.

医学.zh: 随着医学的发展，很多以前治不好的病现在都能治了。
医学.en: With the development of medicine, many diseases that used to be incurable can now be treated.

作出.zh: 他为公司的发展作出了很大的贡献。
作出.en: He made a great contribution to the company's development.

搜索@6.zh: 只要在手机上搜索一下，就能找到附近的加油站。
搜索@6.en: Just do a quick search on your phone and you can find a nearby petrol station.

炸.zh: 油炸食品吃多了对身体不好。
炸.en: Eating too much deep-fried food is bad for you.

预测.zh: 未来会怎么样，谁也无法准确预测。
预测.en: No one can accurately predict what the future will be like.

位于@6.zh: 我们学校位于城市的东边，靠近一个大公园。
位于@6.en: Our school is located in the east of the city, near a big park.

静.zh: 你先静下心来，想想问题到底出在哪儿。
静.en: Calm down first and think about where the problem actually lies.

需求.zh: 随着人口老龄化，社会对护理人员的需求越来越大。
需求.en: As the population ages, society's demand for carers keeps growing.

展现.zh: 这些老照片展现了一百年前北京人的生活。
展现.en: These old photos show what life was like for people in Beijing a hundred years ago.

谈话.zh: 两位领导的谈话持续了一个多小时。
谈话.en: The two leaders' conversation lasted more than an hour.

平安@6.zh: 祝你一路平安，到了别忘了发个消息。
平安@6.en: Have a safe trip, and don't forget to send a message when you arrive.

环节.zh: 比赛的最后一个环节是现场问答。
环节.en: The final stage of the competition is a live question-and-answer round.

打破.zh: 一阵电话铃声打破了房间里的安静。
打破.en: The ring of a telephone broke the silence in the room.

全力.zh: 运动员们正在全力准备下个月的比赛。
全力.en: The athletes are going all out to prepare for next month's competition.

签名.zh: 演出结束后，很多粉丝排队找歌手要签名。
签名.en: After the show, many fans queued up to ask the singer for an autograph.

先进.zh: 她连续三年被评为公司的先进工作者。
先进.en: She has been named the company's model worker three years in a row.

描述.zh: 那里的风景美得无法用语言描述。
描述.en: The scenery there is so beautiful it can't be described in words.

今日.zh: 今日起，这条地铁线路将延长运营时间。
今日.en: Starting today, this subway line will extend its operating hours.

认.zh: 这孩子才三岁，已经认了好几百个字。
认.en: This child is only three and already knows several hundred characters.

在场.zh: 在场的人都被他的话感动了。
在场.en: Everyone present was moved by what he said.

敏感@6.zh: 工资是个敏感话题，最好不要随便问别人。
敏感@6.en: Salary is a sensitive topic; it's best not to ask people about it casually.

防止.zh: 下雪天路面很滑，开车时要放慢速度，防止发生事故。
防止.en: Roads are slippery on snowy days, so slow down when driving to prevent accidents.

设置.zh: 为了保护隐私，他给电脑设置了一个复杂的密码。
设置.en: To protect his privacy, he set a complicated password on his computer.

含.zh: 他嘴里含着一块糖，说话不太清楚。
含.en: He had a sweet in his mouth, so he wasn't speaking very clearly.

采用.zh: 公司最后采用了小王提出的方案。
采用.en: In the end the company adopted the plan Xiao Wang proposed.

夫妇.zh: 那对年轻夫妇刚刚在郊区买了房子。
夫妇.en: That young married couple has just bought a house in the suburbs.

提升.zh: 多读书可以提升一个人的文化水平。
提升.en: Reading more can raise a person's level of education and culture.

地面.zh: 飞机已经离开地面，慢慢飞上了天空。
地面.en: The plane has left the ground and is slowly climbing into the sky.

抱怨@6.zh: 顾客抱怨饭菜上得太慢，经理连忙道歉。
抱怨@6.en: The customers complained that the food was too slow to arrive, and the manager hurriedly apologised.

无关.zh: 成功与年龄无关，关键是要肯努力。
无关.en: Success has nothing to do with age; what matters is being willing to work hard.

动手.zh: 有话好好说，千万别动手打人。
动手.en: Talk it out properly — never start hitting people.

靠近.zh: 我想找一个靠近地铁站的房子。
靠近.en: I'd like to find a place near a subway station.

直播.zh: 她每天晚上在网上直播教大家做菜。
直播.en: Every evening she livestreams online, teaching people how to cook.

应当.zh: 年轻人应当多出去走走，看看外面的世界。
应当.en: Young people ought to get out more and see the world.

罚.zh: 上课迟到的学生要被老师罚站。
罚.en: Students who are late for class are made to stand as punishment.

交往@6.zh: 他们俩交往了三年，打算明年结婚。
交往@6.en: The two of them have been dating for three years and plan to marry next year.

空中.zh: 新年夜里，五颜六色的烟花在空中绽开。
空中.en: On New Year's night, colourful fireworks burst open in the sky.

连接.zh: 要上网的话，请先把电脑连接到无线网络上。
连接.en: If you want to go online, please connect the computer to the wireless network first.

药品.zh: 药品应当放在孩子拿不到的地方。
药品.en: Medicines should be kept out of children's reach.

影片.zh: 这是一部根据真实事件改编的影片。
影片.en: This is a film adapted from real events.

此时.zh: 他正准备出门，此时电话突然响了。
此时.en: He was just about to go out when the phone suddenly rang.

当作.zh: 你就把这里当作自己的家，别客气。
当作.en: Just treat this place as your own home; make yourself comfortable.

眼泪.zh: 孩子擦干眼泪，又高高兴兴地去玩了。
眼泪.en: The child wiped away his tears and went off happily to play again.

画面.zh: 那天离别的画面，我到现在还记得清清楚楚。
画面.en: I still remember the scene of our parting that day very clearly.

隔.zh: 两个房间之间只隔了一面薄墙，说话都能听见。
隔.en: Only a thin wall separates the two rooms, so you can hear people talking.

周年.zh: 为了庆祝公司成立二十周年，老板请大家吃饭。
周年.en: To celebrate the company's twentieth anniversary, the boss treated everyone to dinner.

统计.zh: 据统计，这个城市每天产生上万吨垃圾。
统计.en: According to statistics, this city produces over ten thousand tonnes of rubbish a day.

创作.zh: 这位作家花了五年时间才完成这部长篇小说的创作。
创作.en: The writer spent five years completing this novel.

本地.zh: 他不是本地人，说话带着外地口音。
本地.en: He's not from around here; he speaks with an accent from elsewhere.

大脑.zh: 他太累了，大脑一片空白，什么也想不起来。
大脑.en: He was so tired his mind went blank and he couldn't remember anything.

自身.zh: 每个人都应该根据自身的情况选择合适的工作。
自身.en: Everyone should choose a suitable job based on their own situation.

大事.zh: 出什么大事了？你怎么这么着急？
大事.en: What's happened? Why are you in such a hurry?

演讲@6.zh: 下周学校要举行英语演讲比赛，我报了名。
演讲@6.en: Next week the school is holding an English speech contest, and I've signed up.

屏幕.zh: 这台新电视的屏幕有七十五英寸。
屏幕.en: This new TV has a 75-inch screen.

负担.zh: 老师减少了作业，减轻了学生的负担。
负担.en: The teacher cut down the homework, lightening the students' burden.

随后.zh: 警察接到报警后立刻赶到现场，救护车随后也到了。
随后.en: The police rushed to the scene as soon as they got the call, and an ambulance arrived soon after.

升级.zh: 这家酒店把我们的房间免费升级成了套房。
升级.en: The hotel upgraded our room to a suite for free.

加速.zh: 政府出台新政策，加速推动新能源汽车的发展。
加速.en: The government has introduced new policies to accelerate the development of new-energy vehicles.

人体.zh: 吸烟对人体的危害很大，最好早点戒掉。
人体.en: Smoking does great harm to the human body; it's best to quit as early as you can.

培训@6.zh: 这家公司每年都会给员工提供免费的英语培训。
培训@6.en: This company provides its staff with free English training every year.

独自.zh: 天黑以后，女孩子最好不要独自走夜路。
独自.en: After dark, it's best for girls not to walk alone at night.

推进.zh: 两国政府决定共同推进经济合作。
推进.en: The two governments decided to jointly advance economic cooperation.

搜.zh: 警察把他的房间搜了一遍，什么也没找到。
搜.en: The police searched his room and found nothing.

大众.zh: 这部电影内容简单易懂，适合大众观看。
大众.en: This film is simple and easy to understand, suitable for a general audience.

计算机.zh: 现在很多工作都离不开计算机。
计算机.en: Many jobs today can't be done without computers.

房屋.zh: 这一带的房屋大多是上世纪八十年代建的。
房屋.en: Most of the houses in this area were built in the 1980s.

买卖.zh: 这笔买卖我们亏了不少钱，以后得小心点。
买卖.en: We lost quite a lot of money on this deal; we'll have to be more careful from now on.

出售.zh: 法律规定，商店不得向未成年人出售烟酒。
出售.en: By law, shops may not sell cigarettes or alcohol to minors.

总部.zh: 他被调到总部工作，所以要搬家了。
总部.en: He's been transferred to head office, so he has to move.

分离.zh: 和父母分离了二十年，他终于回到了家乡。
分离.en: After twenty years apart from his parents, he finally returned home.

扇.zh: 他热得满头大汗，拿起一本杂志不停地扇着。
扇.en: He was so hot he was dripping with sweat, so he picked up a magazine and kept fanning himself.

堵.zh: 厨房的水管堵了，得找人来修。
堵.en: The kitchen pipe is blocked; we need to get someone to fix it.

随意.zh: 请随意，就当在自己家一样。
随意.en: Make yourself at home, just as if you were in your own house.

预计.zh: 这座大桥预计明年年底建成通车。
预计.en: This bridge is expected to be completed and open to traffic by the end of next year.

轻易@6.zh: 他不会轻易相信陌生人说的话。
轻易@6.en: He doesn't readily believe what strangers say.

当成.zh: 他一直把这只狗当成自己的家人。
当成.en: He has always treated this dog as one of the family.

适当.zh: 请你根据实际情况，适当调整一下计划。
适当.en: Please adjust the plan as appropriate to the actual situation.

如同.zh: 他对待学生如同对待自己的孩子一样。
如同.en: He treats his students as he would his own children.

提起.zh: 这件事你千万别在他面前提起。
提起.en: Whatever you do, don't bring this up in front of him.

建造.zh: 政府计划在这里建造一座新的体育馆。
建造.en: The government plans to build a new stadium here.

思维.zh: 这个设计打破了传统思维，让人眼前一亮。
思维.en: This design breaks with conventional thinking and is eye-opening.

饼.zh: 早上我常在路边买一个鸡蛋饼当早饭。

便利.zh: 网上购物给人们的生活带来了很大的便利。
便利.en: Online shopping has brought great convenience to people's lives.

大力.zh: 这几年学校大力支持学生参加各种社会实践活动。
大力.en: In recent years the school has strongly supported students taking part in all kinds of social activities.

开展.zh: 社区开展了一次大规模的垃圾分类宣传活动。
开展.en: The community launched a large-scale campaign promoting waste sorting.

长久.zh: 两个人相处，只有互相尊重，感情才能长久。
长久.en: In a relationship, love can only last if both people respect each other.

中华民族.zh: 长城是中华民族的象征之一，每年吸引无数游客。
中华民族.en: The Great Wall is one of the symbols of the Chinese nation and attracts countless tourists every year.

紧密.zh: 学习和生活是紧密相连的，不能分开来看。
紧密.en: Study and life are closely linked and can't be looked at separately.

体力.zh: 搬家是个体力活，你最好多叫几个朋友来帮忙。
体力.en: Moving house is hard physical work; you'd better get a few more friends to help.

视为.zh: 考试中使用手机的，一律视为作弊。
视为.en: Anyone using a mobile phone during the exam will be treated as cheating.

诗人.zh: 这位年轻诗人的第一本诗集一出版就卖光了。
诗人.en: This young poet's first collection of poems sold out as soon as it came out.

打断.zh: 他刚开口要解释，就被经理不耐烦地打断了。
打断.en: He had barely started to explain when the manager impatiently cut him off.

语音.zh: 他开车不方便打字，就给我发了一条语音。
语音.en: He was driving and couldn't type, so he sent me a voice message.

注重.zh: 他平时很注重饮食健康，很少吃油炸食品。
注重.en: He usually pays close attention to eating healthily and rarely eats fried food.

夜间.zh: 这家医院的急诊科夜间也有医生值班。
夜间.en: This hospital's emergency department has doctors on duty at night as well.

有助于.zh: 多读课外书有助于扩大孩子的知识面。
有助于.en: Reading more books outside of class helps broaden children's knowledge.

用力.zh: 他用力推了一下门，门却一动也不动。
用力.en: He pushed the door hard, but it didn't budge at all.

拨打.zh: 您拨打的电话暂时无人接听，请稍后再拨。
拨打.en: The number you have dialled is not answering; please try again later.

加工.zh: 这家工厂把新鲜牛奶加工成奶酪和酸奶。
加工.en: This factory processes fresh milk into cheese and yoghurt.

行程.zh: 因为台风，我们不得不改变行程，提前回国。
行程.en: Because of the typhoon, we had to change our travel plans and go home early.

记载.zh: 据史书记载，这座石桥建于一千多年前。
记载.en: According to historical records, this stone bridge was built over a thousand years ago.

差距@6.zh: 虽然我进步了很多，但是和第一名还有很大的差距。
差距@6.en: Although I've improved a lot, there's still a big gap between me and the top student.

证书.zh: 应聘这个职位需要提供教师资格证书。
证书.en: Applicants for this position must provide a teaching qualification certificate.

病房.zh: 他住的病房里一共有三张病床，另外两张也都住了人。
病房.en: The ward he's in has three beds, and the other two are occupied as well.

研发.zh: 他大学毕业后进了一家互联网公司，负责软件研发。
研发.en: After graduating, he joined an internet company and works in software development.

西装.zh: 这套西装是在店里量身定做的，穿起来非常合身。
西装.en: This suit was tailor-made at the shop and fits perfectly.

字母@6.zh: 请用大写字母填写你的姓名。
字母@6.en: Please fill in your name in capital letters.

忙碌.zh: 超市里，店员们正忙碌地往货架上摆放商品。
忙碌.en: In the supermarket, the staff are busily stocking the shelves.

灰色.zh: 他买了一件灰色的大衣，跟什么裤子都好搭配。
灰色.en: He bought a grey coat that goes with any pair of trousers.

束.zh: 一束阳光从窗户照进来，正好落在书桌上。
束.en: A beam of sunlight shone through the window and fell right on the desk.

销量.zh: 因为天气太冷，冰淇淋的销量明显下降了。
销量.en: Because the weather is so cold, ice cream sales have dropped noticeably.

分类.zh: 我们小区要求居民把垃圾分类以后再扔。
分类.en: Our neighbourhood requires residents to sort their rubbish before throwing it out.

外部.zh: 公司遇到的困难主要来自外部，比如市场竞争越来越激烈。
外部.en: The company's difficulties come mainly from outside, such as ever fiercer market competition.

充足.zh: 考试前一定要保证睡眠充足，否则很难集中精力。
充足.en: Make sure you get enough sleep before the exam, or it will be hard to concentrate.

名称.zh: 这种植物在不同地方有不同的名称，很容易弄混。
名称.en: This plant has different names in different places, so it's easy to mix up.

向上.zh: 他是一个积极向上的年轻人，从来不怕困难。
向上.en: He's a positive, driven young man who's never afraid of difficulties.

预约.zh: 博物馆每天限流三千人，参观前必须预约。
预约.en: The museum admits only 3,000 visitors a day, so you must book before you go.

抢救.zh: 图书馆着火时，管理员们冲进去抢救珍贵的古书。
抢救.en: When the library caught fire, the librarians rushed in to save the precious old books.

更换.zh: 这套系统已经很旧了，公司打算明年全部更换。
更换.en: This system is very old; the company plans to replace all of it next year.

丢失.zh: 如果银行卡丢失，请马上打电话办理挂失。
丢失.en: If your bank card goes missing, call right away to report it lost.

近期.zh: 该公司表示近期不会再推出新产品。
近期.en: The company said it won't launch any new products in the near future.

评.zh: 他工作非常努力，今年被评为公司的优秀员工。
评.en: He works very hard and was named one of the company's outstanding employees this year.

缓慢.zh: 受全球市场影响，今年的经济增长速度十分缓慢。
缓慢.en: Affected by the global market, economic growth this year has been very slow.

行走.zh: 这位盲人靠着导盲犬，能够在城市里独立行走。
行走.en: With the help of his guide dog, this blind man can get around the city on his own.

出自.zh: 这幅画一看就出自名家之手，价格肯定不便宜。
出自.en: You can tell at a glance this painting is by a master, so it certainly won't be cheap.

由此.zh: 两国领导人成功会谈，两国关系由此进入了新阶段。
由此.en: The two leaders held successful talks, and relations between the two countries thus entered a new stage.

租金.zh: 市中心的店面租金太高，他只好把店搬到了郊区。
租金.en: Shop rents in the city centre were too high, so he had to move his shop to the suburbs.

智能.zh: 这台智能音箱可以听懂主人的语音命令。
智能.en: This smart speaker can understand its owner's voice commands.

心态.zh: 面对失败，他始终保持积极乐观的心态。
心态.en: In the face of failure, he always keeps a positive, optimistic attitude.

总体.zh: 今年公司的总体情况比去年好很多。
总体.en: The company's overall situation this year is much better than last year.

登录.zh: 密码连续输错三次后，系统会暂时禁止登录。
登录.en: After three wrong passwords in a row, the system temporarily blocks logging in.

应对.zh: 各国应当共同努力，应对气候变化带来的挑战。
应对.en: All countries should work together to meet the challenges of climate change.

光线.zh: 拍照的时候要注意光线，逆光拍出来的脸会很黑。
光线.en: Pay attention to the light when taking photos; faces come out dark against the light.

强度.zh: 医生建议他刚开始锻炼时，不要把运动强度定得太高。
强度.en: The doctor advised him not to set the intensity of his workouts too high when he first starts.

一次性.zh: 这笔钱可以一次性付清，也可以分十二个月还。
一次性.en: You can pay this sum in full at once or pay it back over twelve months.

变动.zh: 公司人事发生了较大变动，好几位经理都换了人。
变动.en: There has been a major staff reshuffle at the company, with several managers replaced.

烧烤.zh: 夏天的晚上，街边的烧烤摊总是坐满了人。
烧烤.en: On summer evenings, the roadside barbecue stalls are always packed.

新型.zh: 警方提醒市民，要警惕各种新型网络诈骗。
新型.en: The police are warning the public to watch out for new kinds of online fraud.

互动.zh: 演唱会上，歌手不时走下舞台和观众互动。
互动.en: At the concert, the singer kept stepping off the stage to interact with the audience.

将近.zh: 从这里坐车到机场需要将近两个小时。
将近.en: It takes nearly two hours to get to the airport from here by car.

赛场.zh: 受伤半年后，这位运动员终于重新回到了赛场。
赛场.en: Six months after his injury, the athlete finally returned to competition.

人力.zh: 这项工程需要投入大量的人力和物力。
人力.en: This project requires a huge investment of manpower and materials.

低头.zh: 现在很多人走路时都低头看手机，非常危险。
低头.en: Nowadays lots of people look down at their phones while walking, which is very dangerous.

子女.zh: 公司为员工子女提供免费的暑期托管服务。
子女.en: The company provides free summer childcare for employees' children.

面向.zh: 这门课程主要面向零基础的初学者。
面向.en: This course is mainly aimed at complete beginners.

消费者.zh: 商家虚假宣传，严重侵害了消费者的权益。
消费者.en: The merchant's false advertising seriously violated consumers' rights.

种植.zh: 这个地区气候温暖湿润，非常适合种植茶树。
种植.en: This region's warm, humid climate is ideal for growing tea.

住房.zh: 政府计划新建一批保障性住房，帮助低收入家庭。
住房.en: The government plans to build a batch of affordable housing to help low-income families.

此后.zh: 他十八岁离开家，此后一直在北京工作。
此后.en: He left home at eighteen and has worked in Beijing ever since.

打包.zh: 搬家前，我们花了两天时间把所有东西打包好。
打包.en: Before moving, we spent two days packing everything up.

定期.zh: 我的汽车每半年定期保养一次。
定期.en: My car gets regular servicing every six months.

动人.zh: 她的歌声非常动人，大家都听得入了迷。
动人.en: Her singing was so moving that everyone was spellbound.

种类@6.zh: 超市里牛奶的种类太多了，我不知道该买哪种。
种类@6.en: There are so many kinds of milk in the supermarket that I don't know which to buy.

有益.zh: 参加志愿活动对我来说是一次非常有益的经历。
有益.en: Volunteering was a very worthwhile experience for me.

户外.zh: 他特别喜欢爬山、露营这样的户外运动。
户外.en: He loves outdoor activities like hiking and camping.

急需.zh: 医院现在急需O型血，希望市民踊跃献血。
急需.en: The hospital urgently needs type O blood and hopes people will come forward to donate.

凭借.zh: 这家小公司凭借过硬的技术，在市场上站稳了脚跟。
凭借.en: Thanks to its solid technology, this small company has gained a firm foothold in the market.

看作.zh: 别客气，我一直把你看作自己的亲妹妹。
看作.en: Don't be so polite; I've always thought of you as my own little sister.

橘子.zh: 这种橘子皮很薄，用手一剥就开了。
橘子.en: These tangerines have very thin skin and peel easily by hand.

剧场.zh: 演出快开始了，观众们陆续走进剧场找座位。
剧场.en: The show was about to start, and the audience filed into the theatre to find their seats.

有害.zh: 这种塑料加热后会释放出有害物质。
有害.en: This plastic gives off harmful substances when heated.

开业.zh: 这家餐厅开业第一天，所有菜都打五折。
开业.en: On the restaurant's first day of business, every dish was half price.

图书.zh: 这个网站上的图书经常打折，比实体店便宜不少。
图书.en: Books on this website are often on sale and much cheaper than in physical shops.

泪水.zh: 比赛结束的那一刻，他再也控制不住，泪水夺眶而出。
泪水.en: The moment the match ended, he couldn't hold back any longer and tears streamed from his eyes.

电器.zh: 这个插座同时插了太多电器，很容易出问题。
电器.en: Too many appliances are plugged into this socket at once; that can easily cause trouble.

步行.zh: 从这里步行到地铁站大概只要五分钟。
步行.en: It's only about a five-minute walk from here to the subway station.

就业.zh: 这个新工厂建成后，可以为当地提供两千个就业机会。
就业.en: Once completed, this new factory can provide two thousand local jobs.

时常.zh: 这家小店的老板时常送给老顾客一些小礼物。
时常.en: The owner of this little shop often gives small gifts to regular customers.

彩色.zh: 以前的电视只有黑白的，后来才有了彩色电视。
彩色.en: TVs used to be only black and white; colour TV came later.

上涨.zh: 连续下了几天大雨，河里的水位不断上涨。
上涨.en: After several days of heavy rain, the river level kept rising.

消极@6.zh: 他工作态度很消极，总是能少做就少做。
消极@6.en: His attitude to work is very passive; he always does as little as he can.

收看.zh: 观众朋友们，欢迎收看今天的新闻节目。
收看.en: Good evening, viewers, and welcome to today's news programme.

海外.zh: 春节期间，很多海外华人也会以各种方式庆祝。
海外.en: During the Spring Festival, many overseas Chinese also celebrate in various ways.

公务员.zh: 每年报考公务员的人数都在增加，竞争非常激烈。
公务员.en: The number of people applying to be civil servants grows every year, and competition is fierce.

看望@6.zh: 我出差路过老家，顺便看望了一下以前的老师。
看望@6.en: Passing through my hometown on a business trip, I dropped in to visit my old teacher.

热量.zh: 炸鸡的热量很高，减肥期间最好少吃。
热量.en: Fried chicken is high in calories, so it's best to eat less of it while dieting.

早晚.zh: 你骗了他这么多次，他早晚会发现的。
早晚.en: You've lied to him so many times; he'll find out sooner or later.

亏.zh: 这家店开了一年一直在亏钱，老板只好把它关了。
亏.en: The shop lost money for a whole year, so the owner had to close it.

长度.zh: 这篇作文的长度不能少于八百字。
长度.en: This essay must be at least eight hundred characters long.

签订.zh: 入职第一天，公司就和他签订了三年的劳动合同。
签订.en: On his first day, the company signed a three-year employment contract with him.

迎.zh: 听说老同学要来，他一大早就跑到村口去迎他。
迎.en: Hearing that his old classmate was coming, he ran to the village entrance first thing in the morning to meet him.

鸭子.zh: 奶奶在院子里养了几只鸡和鸭子，每天都能捡到蛋。
鸭子.en: Grandma keeps a few chickens and ducks in the yard and collects eggs every day.

车主.zh: 很多车主都选择在网上购买汽车保险。
车主.en: Many car owners choose to buy their car insurance online.

赏.zh: 每年春天，很多人专门去公园赏花。
赏.en: Every spring, lots of people go to the park specially to enjoy the flowers.

引进.zh: 为了发展经济，这座城市积极引进各类人才。
引进.en: To develop its economy, the city is actively bringing in talent of all kinds.

充电.zh: 工作几年后，他觉得自己需要充电，就报了个研究生课程。
充电.en: After working a few years, he felt he needed to recharge, so he enrolled in a postgraduate course.

促销.zh: 商家常常利用节假日进行促销，吸引更多顾客。
促销.en: Merchants often use holidays to run promotions and attract more customers.

加热.zh: 水加热到一百度就会开始沸腾。
加热.en: Water starts to boil when it's heated to one hundred degrees.

电动.zh: 这款电动牙刷充一次电可以用一个月。
电动.en: This electric toothbrush lasts a month on a single charge.

赠送.zh: 这本词典是朋友赠送给我的毕业礼物。
赠送.en: This dictionary was a graduation present given to me by a friend.

标题.zh: 邮件的标题一定要写清楚，方便对方一眼看出主要内容。
标题.en: Make the email's subject line clear so the recipient can see the main point at a glance.

番茄.zh: 这种番茄酱酸酸甜甜的，配薯条特别好吃。
番茄.en: This ketchup is sweet and tangy and goes great with fries.

比喻.zh: 这首诗用了很多生动的比喻，读起来很有意思。
比喻.en: This poem uses many vivid metaphors and is very interesting to read.

新郎.zh: 婚礼上，新郎紧张得把戒指掉在了地上。
新郎.en: At the wedding, the groom was so nervous he dropped the ring on the floor.

到期.zh: 租房合同快到期了，房东问我还续不续租。
到期.en: My lease is about to run out, and the landlord asked whether I'll renew.

修建.zh: 为了方便村民出行，政府在河上修建了一座石桥。
修建.en: To make travel easier for the villagers, the government built a stone bridge over the river.

高大.zh: 公园门口种着两排高大的树，夏天特别凉快。
高大.en: Two rows of tall trees line the park entrance, so it's lovely and cool in summer.

动画.zh: 他大学学的是动画设计，现在在一家游戏公司工作。
动画.en: He studied animation design at university and now works for a games company.

研制.zh: 一九六四年，中国第一颗原子弹研制成功。
研制.en: In 1964, China successfully developed its first atomic bomb.

成年.zh: 孩子已经成年了，有些事应该让他自己做决定。
成年.en: He's an adult now; some things he should decide for himself.

职工.zh: 单位每年都组织职工免费体检。
职工.en: The work unit arranges a free health check for its staff every year.

长远.zh: 保护环境关系到国家的长远发展。
长远.en: Protecting the environment matters for the country's long-term development.

印刷@6.zh: 这本杂志每月印刷五万份。
印刷@6.en: This magazine prints fifty thousand copies a month.

外形.zh: 这种动物外形很像老鼠，其实跟老鼠没什么关系。
外形.en: This animal looks a lot like a mouse but isn't actually related to mice.

赠.zh: 这本书是作者签名后亲手赠给我的。
赠.en: The author signed this book and gave it to me personally.

大爷.zh: 楼下那位大爷退休前是老师，他每天早上都在公园里打太极拳。
大爷.en: The old man downstairs was a teacher before he retired; he does tai chi in the park every morning.

熟人.zh: 他想通过熟人帮忙找工作，结果被骗了钱。
熟人.en: He tried to find a job through someone he knew and ended up being cheated out of money.

报到@6.zh: 他明天第一天上班，要早点儿去公司报到。
报到@6.en: Tomorrow is his first day at work, and he has to report to the company early.

初期.zh: 这种病在初期没有明显症状，很容易被忽视。
初期.en: This disease has no obvious symptoms in its early stage, so it's easily overlooked.

在线.zh: 他的头像是灰的，说明他现在不在线。
在线.en: His profile picture is greyed out, which means he's not online right now.

河流.zh: 工厂把污水直接排进附近的河流，造成了严重污染。
河流.en: The factory dumped waste water straight into a nearby river, causing serious pollution.

通行.zh: 这座桥只允许行人和自行车通行。
通行.en: Only pedestrians and bicycles are allowed to cross this bridge.

学历@6.zh: 现在很多公司除了看学历，更看重工作能力。
学历@6.en: Nowadays many companies look beyond educational background and value work ability more.

一代.zh: 新一代年轻人更注重生活质量。
一代.en: The new generation of young people care more about quality of life.

纪念日.zh: 这个纪念日是为了纪念在大地震中遇难的人。
纪念日.en: This day of remembrance commemorates those who died in the great earthquake.

聘请.zh: 公司打算聘请一位有经验的律师来处理这件事。
聘请.en: The company plans to hire an experienced lawyer to handle the matter.

门诊.zh: 他只是轻微感冒，在门诊开了点药就回家了。
门诊.en: He just had a slight cold, so he got some medicine at the outpatient clinic and went home.

故乡.zh: 每次吃到这道菜，我都会想起遥远的故乡。
故乡.en: Every time I eat this dish, I think of my faraway hometown.

邮票.zh: 寄信前别忘了在信封上贴好邮票。
邮票.en: Don't forget to put a stamp on the envelope before you post the letter.

开幕.zh: 展览开幕当天，来参观的人排起了长队。
开幕.en: On the day the exhibition opened, visitors formed a long queue.

树木.zh: 为了修路，这里的很多树木被砍掉了。
树木.en: Many of the trees here were cut down to build the road.

特有.zh: 这道菜有一种当地特有的香味，别的地方吃不到。
特有.en: This dish has a flavour unique to the area that you can't find anywhere else.

领带.zh: 他今天穿得很正式，还系了一条红领带。
领带.en: He's dressed very formally today, even wearing a red tie.

闹钟.zh: 他昨晚忘了定闹钟，结果上班迟到了。
闹钟.en: He forgot to set his alarm last night and was late for work.

熬夜@6.zh: 为了准备考试，他昨天熬夜到凌晨三点。
熬夜@6.en: To prepare for the exam, he stayed up until three in the morning last night.

折扣.zh: 这家店的折扣力度很大，很多衣服只要半价。
折扣.en: This shop's discounts are huge; lots of clothes are half price.

先后.zh: 这两位科学家先后获得了诺贝尔奖。
先后.en: These two scientists won the Nobel Prize one after the other.

气球.zh: 生日派对上，房间里挂满了五颜六色的气球。
气球.en: At the birthday party, the room was full of colourful balloons.

敢于.zh: 一个好的领导应该敢于承认自己的错误。
敢于.en: A good leader should have the courage to admit their own mistakes.

书房.zh: 他把家里最小的房间改成了书房，放满了书架。
书房.en: He turned the smallest room in the house into a study and filled it with bookshelves.

总数.zh: 统计显示，参加活动的人中女性占总数的六成。
总数.en: Figures show that women made up sixty percent of the total participants.

食用.zh: 牛奶开封后请放进冰箱，并在三天内食用。
食用.en: Once opened, keep the milk in the fridge and consume within three days.

大于.zh: 如果支出长期大于收入，家庭就会陷入困难。
大于.en: If spending exceeds income for a long time, the family will run into trouble.

中期.zh: 公司制订了一个五年的中期发展计划。
中期.en: The company has drawn up a five-year medium-term development plan.

里头.zh: 外面太冷了，快到里头来坐吧。
里头.en: It's too cold out there; come inside and sit down.

存放.zh: 酒店前台可以帮客人免费存放行李。
存放.en: The hotel front desk can keep guests' luggage for free.

科研.zh: 她是一名科研人员，每天都在实验室里做实验。
科研.en: She's a researcher who spends every day doing experiments in the lab.

高效.zh: 要想高效学习，首先要制订合理的计划。
高效.en: If you want to study efficiently, you first need a sensible plan.

虫子.zh: 夏天开着窗户，很容易有虫子飞进来。
虫子.en: If you leave the window open in summer, bugs fly in easily.

此前.zh: 警方表示，嫌疑人此前已有多次犯罪记录。
此前.en: Police said the suspect already had several previous criminal records.

词汇@6.zh: 这本书的词汇难度适合中级学生。
词汇@6.en: The vocabulary level of this book suits intermediate students.

大米.zh: 超市里的大米一袋十公斤，价格不贵。
大米.en: Rice at the supermarket comes in ten-kilo bags and isn't expensive.

失恋.zh: 失恋以后，他把所有时间都花在了工作上。
失恋.en: After the breakup, he poured all his time into work.

工艺.zh: 这家工厂采用新工艺以后，产品质量大大提高。
工艺.en: Since this factory adopted a new process, its product quality has greatly improved.

领取.zh: 快递已经到了，请凭取件码到驿站领取。
领取.en: Your parcel has arrived; please collect it at the pickup point with your pickup code.

外公@6.zh: 妈妈小时候，外公常常带她去河边钓鱼。
外公@6.en: When Mum was little, her father—my grandpa—often took her fishing by the river.

展出.zh: 这次画展一共展出了两百多幅作品。
展出.en: This art exhibition showed more than two hundred works in total.

路人.zh: 他迷路了，只好向路人打听回酒店怎么走。
路人.en: He got lost and had to ask passers-by how to get back to the hotel.

优质.zh: 公司始终坚持为客户提供优质的服务。
优质.en: The company has always been committed to providing customers with high-quality service.

拖鞋.zh: 夏天他总是穿着拖鞋去楼下买东西。
拖鞋.en: In summer he always pops downstairs to the shops in his flip-flops.

山区.zh: 山区交通不方便，孩子们上学要走很远的路。
山区.en: Transport in the mountains is poor, so children have to walk a long way to school.

好评.zh: 这家餐厅在网上的好评很多，周末总要排队。
好评.en: This restaurant has lots of good reviews online, so there's always a queue at weekends.

驾照.zh: 警察让司机出示驾照和行驶证。
驾照.en: The police officer asked the driver to show his driving licence and vehicle registration.

水分.zh: 运动出汗后，要及时补充身体流失的水分。
水分.en: After sweating from exercise, you should promptly replace the fluids your body has lost.

单一.zh: 孩子的饮食不能太单一，要注意营养均衡。
单一.en: Children's diets shouldn't be too monotonous; make sure their nutrition is balanced.

二手.zh: 毕业前，很多学生会把旧书拿到二手市场去卖。
二手.en: Before graduating, many students take their old books to the second-hand market to sell.

现代化.zh: 工厂引进新设备以后，基本实现了生产的现代化。
现代化.en: After bringing in new equipment, the factory has largely modernised its production.

优良.zh: 这里的水稻品种优良，产量比别处高出不少。
优良.en: The rice varieties here are excellent, and yields are much higher than elsewhere.

儿女.zh: 她有一双儿女，儿子十岁，女儿八岁。
儿女.en: She has a son and a daughter; the boy is ten and the girl is eight.

账号.zh: 他的游戏账号被人盗了，里面的装备全没了。
账号.en: His game account was hacked, and all his gear is gone.

住宿.zh: 学校为外地学生提供免费住宿。
住宿.en: The school offers free accommodation to students from out of town.

站台.zh: 他站在站台上，一直看着火车开远了才离开。
站台.en: He stood on the platform watching until the train was far away before he left.

跑道.zh: 每天傍晚，学校操场的跑道上都有很多人在跑步。
跑道.en: Every evening there are lots of people running on the track at the school sports ground.

创业.zh: 很多年轻人辞掉稳定的工作，回到家乡创业。
创业.en: Many young people quit stable jobs and go back to their hometowns to start businesses.

暴雨.zh: 气象台发布了暴雨预警，提醒市民尽量不要外出。
暴雨.en: The weather service issued a rainstorm warning, advising people to stay indoors if possible.

原有.zh: 在原有基础上，今年的产量又提高了百分之十。
原有.en: Building on what was already there, output rose by a further ten percent this year.

床单.zh: 孩子把牛奶洒在了床上，床单全湿了。
床单.en: The child spilled milk on the bed and the sheet got soaked.

试用.zh: 新员工要先试用三个月，表现好才能转正。
试用.en: New staff are on probation for three months and only become permanent if they do well.

雨水.zh: 他们在屋顶上装了设备，把雨水收集起来浇花。
雨水.en: They've put equipment on the roof to collect rainwater for watering the flowers.

旅行社.zh: 她在一家旅行社当导游，经常带团出国。
旅行社.en: She works as a tour guide for a travel agency and often takes groups abroad.

急诊@6.zh: 晚上门诊已经下班了，只能去挂急诊。
急诊@6.en: The outpatient clinic is closed at night, so you can only register at the emergency department.

柜子.zh: 衣服买得太多了，柜子已经装不下了。
柜子.en: I've bought so many clothes that the wardrobe can't hold them all.

沙子.zh: 刮了一天大风，窗台上落了厚厚一层沙子。
沙子.en: After a whole day of strong wind, a thick layer of sand had settled on the windowsill.

学科.zh: 这所大学的优势学科是计算机和医学。
学科.en: This university's strongest subjects are computer science and medicine.

产量.zh: 由于天气干旱，今年苹果的产量大大减少。
产量.en: Because of the drought, this year's apple harvest has fallen sharply.

请教.zh: 我有个问题想向您请教一下，不知道您现在方便吗？
请教.en: I have a question I'd like to ask your advice on — is now a good time?

昆虫@6.zh: 这个博物馆收集了上千种昆虫标本。
昆虫@6.en: This museum has collected specimens of over a thousand kinds of insects.

餐饮.zh: 受疫情影响，很多餐饮企业的收入大幅下降。
餐饮.en: Hit by the pandemic, many food and beverage businesses saw their income plunge.

舍得.zh: 这只小狗陪了他十年，他怎么舍得送人呢？
舍得.en: That dog has been with him for ten years; how could he bear to give it away?

大妈.zh: 这位大妈年轻时是个裁缝，她做的衣服可漂亮了。
大妈.en: This lady was a tailor when she was young, and the clothes she made were beautiful.

随手@6.zh: 用完的东西要随手放回原处。
随手@6.en: Put things back where they belong as soon as you've finished with them.

纪录片.zh: 他最近迷上了历史纪录片，每天晚上都看一集。
纪录片.en: He's hooked on history documentaries lately and watches an episode every night.

汗水.zh: 今天的成功是靠多年的汗水换来的。
汗水.en: Today's success was earned through years of hard work.

离职.zh: 离职之前，你得把手上的工作交接清楚。
离职.en: Before you leave the job, you need to hand over your work properly.

带动.zh: 在他的带动下，全班同学都爱上了跑步。
带动.en: Inspired by his example, the whole class came to love running.

城区.zh: 为了减少污染，大货车白天不能进入城区。
城区.en: To cut pollution, heavy lorries aren't allowed into the city during the day.

大批.zh: 工厂刚生产了一大批口罩，马上就要送往医院。
大批.en: The factory has just produced a large batch of masks that will be sent to hospitals right away.

正如.zh: 正如老师预料的那样，这道题很多同学都做错了。
正如.en: Just as the teacher expected, many students got this question wrong.

物业.zh: 小区的物业管理很好，到处都干干净净的。
物业.en: The property management in this housing estate is very good; everywhere is spotless.

制订.zh: 老师根据每个学生的情况，制订了不同的学习计划。
制订.en: Based on each student's situation, the teacher drew up a different study plan for each.

外观.zh: 这款手机外观设计简洁大方，很受年轻人喜欢。
外观.en: This phone's sleek, simple design is very popular with young people.

加深.zh: 这条河太浅，船过不去，得把河道加深一些。
加深.en: This river is too shallow for boats to get through; the channel needs to be deepened.

调研.zh: 推出新产品前，公司先做了大量的市场调研。
调研.en: Before launching the new product, the company did a lot of market research.

胆小.zh: 别看这只狗个子大，其实胆小得很，见了猫就跑。
胆小.en: This dog may be big, but it's a real coward; it runs away whenever it sees a cat.

影视.zh: 这座古城经常被用来拍摄影视作品。
影视.en: This ancient town is often used as a location for films and TV dramas.

超速.zh: 这条路限速六十公里，超速行驶非常危险。
超速.en: The speed limit on this road is sixty kilometres an hour; speeding is very dangerous.

国庆.zh: 今年国庆放七天假，我们打算回老家看看。
国庆.en: We get seven days off for National Day this year, so we plan to visit our hometown.

问卷.zh: 研究人员通过网上问卷调查了一千多名大学生。
问卷.en: The researchers surveyed more than a thousand university students with an online questionnaire.

增进.zh: 适当运动可以增进食欲，也能改善睡眠。
增进.en: Moderate exercise can boost your appetite and improve your sleep.

深远.zh: 孔子的思想对整个东亚文化都影响深远。
深远.en: Confucius's ideas have profoundly influenced the whole of East Asian culture.

音量.zh: 他戴着耳机，音量开得很大，连我叫他都没听见。
音量.en: He had his headphones on with the volume turned way up and didn't even hear me call him.

年夜饭.zh: 现在很多家庭选择在饭店订年夜饭，省得自己做。
年夜饭.en: Many families now book their New Year's Eve dinner at a restaurant to save cooking themselves.

深厚.zh: 这位老教授有着深厚的文学功底。
深厚.en: This old professor has a profound grounding in literature.

涨价.zh: 猪肉又涨价了，一斤比上个月贵了五块钱。
涨价.en: Pork has gone up again; it's five yuan more per jin than last month.

亲情.zh: 这部电影讲的是父女之间的亲情，很多观众都看哭了。
亲情.en: This film is about the love between a father and his daughter, and it moved many viewers to tears.

住址.zh: 快递员找不到地方，打电话来问我的详细住址。
住址.en: The courier couldn't find the place and called to ask for my exact address.

要不是.zh: 要不是路上堵车，我们早就到机场了。
要不是.en: If it weren't for the traffic, we'd have reached the airport long ago.

近日.zh: 警方近日破获了一起特大网络诈骗案。
近日.en: Police recently cracked a major online fraud case.

图画.zh: 这本书里有很多彩色图画，小朋友特别喜欢。
图画.en: This book has lots of colour pictures, and kids love it.

火锅.zh: 重庆的火锅以麻辣出名，很多外地人都吃不惯。
火锅.en: Chongqing hot pot is famous for being numbing and spicy, and many outsiders can't handle it.

书法.zh: 这家博物馆正在展出王羲之的书法作品。
书法.en: This museum is currently exhibiting calligraphy by Wang Xizhi.

小于.zh: 按照规定，重量小于五公斤的行李可以带上飞机。
小于.en: Under the rules, luggage weighing less than five kilos can be taken on board.

丰富多彩.zh: 退休以后，爷爷的生活过得丰富多彩，一点也不无聊。
丰富多彩.en: Since retiring, Grandpa has led a full and varied life and is never bored.

长处.zh: 我们应该多学习别人的长处，弥补自己的不足。
长处.en: We should learn from others' strengths to make up for our own shortcomings.

升温.zh: 随着比赛临近，两队之间的竞争不断升温。
升温.en: As the match draws near, the rivalry between the two teams keeps heating up.

时差@6.zh: 北京和伦敦有七八个小时的时差。
时差@6.en: There's a time difference of seven or eight hours between Beijing and London.

学分.zh: 他还差四个学分才能毕业，只好再读一个学期。
学分.en: He's still four credits short of graduating, so he has to study another term.

近年来.zh: 近年来，中国的高铁发展非常迅速。
近年来.en: China's high-speed rail has developed very rapidly in recent years.

开水@6.zh: 泡方便面要用开水，温水泡不开。
开水@6.en: Instant noodles need boiling water; warm water won't soften them.

响声.zh: 这扇门太旧了，一开就发出吱吱的响声。
响声.en: This door is so old it creaks whenever you open it.

押金@6.zh: 借自行车要交两百元押金，还车时退给你。
押金@6.en: To borrow a bike you pay a 200-yuan deposit, which is refunded when you return it.

物价.zh: 这座城市物价比较低，很适合退休养老。
物价.en: The cost of living in this city is fairly low, making it ideal for retirement.

台灯.zh: 书桌上的台灯坏了，屋里太暗，没法看书。
台灯.en: The lamp on the desk is broken, and the room is too dark to read in.

一路顺风.zh: 送朋友上火车时，我们挥着手祝他一路顺风。
一路顺风.en: Seeing our friend off at the train, we waved and wished him a safe journey.

宽度.zh: 这条小路的宽度只能让一辆车通过。
宽度.en: This lane is only wide enough for one car to get through.

普及.zh: 学校应该普及急救知识，让每个学生都学会心肺复苏。
普及.en: Schools should spread first-aid knowledge so that every student learns CPR.

亲朋好友.zh: 他搬新家的时候，请了很多亲朋好友来家里吃饭。
亲朋好友.en: When he moved into his new home, he invited lots of family and friends over for a meal.

厚度.zh: 湖面上的冰要达到一定的厚度，才能在上面滑冰。
厚度.en: The ice on the lake has to be thick enough before you can skate on it.

中医.zh: 她一直在吃中医开的药，现在身体好多了。
中医.en: She's been taking medicine prescribed by a Chinese medicine doctor and is much better now.

年初.zh: 他今年年初换了工作，现在收入比以前高多了。
年初.en: He changed jobs at the start of this year and now earns much more than before.

乘务员.zh: 列车上的乘务员正在检查每位乘客的车票。
乘务员.en: The train attendant is checking every passenger's ticket.

售价.zh: 这种包的成本不到一百元，售价却高达两千元。
售价.en: This bag costs less than a hundred yuan to make but sells for as much as two thousand.

吸管.zh: 小朋友用吸管喝果汁，一会儿就喝完了。
吸管.en: The little kid drank the juice through a straw and finished it in no time.

窗台.zh: 我家的猫最喜欢趴在窗台上晒太阳。
窗台.en: Our cat loves lying on the windowsill in the sun.

中外.zh: 这部电影是中外合拍的，演员来自五个国家。
中外.en: This film is a Chinese-foreign co-production, with actors from five countries.

学年.zh: 在中国，一个学年通常分为上下两个学期。
学年.en: In China, an academic year is usually divided into two semesters.

中级.zh: 她刚通过了中级会计师考试，下一步准备考高级。
中级.en: She's just passed the intermediate accountant exam and is now preparing for the senior level.

首次.zh: 这位歌手将于下个月首次来北京举办演唱会。
首次.en: The singer will hold a concert in Beijing for the first time next month.

豆浆.zh: 她每天早上自己磨豆浆，觉得比外面买的干净。
豆浆.en: She makes her own soy milk every morning; she thinks it's cleaner than shop-bought.

特产.zh: 哈密瓜是新疆的特产，又甜又脆。
特产.en: Hami melons are a Xinjiang specialty; they're sweet and crisp.

配送.zh: 网上订的家具由商家负责配送和安装。
配送.en: For furniture ordered online, the seller handles delivery and installation.

中华.zh: 这家中华老字号已经有三百多年的历史了。
中华.en: This time-honoured Chinese brand has a history of more than three hundred years.

中药.zh: 医生给他开了一个星期的中药，让他每天熬着喝。
中药.en: The doctor prescribed him a week of herbal medicine to boil and drink every day.

盒饭.zh: 火车上卖的盒饭又贵又不好吃。
盒饭.en: The boxed meals sold on the train are expensive and not very good.

国画.zh: 这位画家的国画作品在国外也很受欢迎。
国画.en: This artist's traditional Chinese paintings are very popular abroad as well.

保质期.zh: 这包饼干已经过了保质期，千万别吃了。
保质期.en: This packet of biscuits is past its best-before date; don't eat it.

话费.zh: 手机欠费停机了，我得赶紧去交话费。
话费.en: My phone's been cut off for non-payment; I need to pay the bill right away.

姥爷.zh: 放假的时候，我总爱去姥姥、姥爷家住几天。
姥爷.en: During the holidays I always love staying a few days with my grandma and grandpa.

省会.zh: 很多年轻人毕业后选择留在省会城市工作。
省会.en: Many young people choose to stay and work in the provincial capital after graduating.

高科技.zh: 现在种地也用上了高科技，用无人机就能给庄稼打药。
高科技.en: Farming now uses high technology too; drones can spray the crops.

读音.zh: 遇到不认识的字，可以查字典确认它的读音。
读音.en: When you come across a character you don't know, you can check its pronunciation in a dictionary.

五颜六色.zh: 节日的晚上，天空中绽放着五颜六色的烟花。
五颜六色.en: On the night of the festival, fireworks of every colour burst across the sky.

夜市.zh: 晚上八点以后，夜市上人来人往，特别热闹。
夜市.en: After eight in the evening, the night market is bustling with people.

用法.zh: 吃药之前，一定要仔细阅读说明书上的用法和用量。
用法.en: Before taking the medicine, be sure to read the directions and dosage on the leaflet carefully.

主食.zh: 减肥不等于不吃主食，关键是要控制好量。
主食.en: Losing weight doesn't mean giving up staple foods; the key is controlling portions.

跳高.zh: 他个子高，弹跳又好，教练让他专门练跳高。
跳高.en: He's tall and a great jumper, so the coach had him specialise in the high jump.

家电.zh: 国家出台了家电以旧换新的补贴政策。
家电.en: The government has introduced subsidies for trading in old household appliances for new ones.

压岁钱.zh: 妈妈帮我把压岁钱存进了银行。
压岁钱.en: Mum helped me put my New Year money in the bank.

西餐.zh: 他吃不惯西餐，总觉得牛排没有中国菜香。
西餐.en: He can't get used to Western food; he always feels steak isn't as tasty as Chinese dishes.

短处.zh: 他知道自己的短处是不善于表达，所以一直在努力改进。
短处.en: He knows his weakness is that he's not good at expressing himself, so he keeps working on it.

酸甜苦辣.zh: 这本书写的是一位老人一生的酸甜苦辣。
酸甜苦辣.en: This book tells of the joys and sorrows of an old man's life.

闭幕式.zh: 比赛最后一天的晚上将举行隆重的闭幕式。
闭幕式.en: A grand closing ceremony will be held on the evening of the last day of the games.

毛笔.zh: 学书法要先学会正确地握毛笔。
毛笔.en: When learning calligraphy, you first have to learn to hold the brush properly.

跳远.zh: 他助跑后用力一跳，跳远成绩达到了七米。
跳远.en: After a run-up he leapt with all his strength, reaching seven metres in the long jump.

没法儿.zh: 他说话声音太小，我根本没法儿听清楚。
没法儿.en: He speaks so quietly that I just can't hear him clearly.

电子版.zh: 请把合同的电子版发到我的邮箱。
电子版.en: Please send the electronic copy of the contract to my email.

便利店.zh: 加班到半夜，他只能去便利店买点吃的。
便利店.en: After working overtime until midnight, all he could do was grab something to eat at a convenience store.

二维码.zh: 请扫描屏幕上的二维码，关注我们的公众号。
二维码.en: Please scan the QR code on the screen to follow our official account.

安全带.zh: 飞机遇到气流颠簸时，乘客一定要系紧安全带。
安全带.en: When the plane hits turbulence, passengers must keep their seatbelts tightly fastened.

不符.zh: 他的说法与事实不符，警方决定继续调查。
不符.en: His account doesn't match the facts, so the police have decided to investigate further.

橙子.zh: 她把橙子切成四块，放在盘子里给客人吃。
橙子.en: She cut the orange into quarters and put them on a plate for the guests.

池.zh: 池里的荷花开了，引来不少人拍照。
池.en: The lotus flowers in the pond are in bloom, drawing plenty of people to take photos.

充值.zh: 他偷偷在游戏里充值了几千块钱，被父母狠狠骂了一顿。
充值.en: He secretly spent several thousand yuan topping up his game account and got a real telling-off from his parents.

点赞.zh: 大家纷纷为这位见义勇为的小伙子点赞。
点赞.en: People everywhere gave a thumbs-up to the young man who bravely stepped in to help.

电商.zh: 每年双十一，各大电商平台都会推出大量优惠。
电商.en: Every year on Singles' Day, all the major e-commerce platforms roll out huge deals.

发音.zh: 这个词你发音不对，再跟我读一遍。
发音.en: You're not pronouncing this word right; say it after me again.

非洲.zh: 他毕业后去非洲做了两年志愿者。
非洲.en: After graduating, he spent two years volunteering in Africa.

改天.zh: 这家店今天没开门，我们改天再来吧。
改天.en: The shop isn't open today; let's come back another day.

各行各业.zh: 互联网已经深入到各行各业，改变了人们的工作方式。
各行各业.en: The internet has reached into every industry and changed the way people work.

贵姓.zh: 先生，请问您贵姓？我帮您登记一下。
贵姓.en: Sir, may I have your surname? I'll register you.

降水.zh: 气象台预计，未来三天全省大部分地区将出现明显降水。
降水.en: The weather service forecasts significant rain or snow across most of the province over the next three days.

久远.zh: 年代太久远了，墙上的字已经看不清了。
久远.en: It's so old that the writing on the wall can no longer be made out.

客服.zh: 我打了好几次客服电话，一直都占线。
客服.en: I called the customer service line several times, but it was always busy.

派出所.zh: 办身份证要去户口所在地的派出所。
派出所.en: To get an ID card, you have to go to the police station where your household is registered.

拼音@6.zh: 这本儿童读物的每个汉字上面都标了拼音。
拼音@6.en: Every character in this children's book has its pinyin marked above it.

轻重.zh: 这孩子说话不知轻重，常常得罪人。
轻重.en: This kid has no sense of what's appropriate to say and often offends people.

人际.zh: 她性格内向，不太擅长人际交往。
人际.en: She's introverted and not very good at socialising.

商家.zh: 顾客收到的商品有质量问题，商家应该负责退换。
商家.en: If customers receive defective goods, the seller should be responsible for returns and exchanges.

上传.zh: 文件太大了，上传了半个小时还没完成。
上传.en: The file is so big that it's been uploading for half an hour and still isn't done.

生肖.zh: 中国有十二生肖，每个人都有自己的属相。
生肖.en: China has twelve zodiac animals, and everyone has their own sign.

省份.zh: 四川是中国人口较多的省份之一。
省份.en: Sichuan is one of the more populous provinces in China.

甜品.zh: 她特别爱吃甜品，蛋糕、冰淇淋都离不了。
甜品.en: She has a real sweet tooth and can't live without cake and ice cream.

退还.zh: 房子退租时，房东把押金全部退还给了我。
退还.en: When I moved out, the landlord returned my entire deposit.

相册.zh: 他的手机相册里存了上万张照片。
相册.en: He has tens of thousands of pictures saved in his phone's photo album.

雪糕.zh: 孩子一口气吃了三根雪糕，结果肚子疼了。
雪糕.en: The kid ate three ice lollies in a row and ended up with a stomach ache.

邮寄.zh: 录取通知书会通过快递邮寄到学生家里。
邮寄.en: Admission letters will be sent to students' homes by courier.

油条.zh: 这家早餐店的油条特别有名，每天早上都排长队。
油条.en: This breakfast shop's fried dough sticks are famous, and there's a long queue every morning.

语文.zh: 明天上午第一节是语文课，要背一首古诗。
语文.en: The first lesson tomorrow morning is Chinese, and we have to recite a classical poem.

运费.zh: 东西本身不贵，可是寄到国外的运费比商品还贵。
运费.en: The item itself isn't expensive, but shipping it abroad costs more than the goods.

职场.zh: 她在职场打拼了十年，终于当上了部门经理。
职场.en: She worked hard in the working world for ten years and finally became a department manager.

中.zh: 他买了十年彩票，今天终于中了一等奖。
中.en: He has bought lottery tickets for ten years, and today he finally won first prize.

该.zh: 这家公司去年推出了一款新手机，该产品上市三个月就卖出了一百万台。
该.en: The company launched a new phone last year; the product sold a million units within three months of going on sale.

所@6.zh: 这所大学有一百多年的历史，校园特别美。
所@6.en: This university is over a hundred years old, and its campus is especially beautiful.

成.zh: 调查显示，班里有七成的学生每天睡眠不足八小时。
成.en: A survey shows that 70% of the students in the class sleep less than eight hours a day.

啦.zh: 下雪啦！孩子们都跑到院子里去堆雪人了。
啦.en: It's snowing! The kids all ran into the yard to build a snowman.

于.zh: 他毕业于北京大学，现在在一家外企工作。
于.en: He graduated from Peking University and now works at a foreign company.

地方.zh: 你觉得这篇文章还有哪些地方需要修改？
地方.en: Which parts of this article do you think still need revising?

结果.zh: 这些葡萄树刚种下去，至少要等两年才能结果。
结果.en: These grapevines were just planted; it will take at least two years before they bear fruit.

求.zh: 遇到困难的时候，她宁可自己扛着，也不愿意开口求人。
求.en: When she runs into trouble, she would rather bear it herself than ask anyone for help.

转.zh: 风扇坏了，打开开关以后一点儿也不转。
转.en: The fan is broken; when you switch it on it doesn't turn at all.

杀@6.zh: 过年的时候，奶奶总要杀一只鸡给全家炖汤。
杀@6.en: At New Year, Grandma always kills a chicken to make soup for the whole family.

嘛.zh: 你要是累了就早点儿休息嘛，作业明天再写。
嘛.en: If you're tired, just go to bed early — you can do the homework tomorrow.

线.zh: 坐地铁二号线到终点站，再走五分钟就到了。
线.en: Take Metro Line 2 to the last stop, then walk five more minutes and you're there.

因.zh: 他因工作出色，被公司评为年度优秀员工。
因.en: Because of his outstanding work, he was named the company's employee of the year.

特.zh: 他这个人特爱面子，从来不肯当众认错。
特.en: He cares an awful lot about face and never admits he's wrong in public.

局.zh: 他在市公安局工作了二十多年，快要退休了。
局.en: He has worked at the city public security bureau for over twenty years and is about to retire.

未.zh: 该病毒的来源目前尚未查明，专家仍在调查中。
未.en: The source of the virus has not yet been identified, and experts are still investigating.

哇.zh: 哇，你一个人做了这么多菜，太厉害了！
哇.en: Wow, you cooked all these dishes by yourself — amazing!

神.zh: 这个魔术太神了，大家都猜不出他是怎么做到的。
神.en: That magic trick was amazing; nobody could figure out how he did it.

支@6.zh: 我们学校的这支足球队曾经得过全市冠军。
支@6.en: Our school's football team once won the city championship.

死亡.zh: 这场流感造成的死亡人数比去年少了很多。
死亡.en: The number of deaths from this flu was much lower than last year.

则@6.zh: 我今天在网上看到一则有趣的新闻。
则@6.en: I saw an interesting news item online today.

清.zh: 他花了整整五年，才把欠银行的钱还清。
清.en: It took him five full years to pay off what he owed the bank.

轮.zh: 排队排了一个多小时，终于轮到我了。
轮.en: After queuing for over an hour, it was finally my turn.

投票.zh: 观众可以通过手机为自己喜欢的歌手投票。
投票.en: Viewers can vote for their favourite singer on their phones.

逼.zh: 要不是被生活所逼，他也不会一个人跑到外地打工。
逼.en: If life hadn't forced him, he wouldn't have gone off alone to work in another city.

待.zh: 这次出差我在上海只待了两天，没时间去玩儿。
待.en: On this business trip I only stayed in Shanghai for two days and had no time for sightseeing.

尽.zh: 这件事我会尽力去办，但不能保证一定成功。
尽.en: I'll do my best with this, but I can't guarantee it will succeed.

投资@6.zh: 很多年轻人开始学习如何理财和投资。
投资@6.en: Many young people are starting to learn how to manage money and invest.

战争@6.zh: 这部电影讲的是一个家庭在战争中失散又重逢的故事。
战争@6.en: This film tells the story of a family separated during the war and later reunited.

冲@6.zh: 早上起来，他先给自己冲了一杯咖啡。
冲@6.en: When he gets up in the morning, he first makes himself a cup of coffee.

盘.zh: 爷爷吃完晚饭，总要拉着邻居下两盘象棋。
盘.en: After dinner, Grandpa always drags the neighbor into a couple of games of Chinese chess.

皮.zh: 这件皮夹克质量很好，穿了五六年还跟新的一样。
皮.en: This leather jacket is great quality; after five or six years it still looks new.

枪@6.zh: 小时候，他最喜欢的玩具是一把水枪。
枪@6.en: As a child, his favorite toy was a water gun.

落.zh: 他生病请了一个月假，功课落下了不少，得抓紧补。
落.en: He was off sick for a month and fell well behind in his schoolwork, so he has to hurry to catch up.

呆@6.zh: 周末他在家里呆了两天，哪儿也没去。
呆@6.en: At the weekend he stayed at home for two days and didn't go anywhere.

网.zh: 酒店房间里上不了网，我只好去楼下大厅。
网.en: I couldn't get online in my hotel room, so I had to go down to the lobby.

雷@6.zh: 雷声太大了，把睡着的孩子吵醒了。
雷@6.en: The thunder was so loud that it woke the sleeping child.

武器.zh: 博物馆里展出了很多古代士兵使用过的武器。
武器.en: The museum displays many weapons once used by ancient soldiers.

圈@6.zh: 他每天晚上都绕着操场跑十圈。
圈@6.en: Every evening he runs ten laps around the sports field.

招.zh: 夏天晚上开着灯不关窗户，很容易招蚊子。
招.en: On summer nights, if you leave the light on with the window open, you easily attract mosquitoes.

科.zh: 这次期末考试我有一科没及格，暑假还得补考。
科.en: I failed one subject in the final exams, so I have to retake it over the summer.

版.zh: 这条新闻登在今天报纸的第一版上。
版.en: This news story is on the front page of today's paper.

英雄@6.zh: 在孩子的眼里，爸爸就是一个英雄。
英雄@6.en: In a child's eyes, Dad is a hero.

攻击.zh: 他在会上公开攻击同事的方案，让大家都很不舒服。
攻击.en: He openly attacked his colleague's proposal at the meeting, which made everyone uncomfortable.

镇.zh: 从县城坐车到镇上要一个多小时。
镇.en: It takes over an hour by bus from the county seat to the town.

俱乐部@6.zh: 我们学校有一个英语俱乐部，每周三活动一次。
俱乐部@6.en: Our school has an English club that meets every Wednesday.

顶@6.zh: 我们爬了三个小时，终于到达了山顶。
顶@6.en: We climbed for three hours and finally reached the top of the mountain.

自我.zh: 年轻人应该多出去走走，在不同的经历中认识自我。
自我.en: Young people should get out more and discover themselves through different experiences.

犯.zh: 酒后开车是犯法的，千万不要抱侥幸心理。
犯.en: Drink-driving is against the law; never think you'll get away with it.

服.zh: 你说得这么有道理，我不得不服你。
服.en: What you said makes so much sense that I have to hand it to you.

布@6.zh: 她用一块旧布把桌子擦干净了。
布@6.en: She wiped the table clean with an old piece of cloth.

样.zh: 这次去超市只买了三样东西，却花了两百多块。
样.en: I only bought three things at the supermarket this time, yet spent over two hundred yuan.

理.zh: 我叫了他好几声，他都不理我，可能还在生气吧。
理.en: I called him several times but he ignored me; he's probably still angry.

恨@6.zh: 他很恨那个骗了他很多钱的朋友。
恨@6.en: He really hates the friend who cheated him out of a lot of money.

射.zh: 他拉开弓，一箭射向远处的目标。
射.en: He drew the bow and shot an arrow at the distant target.

时尚@6.zh: 这家店的衣服又便宜又时尚。
时尚@6.en: The clothes in this shop are both cheap and fashionable.

剑.zh: 这位武术老师能同时舞两把剑。
剑.en: This martial arts teacher can wield two swords at once.

和平@6.zh: 鸽子常常被看作和平的象征。
和平@6.en: The dove is often seen as a symbol of peace.

爆炸.zh: 厨房里的煤气罐突然爆炸，幸好没有人受伤。
爆炸.en: The gas canister in the kitchen suddenly exploded; luckily no one was hurt.

偷@6.zh: 弟弟趁我不在，偷吃了冰箱里的蛋糕。
偷@6.en: While I was out, my little brother secretly ate the cake in the fridge.

基地.zh: 科学家们在南极建立了一个科学考察基地。
基地.en: Scientists set up a research base in Antarctica.

黄.zh: 开车遇到黄灯时，最好慢慢停下来，别抢着过去。
黄.en: When you meet a yellow light while driving, it's best to slow to a stop rather than rush through.

岛.zh: 台风来临前，岛上的游客都被安排离开了。
岛.en: Before the typhoon arrived, all the tourists on the island were evacuated.

战斗.zh: 这些消防员和大火战斗了整整一夜。
战斗.en: These firefighters battled the blaze all night long.

官@6.zh: 他从小就想当一名外交官。
官@6.en: Ever since he was little, he has wanted to be a diplomat.

公开@6.zh: 他们俩谈恋爱的事还没有公开。
公开@6.en: They haven't made their relationship public yet.

混.zh: 他上班从来不认真，每天就是混日子。
混.en: He never takes his job seriously and just drifts through each day.

人家.zh: 人家等了你一个小时，你怎么才来呀！
人家.en: I've been waiting a whole hour for you — why are you only getting here now!

摆@6.zh: 她把照片整齐地摆在书架上。
摆@6.en: She arranged the photos neatly on the bookshelf.

吓@6.zh: 那部电影太恐怖了，把孩子吓哭了。
吓@6.en: That film was so scary that it frightened the child to tears.

升@6.zh: 他工作努力，今年升为部门经理了。
升@6.en: He works hard and was promoted to department manager this year.

军队.zh: 地震发生后，军队很快赶到灾区参加救援。
军队.en: After the earthquake, the army quickly arrived in the disaster area to help with the rescue.

基金.zh: 他每个月都会拿出一部分工资买基金。
基金.en: Every month he puts part of his salary into investment funds.

编.zh: 你别再编故事骗我了，我已经知道真相了。
编.en: Stop making up stories to fool me; I already know the truth.

学会.zh: 这次国际研讨会由本市的心理学会主办。
学会.en: This international symposium is hosted by the city's psychological society.

部队.zh: 他十八岁就到部队当兵，一干就是二十年。
部队.en: He joined the army at eighteen and served for twenty years.

可怜.zh: 我不需要别人可怜我，我只想要一个公平的机会。
可怜.en: I don't need anyone's pity; I just want a fair chance.

为何.zh: 记者问这位官员：“房价为何一涨再涨？”
为何.en: The reporter asked the official: Why do housing prices keep rising?

爆.zh: 车子开到一半，前面的轮胎突然爆了。
爆.en: Halfway through the drive, the front tire suddenly blew out.

毒.zh: 山里有些蛇有剧毒，被咬了要马上去医院。
毒.en: Some snakes in the mountains are highly venomous; if bitten, go to hospital immediately.

吐@6.zh: 他晕车很厉害，一上车就想吐。
吐@6.en: He gets badly carsick and feels like throwing up as soon as he gets in.

中央.zh: 小狗躺在客厅中央的地毯上睡觉。
中央.en: The puppy is asleep on the rug in the middle of the living room.

州.zh: 这家公司的总部设在美国得克萨斯州。
州.en: The company's headquarters are in the US state of Texas.

解.zh: 这道数学题我想了一晚上，还是解不出来。
解.en: I thought about this math problem all evening and still couldn't solve it.

罪.zh: 法院最后判定他无罪，当庭释放。
罪.en: The court finally found him not guilty and released him on the spot.

显著.zh: 经过一年的治理，这条河的水质有了显著的改善。
显著.en: After a year of clean-up work, the river's water quality has improved markedly.

承诺.zh: 他向女朋友承诺，结婚以后一定戒烟。
承诺.en: He promised his girlfriend that he would definitely quit smoking after they married.

感染.zh: 伤口要及时清洗，否则很容易感染。
感染.en: A wound must be cleaned promptly, otherwise it easily gets infected.

启动.zh: 这个城市的新地铁项目将于明年正式启动。
启动.en: The city's new metro project will officially launch next year.

一一.zh: 会议结束后，他和到场的客人一一握手告别。
一一.en: After the meeting, he shook hands and said goodbye to each of the guests in turn.

算是.zh: 在这个城市住了十年，我也算是半个本地人了。
算是.en: After living in this city for ten years, I can more or less call myself half a local.

滴@6.zh: 水龙头没关好，一直在滴水。
滴@6.en: The tap wasn't turned off properly and keeps dripping.

逃@6.en: After the fire broke out, everyone in the building escaped safely.

婚姻@6.zh: 她认为婚姻需要两个人共同经营。
婚姻@6.en: She believes a marriage needs both people to work at it together.

打击.zh: 警方加大力度打击网络诈骗。
打击.en: The police are stepping up their crackdown on online fraud.

转移.zh: 公司决定把工厂转移到劳动力更便宜的地区。
转移.en: The company decided to move its factory to a region with cheaper labour.

印.zh: 雪地上留下了一串小动物的脚印。
印.en: A trail of small animal footprints was left in the snow.

卷.en: He rolled up his sleeves and started helping Mum wash the dishes.

透.zh: 阳光透过窗帘照进房间，屋里一下子亮了。
透.en: Sunlight came through the curtains, and the room suddenly brightened.

酷.zh: 哇，你这双新球鞋真酷，在哪儿买的？
酷.en: Wow, your new sneakers are so cool, where did you buy them?

人士.zh: 这次活动邀请了不少社会知名人士。
人士.en: This event invited quite a few well-known public figures.

拖.zh: 这件事已经拖了半年了，不能再等下去了。
拖.en: This matter has been put off for half a year already; we can't wait any longer.

集团.zh: 这家集团旗下有酒店、商场和电影院。
集团.en: This conglomerate owns hotels, shopping malls and cinemas.

为止.zh: 盐要慢慢加，一直加到你觉得味道合适为止。
为止.en: Add the salt slowly, until it tastes right to you.

进展.zh: 警方对这起案子的调查有了新的进展。
进展.en: There has been new progress in the police investigation of this case.

塞.zh: 临走时，妈妈又往我手里塞了两百块钱。
塞.en: Just as I was leaving, Mom pressed another two hundred yuan into my hand.

系列.zh: 这个系列的童话书一共有十二本。
系列.en: This series of fairy-tale books has twelve volumes in total.

检测.zh: 新房装修完以后，最好请专业人员来检测一下空气质量。
检测.en: After renovating a new home, it's best to have professionals test the air quality.

塔.zh: 这座古塔已经有一千多年的历史了。
塔.en: This ancient pagoda is more than a thousand years old.

真相.zh: 经过一个月的调查，记者终于揭开了食品安全问题背后的真相。
真相.en: After a month of investigation, the journalist finally revealed the truth behind the food safety problem.

搭.zh: 孩子们用积木搭了一座漂亮的城堡。
搭.en: The children built a beautiful castle out of building blocks.

病毒@6.zh: 流感病毒在冬天特别容易传播。
病毒@6.en: The flu virus spreads especially easily in winter.

权力@6.en: He's the boss of the company and holds a lot of power.

夫人.zh: 晚宴上，大使和他的夫人一起向客人们敬酒。
夫人.en: At the banquet, the ambassador and his wife toasted the guests together.

毫无.zh: 他第一次上台演讲，却毫无紧张的感觉。
毫无.en: It was his first time giving a speech on stage, yet he felt no nervousness at all.

制.zh: 这家工厂专门制药，产品主要出口欧洲。
制.en: This factory specializes in making medicines, mostly exported to Europe.

泡.zh: 走了一天路，晚上用热水泡脚特别舒服。
泡.en: After walking all day, soaking your feet in hot water in the evening feels wonderful.

户.zh: 这个村子只有一百来户，大部分年轻人都去城里打工了。
户.en: This village has only about a hundred households; most of the young people have gone to work in the city.

归.zh: 家里的事你别管，做饭洗碗归我，你只管好好学习。
归.en: Don't worry about the housework; cooking and washing up are my job, you just focus on studying.

胸@6.zh: 她把孩子紧紧地抱在胸前。
胸@6.en: She held the child tightly to her chest.

嫁@6.zh: 她把女儿嫁到了很远的地方。
嫁@6.en: She married her daughter off to someone in a faraway place.

命令@6.zh: 听到教练的命令，队员们马上停止了训练。
命令@6.en: Hearing the coach's order, the players stopped training at once.

政策.zh: 政府出台了新的住房政策，帮助年轻人买房。
政策.en: The government introduced a new housing policy to help young people buy homes.

神经.en: Have you gone mad? Going out in short sleeves in the dead of winter!

一辈子@6.zh: 爷爷一辈子都住在这个小村子里。
一辈子@6.en: Grandpa has lived in this little village all his life.

士兵@6.zh: 士兵们冒着大雨，帮助村民把粮食搬到高处。
士兵@6.en: The soldiers braved the heavy rain to help villagers move their grain to higher ground.

母.zh: 这只母猫刚生了四只小猫，正在窝里喂奶呢。
母.en: This mother cat just had four kittens and is nursing them in the nest.

评论.zh: 这位专家经常在电视上评论经济新闻。
评论.en: This expert often comments on economic news on television.

仪式.zh: 新校长的就职仪式在学校礼堂举行。
仪式.en: The new principal's inauguration ceremony was held in the school auditorium.

冒.zh: 消防员冒着生命危险冲进了火里。
冒.en: The firefighters risked their lives and rushed into the fire.

烂@6.zh: 这双鞋穿了五年，已经穿烂了。
烂@6.en: I've worn these shoes for five years, and they're worn out.

除.zh: 老师让我们算一下一百除以四等于多少。
除.en: The teacher asked us to work out what one hundred divided by four is.

本身.zh: 这种水果本身没什么味道，但做成果汁很好喝。
本身.en: This fruit has little flavour on its own, but it makes delicious juice.

端.zh: 妈妈端着一盘刚出锅的饺子走进客厅。
端.en: Mum walked into the living room carrying a plate of freshly cooked dumplings.

时光.zh: 退休以后，他和老伴一起度过了一段悠闲的时光。
时光.en: After retiring, he and his wife spent a leisurely time together.
