扣.en: It's so cold — button up your coat before you go out.

狼.zh: 小时候奶奶常给我讲小羊和大灰狼的故事。
狼.en: When I was little, Grandma often told me the story of the little lamb and the big bad wolf.

道德@6.zh: 做生意也要讲道德，不能欺骗顾客。
道德@6.en: Doing business also requires ethics; you can't cheat customers.

编辑@6.zh: 这本词典是由十几位专家共同编辑的。
编辑@6.en: This dictionary was compiled jointly by more than a dozen experts.

挖.zh: 考古学家在这里挖出了一批两千年前的文物。
挖.en: Archaeologists dug up a batch of 2,000-year-old relics here.

证实.zh: 警方已经证实，那名失踪的游客找到了。
证实.en: The police have confirmed that the missing tourist has been found.

要么.zh: 坐公交太慢了，要么我们打个车吧？
要么.en: The bus is too slow; how about we take a taxi instead?

恶心.zh: 垃圾桶好几天没人倒，发出一股让人恶心的味道。
恶心.en: No one emptied the bin for days, and it gave off a disgusting smell.

将军.zh: 下棋的时候，他突然喊了一声“将军”，我才发现自己输了。
将军.en: While we were playing chess, he suddenly called out "check", and only then did I realise I had lost.

透露.zh: 她悄悄向我透露，下个月就要结婚了。
透露.en: She quietly let slip to me that she is getting married next month.

兵.zh: 古代打仗时，哪一方的兵多，哪一方就占优势。
兵.en: In ancient warfare, whichever side had more soldiers had the advantage.

侧.zh: 车厢里人太多，我只能侧着身子挤过去。
侧.en: The carriage was so crowded that I had to squeeze through sideways.

闭.zh: 这家博物馆每周一闭馆，参观前请看好时间。
闭.en: This museum is closed every Monday, so please check the times before visiting.

异常.zh: 如果发现账户有异常情况，请马上联系银行。
异常.en: If you notice anything unusual with your account, please contact the bank immediately.

粉.zh: 小女孩穿着一条粉色的连衣裙，看起来特别可爱。
粉.en: The little girl is wearing a pink dress and looks really cute.

足.zh: 这个箱子足有五十斤重，我一个人根本搬不动。
足.en: This box weighs a good 25 kilos; I can't possibly move it by myself.

曲.zh: 这首歌的词是他写的，曲是他妹妹谱的。
曲.en: He wrote the lyrics of this song, and his sister composed the music.

档案.zh: 医院为每位病人都建立了电子健康档案。
档案.en: The hospital has set up an electronic health record for every patient.

协会.zh: 买到假货后，他向消费者协会投诉了这家商店。
协会.en: After buying a fake, he complained about the shop to the Consumers' Association.

公.zh: 这些钱是公款，谁也不能私自动用。
公.en: This money is public funds; nobody may use it privately.

细胞.zh: 研究发现，这种新药能有效杀死癌细胞。
细胞.en: Research has found that this new drug can effectively kill cancer cells.

症状.zh: 如果出现发烧的症状，请马上去医院。
症状.en: If you develop symptoms such as a fever, go to the hospital straight away.

试图.zh: 小猫试图跳上书架，结果把花瓶碰倒了。
试图.en: The kitten tried to jump onto the bookshelf and knocked the vase over.

患者.zh: 这种药适合有高血压的患者服用。
患者.en: This medicine is suitable for patients with high blood pressure.

艘.zh: 一艘渔船在暴风雨中失去了联系。
艘.en: A fishing boat lost contact during the storm.

财产@6.zh: 火灾中，他们失去了大部分财产。
财产@6.en: They lost most of their property in the fire.

银@6.zh: 奶奶送给我一个银手镯，说是传了好几代的。
银@6.en: Grandma gave me a silver bracelet that she said had been handed down for generations.

刺.zh: 吃鱼的时候要小心，别让鱼刺卡在喉咙里。
刺.en: Be careful when eating fish so that a bone doesn't get stuck in your throat.

至于@6.zh: 我们周六去爬山，至于几点出发，明天再定。
至于@6.en: We're going hiking on Saturday; as for what time we leave, we'll decide tomorrow.

肥.zh: 春天到了，农民们忙着给庄稼施肥。
肥.en: Spring has arrived, and the farmers are busy fertilizing their crops.

患.zh: 研究表明，长期睡眠不足的人更容易患抑郁症。
患.en: Research shows that people who are chronically short of sleep are more likely to suffer from depression.

镜头.zh: 摄影师换了一个新镜头，拍出来的照片清楚多了。
镜头.en: The photographer switched to a new lens, and his photos came out much sharper.

贷款@6.zh: 她申请了一笔贷款，用来支付大学学费。
贷款@6.en: She applied for a loan to pay her university tuition.

凌晨.zh: 我们凌晨四点就出发去山顶看日出。
凌晨.en: We set off at four in the morning to watch the sunrise from the summit.

害.zh: 都怪你没提醒我，害我白跑了一趟。
害.en: It's your fault for not reminding me; you made me go all that way for nothing.

淘汰.zh: 这种老式手机早就被市场淘汰了。
淘汰.en: This kind of old-style phone was phased out by the market long ago.

立.zh: 他在战场上立过大功，回国后受到了表彰。
立.en: He performed great deeds on the battlefield and was honored when he returned home.

料.zh: 谁也没料到，这场比赛最后竟然是他们赢了。
料.en: Nobody expected that they would end up winning the match.

公众.zh: 作为公众人物，他的一言一行都会受到大家关注。
公众.en: As a public figure, his every word and deed attracts attention.

释放.zh: 植物在白天吸收二氧化碳，释放氧气。
释放.en: During the day, plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.

撒.en: The farmer scattered the seeds evenly over the field.

心脏@6.en: Exercise can make your heart healthier, but be careful not to overdo it.

斗争.zh: 这位老人一生都在和贫穷作斗争。
斗争.en: This old man struggled against poverty all his life.

给予.zh: 政府给予这些贫困家庭一定的补助。
给予.en: The government gives these poor families a certain amount of subsidy.

指挥@6.en: Under the teacher's direction, the students quickly lined up.

突破.zh: 这位运动员突破了自己保持的世界纪录。
突破.en: This athlete broke the world record that she herself held.

露.en: He was so nervous that he gave himself away the moment he opened his mouth.

为此.en: The company's sales dropped sharply this year, and the boss held a special meeting about it.

回头.en: I'm a bit busy right now; I'll call you back later.

法官.en: Since childhood he has dreamed of becoming a judge and upholding social justice.

嘿.en: Hey, sir in the red shirt up ahead, you forgot your umbrella!

股票@6.en: The stock market has been unstable lately, so be careful when investing.

脑袋@6.zh: 这道题太难了，我想得脑袋都疼了。
脑袋@6.en: This problem is so hard that thinking about it has given me a headache.

血液.zh: 适当运动可以促进血液循环，对身体有好处。
血液.en: Moderate exercise improves blood circulation and is good for your health.

主管.zh: 她刚升为销售主管，手下有十几个人。
主管.en: She has just been promoted to sales supervisor, with more than ten people under her.

动力.zh: 这艘游船完全靠太阳能提供动力。
动力.en: This tour boat is powered entirely by solar energy.

祝福@6.zh: 在婚礼上，大家纷纷向新郎新娘表达了祝福。
祝福@6.en: At the wedding, everyone in turn offered their good wishes to the bride and groom.

公主@6.en: On her birthday, my daughter put on a pretty princess dress.

松.zh: 考试终于结束了，大家都松了一口气。
松.en: The exams are finally over, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

埋.zh: 地震发生时，有十几个人被埋在了倒塌的房子下面。
埋.en: When the earthquake struck, more than ten people were buried under collapsed houses.

率.zh: 今年大学生的就业率比去年略有提高。
率.en: This year's employment rate for university graduates is slightly higher than last year's.

能量.zh: 巧克力含有很高的能量，适合登山时吃。
能量.en: Chocolate is high in energy, which makes it good to eat when climbing mountains.

野.zh: 山里经常有野猪跑出来，把庄稼都吃光了。
野.en: Wild boars often come out of the mountains and eat up all the crops.

清理.en: After class, the students take turns clearing the rubbish out of the classroom.

激情.zh: 这位老教授讲课很有激情，学生们都听得入迷。
激情.en: This old professor lectures with great passion, and his students listen spellbound.

从未.zh: 他在这家公司工作了十年，从未迟到过一次。
从未.en: He has worked at this company for ten years and has never once been late.

谈判@6.zh: 经过三天的谈判，买卖双方终于在价格上达成了一致。
谈判@6.en: After three days of negotiation, the buyer and seller finally agreed on a price.

成交.zh: 这套房子挂牌一周就以三百万元成交了。
成交.en: This flat sold for three million yuan just a week after it was listed.

业.zh: 近几年，网上购物的兴起带动了快递业的发展。
业.en: In recent years, the rise of online shopping has driven the growth of the courier industry.

造型.zh: 她今天换了一个新发型，整个造型显得年轻多了。
造型.en: She got a new hairstyle today, and her whole look seems much younger.

补.en: My sock had a hole in it, and Grandma mended it for me.

装备.zh: 这所学校的实验室装备了最先进的仪器。
装备.en: This school's laboratory is equipped with the most advanced instruments.

障碍.zh: 这栋楼专门为坐轮椅的人设计了无障碍通道。
障碍.en: This building has a barrier-free entrance designed especially for wheelchair users.

自杀.zh: 小说的结尾，主人公因为绝望而选择了自杀。
自杀.en: At the end of the novel, the protagonist takes his own life out of despair.

危机.zh: 这次能源危机让油价涨了一倍。
危机.en: This energy crisis doubled the price of oil.

公民.zh: 依法纳税是每个公民应尽的义务。
公民.en: Paying taxes according to the law is the duty of every citizen.

当初.zh: 当初我们刚认识的时候，谁也没想到会结婚。
当初.en: Back when we first met, neither of us imagined we would get married.

线索.zh: 警察根据监控录像中的线索很快找到了丢失的汽车。
线索.en: Using clues from the surveillance footage, the police quickly found the missing car.

引.zh: 这件红色的裙子在人群中特别引人注目。
引.en: This red dress really catches the eye in a crowd.

金属@6.zh: 这种金属很轻，常常被用来做飞机的零件。
金属@6.en: This metal is very light and is often used to make aircraft parts.

闪.zh: 一辆车冲了过来，他赶紧往旁边一闪，才没被撞到。
闪.en: A car came rushing at him; he quickly dodged aside and just avoided being hit.

石油.zh: 很多塑料产品都是用石油做成的。
石油.en: Many plastic products are made from petroleum.

频道@6.zh: 孩子们最喜欢看少儿频道播放的动画片。
频道@6.en: The children love watching the cartoons shown on the kids' channel.

散.zh: 风一吹，天上的乌云很快就散了。
散.en: As soon as the wind blew, the dark clouds quickly dispersed.

警告.zh: 管理员警告我们，湖面上的冰太薄，千万不能上去。
警告.en: The keeper warned us that the ice on the lake was too thin and we must not go on it.

乘.zh: 请你算一下，十二乘以八是多少？
乘.en: Could you work out what twelve times eight is?

基因.zh: 科学家发现，长寿和某些基因有关。
基因.en: Scientists have found that a long life is linked to certain genes.

晕@6.zh: 他坐船的时候总是头晕，所以很少出海。
晕@6.en: He always feels dizzy on boats, so he rarely goes out to sea.

就算.zh: 这件事就算你不说，我早晚也会知道的。
就算.en: Even if you don't tell me, I'll find out sooner or later.

革命.en: The invention of the steam engine triggered the first Industrial Revolution.

孤独.en: The old man's children all work in other cities; he lives alone and often feels lonely.

针.en: As soon as the child heard he needed a shot, he burst into tears in fright.

官员.en: Government officials from the two countries held talks in Beijing yesterday.

暴力.zh: 这部动画片里没有任何暴力内容，适合小朋友看。
暴力.en: This cartoon contains no violent content at all and is suitable for young children.

原本.en: This was originally wasteland; now it has become a big park.

核心@6.en: This company has mastered the core technology, so it has grown quickly.

通讯.en: I saved his number in my phone's contacts.

隐藏.zh: 这个看起来很普通的软件里，竟然隐藏着一个病毒。
隐藏.en: This ordinary-looking piece of software actually had a virus hidden inside it.

落后@6.zh: 他生病请了两周假，学习成绩落后了不少。
落后@6.en: He took two weeks off sick, and his grades fell quite a way behind.

算了.zh: 太晚了，今天就算了吧，我们明天再接着干。
算了.en: It's too late; let's call it a day and carry on tomorrow.

狠.zh: 她狠下心来，把一直舍不得扔的旧东西全都处理掉了。
狠.en: She steeled herself and got rid of all the old things she had never been able to throw away.

策划.zh: 她花了一个月精心策划了这次生日惊喜。
策划.en: She spent a month carefully planning this birthday surprise.

蹲@6.zh: 孩子们蹲在路边，认真地看着地上的蚂蚁。
蹲@6.en: The children squatted by the roadside, watching the ants on the ground intently.

冒险@6.zh: 她喜欢冒险，一个人去过很多偏远的地方。
冒险@6.en: She loves adventure and has been to many remote places on her own.

牵.zh: 过马路的时候，妈妈总是牵着我的手。
牵.en: When we cross the road, Mum always holds my hand.

冲动.zh: 看到打折广告，她一冲动就买了三双鞋。
冲动.en: Seeing the sale advert, she bought three pairs of shoes on impulse.

考验.zh: 长途旅行是对两个人感情的考验。
考验.en: A long journey is a test of a couple's relationship.

技巧.zh: 打篮球不光要有力气，还要讲究技巧。
技巧.en: Playing basketball takes not only strength but also technique.

天下.zh: 古代很多皇帝都梦想着统一天下。
天下.en: In ancient times, many emperors dreamed of unifying the whole realm.

公正.zh: 评委们公正地给每位选手打分。
公正.en: The judges scored every contestant fairly.

和谐.zh: 这幅画的颜色搭配得很和谐，看起来很舒服。
和谐.en: The colours in this painting go together harmoniously and are pleasant to look at.

高手.zh: 这次比赛高手如云，能进前十就很不错了。
高手.en: This competition is full of top players; making the top ten would be great.

呈现.zh: 这份报告用图表把数据清楚地呈现了出来。
呈现.en: This report presents the data clearly using charts.

暖.zh: 他把冰凉的双手放在火炉边暖了一会儿。
暖.en: He held his icy hands by the stove for a while to warm them.

规划.zh: 这座城市的规划很合理，道路宽阔，绿地很多。
规划.en: This city is well planned, with wide roads and plenty of green space.

不许.zh: 图书馆里不许大声说话，也不能吃东西。
不许.en: In the library you may not talk loudly, and eating is not allowed either.

不止.zh: 参加这次比赛的选手不止一百人。
不止.en: There are more than a hundred contestants taking part in this competition.

录像.zh: 警察调出了商店门口的监控录像，很快找到了小偷。
录像.en: The police pulled the surveillance footage from outside the shop and quickly found the thief.

免.zh: 客气话就免了吧，咱们都是老朋友了。
免.en: Let's skip the pleasantries; we're old friends.

转身.zh: 我刚想跟她打招呼，她就转身离开了。
转身.en: I was just about to say hello, but she turned around and left.

赔偿@6.zh: 我不小心打破了商店的花瓶，只好照价赔偿。
赔偿@6.en: I accidentally broke a vase in the shop, so I had to pay for it at full price.

混合.zh: 雨后的空气里混合着花香和泥土的味道。
混合.en: After the rain, the air carries a mix of floral scent and the smell of earth.

会见.zh: 总经理明天上午要会见几位重要的客户。
会见.en: The general manager will meet several important clients tomorrow morning.

代理.zh: 这家公司是那个外国品牌在中国的独家代理。
代理.en: This company is the exclusive agent of that foreign brand in China.

明明.zh: 他明明已经吃饱了，却还说自己饿。
明明.en: He has obviously already eaten his fill, yet he still says he is hungry.

群众.zh: 这个公园建成以后，深受附近群众的欢迎。
群众.en: Since this park was completed, it has been very popular with local people.

投诉.zh: 邻居家深夜还在唱歌，他忍不住打电话向物业投诉。
投诉.en: The neighbours were still singing late at night, so he couldn't help calling property management to complain.

无疑.zh: 对一个刚毕业的学生来说，这份工作无疑是个难得的机会。
无疑.en: For a fresh graduate, this job is without doubt a rare opportunity.

按摩.zh: 奶奶腰疼，我每天晚上帮她按摩一会儿。
按摩.en: Grandma has a sore back, so I give it a massage for a while every evening.

倾向.zh: 最近年轻人有晚婚的倾向。
倾向.en: Recently, young people have shown a tendency to marry later.

实话@6.zh: 面试的时候不知道答案，就实话实说，不要乱编。
实话@6.en: If you don't know the answer in an interview, just tell the truth; don't make things up.

救命.zh: 你真是我的救命恩人，要不是你，我早就没命了。
救命.en: You're truly the one who saved my life; if not for you, I'd be dead.

无所谓@6.zh: 输赢无所谓，重要的是大家玩得开心。
无所谓@6.en: Winning or losing doesn't matter; what matters is that everyone has fun.

老鼠@6.zh: 猫和老鼠的动画片我小时候看了很多遍。
老鼠@6.en: As a child I watched the cat-and-mouse cartoon many times.

移民@6.zh: 这个国家每年都会接收大量来自世界各地的移民。
移民@6.en: Every year this country takes in large numbers of immigrants from all over the world.

联合国.zh: 这位外交官曾在联合国工作了十几年。
联合国.en: This diplomat once worked at the United Nations for over ten years.

情形.zh: 你还记得我们第一次见面时的情形吗？
情形.en: Do you still remember what it was like when we first met?

持有.zh: 他持有这家公司百分之二十的股份，是第二大股东。
持有.en: He holds twenty percent of the company's shares and is its second-largest shareholder.

趁@6.zh: 趁热吃吧，饺子凉了就不好吃了。
趁@6.en: Eat them while they're hot; dumplings don't taste good once they're cold.

合并.zh: 这两家小银行合并以后，成为了当地最大的银行。
合并.en: After the two small banks merged, they became the largest bank in the area.

带领.zh: 班长带领全班同学把教室打扫得干干净净。
带领.en: The class monitor led the whole class in cleaning the classroom until it was spotless.

探索.zh: 孩子天生喜欢探索周围的世界。
探索.en: Children are born loving to explore the world around them.

对抗.zh: 我们要用科学的方法来对抗疾病。
对抗.en: We should use scientific methods to fight disease.

灭.zh: 消防员花了三个小时才把大火扑灭。
灭.en: It took the firefighters three hours to put out the blaze.

秩序@6.zh: 地铁站里有工作人员维持秩序。
秩序@6.en: There are staff in the subway station keeping order.

血管.zh: 老年人要少吃油腻的东西，保护好心脑血管。
血管.en: Older people should eat less greasy food to protect their heart and blood vessels.

热线.zh: 市民可以通过这条热线向政府反映问题。
热线.en: Residents can use this hotline to report problems to the government.

娃娃.zh: 这个胖娃娃笑起来特别可爱。
娃娃.en: This chubby baby is especially cute when it smiles.

以往.zh: 和以往不同，这次他没有迟到。
以往.en: Unlike in the past, this time he wasn't late.

关联.zh: 警方正在调查这两起案件之间是否存在关联。
关联.en: The police are investigating whether the two cases are connected.

金钱.zh: 他为这个项目投入了大量的时间和金钱，最后却失败了。
金钱.en: He put a great deal of time and money into the project, but it failed in the end.

消灭.zh: 我们要在一周内消灭家里所有的蟑螂。
消灭.en: We need to wipe out all the cockroaches in the house within a week.

欺骗.zh: 他用假照片欺骗了网上认识的朋友。
欺骗.en: He deceived a friend he had met online with fake photos.

街头.zh: 每到周末，这个广场上都有街头艺人表演。
街头.en: Every weekend, street performers put on shows in this square.

惊人.zh: 短短十年间，这座城市发生了惊人的变化。
惊人.en: In just ten years, this city has undergone astonishing changes.

质疑.zh: 有网友质疑这家餐厅使用过期食材。
质疑.en: Some netizens have questioned whether this restaurant uses expired ingredients.

摩托车@6.zh: 骑摩托车的时候，一定要戴好头盔。
摩托车@6.en: When riding a motorbike, you must wear a helmet properly.

金融.zh: 上海是中国重要的金融中心。
金融.en: Shanghai is an important financial centre in China.

贸易@6.zh: 他在一家国际贸易公司工作，经常出差。
贸易@6.en: He works for an international trading company and often travels on business.

痕迹.zh: 这把老椅子上有很多岁月留下的痕迹。
痕迹.en: This old chair bears many marks left by the passing years.

染.zh: 他在医院照顾病人时，不小心染上了流感。
染.en: While caring for patients at the hospital, he accidentally caught the flu.

清晰.zh: 他的发音很清晰，每个字都让人听得明明白白。
清晰.en: His pronunciation is very clear; every word can be understood perfectly.

码头.zh: 渔民们一大早就把新鲜的鱼运到码头上卖。
码头.en: Early in the morning, the fishermen bring fresh fish to the wharf to sell.

循环.zh: 这首歌太好听了，我单曲循环了一整天。
循环.en: This song is so good that I played it on repeat all day.

汇报.zh: 调查小组向领导汇报了事故的原因。
汇报.en: The investigation team reported the cause of the accident to their superiors.

总裁@6.zh: 这家公司的总裁每天早上七点就到办公室了。
总裁@6.en: The company's CEO arrives at the office at seven every morning.

鉴定.zh: 经过专家鉴定，这栋老楼已经成了危房，居民必须马上搬走。
鉴定.en: Experts assessed the old building as unsafe, so the residents must move out immediately.

协调.zh: 这次活动涉及好几个部门，需要有人负责协调。
协调.en: This event involves several departments, so someone needs to be in charge of coordinating.

超越.zh: 他在这次比赛中超越了自我，打破了个人最好成绩。
超越.en: In this competition he surpassed himself and broke his personal best.

铺.zh: 工人们正在给这条小路铺石板。
铺.en: The workers are paving this path with stone slabs.

泥.zh: 孩子们在田里玩了一下午，弄得满身是泥。
泥.en: The kids played in the fields all afternoon and got covered in mud.

正义.zh: 这位律师一生都在为穷人争取正义。
正义.en: This lawyer spent his whole life fighting for justice for the poor.

民众.zh: 新的交通规定实施以后，受到了广大民众的支持。
民众.en: After the new traffic rules took effect, they won broad public support.

场景.zh: 每当想起小时候和爷爷一起钓鱼的场景，我都觉得特别温暖。
场景.en: Whenever I recall fishing with my grandpa as a child, I feel especially warm inside.

青春@6.zh: 这部电影讲述了几个大学生的青春故事。
青春@6.en: This film tells the story of several university students' youth.

救援.zh: 几名登山者被困在山上，当地已经派出直升机前去救援。
救援.en: Several climbers are trapped on the mountain, and the authorities have sent a helicopter to rescue them.

欲望.zh: 这位老师很会激发学生的求知欲望。
欲望.en: This teacher is very good at stimulating students' desire to learn.

败.zh: 他这次虽然败了，但比赛中的表现大家有目共睹。
败.en: Although he lost this time, everyone saw how well he played.

立场.zh: 作为老师，你应该站在学生的立场上考虑问题。
立场.en: As a teacher, you should consider things from the students' standpoint.

火灾.zh: 在家里使用电器时一定要注意安全，防止发生火灾。
火灾.en: Always use electrical appliances at home safely to prevent fires.

认定.zh: 经过调查，专家认定这次火灾是由电线老化引起的。
认定.en: After investigation, experts determined that the fire was caused by ageing wiring.

跌.zh: 雪天路滑，他一不小心跌倒在地上。
跌.en: The road was slippery with snow, and he accidentally fell to the ground.

会计@6.zh: 公司的账目都由会计负责管理。
会计@6.en: The company's accounts are all managed by the accountant.

妙.zh: 他这步棋走得真妙，一下子就扭转了局面。
妙.en: That was a brilliant move of his; it turned the game around at a stroke.

狮子@6.zh: 在非洲草原上，我们看到了一群正在休息的狮子。
狮子@6.en: On the African grassland, we saw a group of lions resting.

头脑.zh: 遇到突发事件时，一定要保持头脑冷静。
头脑.en: When something unexpected happens, you must keep a clear head.

倒是.zh: 你说得倒是轻松，可真正做起来哪有那么容易？
倒是.en: That's easy for you to say, but actually doing it is far from easy.

此刻.zh: 我此刻最想做的事，就是回家好好睡一觉。
此刻.en: What I want most right now is to go home and get a good night's sleep.

足以.zh: 他的工资足以养活一家人。
足以.en: His salary is enough to support the whole family.

尺.zh: 把你的尺子借我用一下，我要画一条直线。
尺.en: Lend me your ruler for a moment; I need to draw a straight line.

通信.zh: 地震发生后，灾区的通信一度中断，外界无法联系到当地居民。
通信.en: After the earthquake, communications in the disaster zone were cut off for a time, and the outside world couldn't reach residents.

场面.zh: 春节前的火车站人山人海，场面十分壮观。
场面.en: Before Spring Festival the train station is packed with people, and the scene is spectacular.

祖国.zh: 每当听到国歌响起，他都为自己的祖国感到骄傲。
祖国.en: Whenever he hears the national anthem, he feels proud of his motherland.

惩罚.zh: 因为他撒了谎，妈妈惩罚他一个星期不准看电视。
惩罚.en: Because he lied, Mum punished him by banning TV for a week.

事务.zh: 他退休后积极参与社区事务，比上班时还忙。
事务.en: After retiring he took an active part in community affairs and is busier than when he was working.

在意.zh: 这次考试的分数我并不在意，能学到东西就够了。
在意.en: I don't really care about my score on this exam; learning something is enough.

寸.zh: 这张照片要冲洗成几寸的？我想把它放进相框里。
寸.en: What size should this photo be printed at? I want to put it in a frame.

抵抗.zh: 孩子的抵抗力比较弱，换季的时候特别容易感冒。
抵抗.en: Children have fairly weak resistance and catch colds especially easily when the seasons change.

动机.zh: 警察还不清楚他这么做的动机。
动机.en: The police still don't know his motive for doing this.

情节.zh: 这本小说情节紧张，我一口气就读完了。
情节.en: This novel has a gripping plot, and I read it in one sitting.

虽.zh: 他虽已年过七十，身体却还很硬朗。
虽.en: Although he is over seventy, he is still very fit.

预期.zh: 新产品的销量远远低于预期，公司很失望。
预期.en: Sales of the new product were far below expectations, and the company was very disappointed.

吵架@6.zh: 夫妻之间难免会吵架，关键是要互相理解。
吵架@6.en: Couples inevitably argue; the key is to understand each other.

货车.zh: 这条路上禁止货车通行，只有小汽车可以走。
货车.en: Trucks are banned from this road; only cars are allowed.

出场.zh: 这个赛季他一共出场了三十次，打进了十五个球。
出场.en: This season he made thirty appearances in total and scored fifteen goals.

天才.zh: 爱因斯坦被认为是二十世纪最伟大的天才之一。
天才.en: Einstein is considered one of the greatest geniuses of the twentieth century.

一向.zh: 我妹妹一向不爱吃青菜，总是偷偷挑出来。
一向.en: My little sister has never liked green vegetables and always secretly picks them out.

绝望.zh: 在山里迷路两天后，他几乎绝望了。
绝望.en: After being lost in the mountains for two days, he had almost given up hope.

迷人.zh: 她笑起来的样子非常迷人。
迷人.en: She looks really charming when she smiles.

职位.zh: 这家公司空出了两个工程师的职位。
职位.en: This company has two engineering positions vacant.

化妆.zh: 演员们在后台忙着化妆，准备上台演出。
化妆.en: The actors were busy putting on makeup backstage, getting ready to go on.

节奏.zh: 跳舞的时候要跟上音乐的节奏，不能太快也不能太慢。
节奏.en: When dancing you need to keep to the rhythm of the music, neither too fast nor too slow.

骗子.zh: 千万别相信陌生人的短信，现在的骗子手段越来越多。
骗子.en: Never trust texts from strangers; scammers have more and more tricks these days.

外科.zh: 她大学学的是医学，毕业后当了一名外科医生。
外科.en: She studied medicine at university and became a surgeon after graduating.

角落.zh: 我在沙发的角落里找到了丢失的耳机。
角落.en: I found my lost earphones in the corner of the sofa.

剧本.zh: 这位导演花了两年时间修改电影剧本。
剧本.en: The director spent two years revising the film script.

亲密.zh: 这对母女像朋友一样亲密，什么话都能说。
亲密.en: This mother and daughter are as close as friends and can talk about anything.

版本.zh: 这本小说有好几个英文版本，翻译质量差别很大。
版本.en: This novel has several English versions, and the quality of the translations varies widely.

干脆@6.zh: 他说话很干脆，从来不绕弯子。
干脆@6.en: He speaks very directly and never beats about the bush.

干扰.zh: 飞机起飞时使用手机可能会干扰信号。
干扰.en: Using a phone while the plane is taking off may interfere with signals.

肿.zh: 她昨晚哭了很久，今天早上眼睛都肿了。
肿.en: She cried for a long time last night, and this morning her eyes were puffy.

途径.zh: 你可以通过官方网站或电话两种途径报名。
途径.en: You can sign up through either of two channels: the official website or by phone.

不安@6.zh: 孩子这么晚还没回家，妈妈心里越来越不安。
不安@6.en: It was so late and the child still wasn't home, and the mother grew more and more uneasy.

体系.zh: 这家公司建立了一套完整的质量管理体系。
体系.en: The company has set up a complete quality management system.

遭受.zh: 这家公司在疫情期间遭受了巨大的损失。
遭受.en: This company suffered huge losses during the pandemic.

康复.zh: 祝你早日康复，我们都等着你回来上班呢！
康复.en: Get well soon; we're all waiting for you to come back to work!

穿过.zh: 这条河穿过整个城市，最后流进大海。
穿过.en: This river runs through the whole city and finally flows into the sea.

轨道.zh: 经过一个月的调整，工厂的生产终于回到了正常轨道。
轨道.en: After a month of adjustments, the factory's production finally got back on track.

城镇.zh: 这条高速公路建成以后，沿线的城镇都得到了发展。
城镇.en: Since this expressway was built, the towns along it have all developed.

忍受.zh: 这里冬天冷得让人难以忍受。

脆弱.zh: 这里的生态环境十分脆弱，一旦破坏就很难恢复。
脆弱.en: The ecosystem here is very fragile; once damaged, it is hard to restore.

漫画.zh: 这本畅销小说已经被改编成了漫画。
漫画.en: This bestselling novel has been adapted into a comic.

肩膀@6.zh: 他把孩子放在肩膀上，让他看清楚前面的表演。
肩膀@6.en: He put the child on his shoulders so he could see the performance in front clearly.

继承.zh: 她继承了奶奶做菜的好手艺。
继承.en: She inherited her grandmother's excellent cooking skills.

弥补.zh: 失去的时间是无法弥补的。
弥补.en: Lost time can never be made up for.

扑.zh: 一阵香味扑面而来，原来隔壁在烤面包。
扑.en: A wave of fragrance hit me in the face; it turned out the neighbours were baking bread.

抵达.zh: 经过三天的长途旅行，我们终于抵达了目的地。
抵达.en: After three days of long-distance travel, we finally reached our destination.

肝.zh: 我小时候最讨厌吃猪肝，现在倒觉得挺香的。
肝.en: As a kid I hated eating pig liver, but now I actually find it quite tasty.

也好.zh: 下雨了，不出去也好，我们就在家看电影吧。
也好.en: It's raining; it's just as well we're not going out. Let's watch a movie at home.

偷偷.zh: 为了给妈妈一个惊喜，我们偷偷准备了一个生日蛋糕。
偷偷.en: To surprise Mom, we secretly prepared a birthday cake.

忽略.zh: 他太专心看书，完全忽略了身边的电话铃声。
忽略.en: He was so absorbed in his book that he completely ignored the phone ringing beside him.

酱.zh: 这道菜的味道全靠这碗秘制的酱，做法从来不外传。
酱.en: The flavor of this dish comes entirely from this secret sauce, whose recipe is never shared.

支撑.zh: 全家人的生活都靠他一个人的工资支撑。
支撑.en: The whole family's living is supported by his salary alone.

依旧.zh: 多年不见，王老师风采依旧，一点儿也不显老。
依旧.en: We haven't seen Teacher Wang in years, but she is as elegant as ever and doesn't look any older.

来临.zh: 随着春节的来临，商场里的人一天比一天多。
来临.en: As the Spring Festival approaches, the malls get busier day by day.

元素.zh: 氧是地壳中含量最多的化学元素。
元素.en: Oxygen is the most abundant chemical element in the Earth's crust.

强迫.zh: 他每天强迫自己早上六点起床跑步。
强迫.en: He forces himself to get up at six every morning to go running.

浮.zh: 游泳时只要放松身体，人就能自然地浮起来。
浮.en: When swimming, as long as you relax your body, you'll float naturally.

奖品.zh: 答对所有问题的观众，可以领取一份小奖品。
奖品.en: Audience members who answer every question correctly can collect a small prize.

仓库.zh: 超市的仓库里堆满了准备过年卖的年货。
仓库.en: The supermarket's warehouse is piled high with goods to sell for Chinese New Year.

回顾.zh: 在毕业典礼上，校长回顾了学校一百年的发展。
回顾.en: At the graduation ceremony, the principal looked back on the school's hundred years of development.

岗位.zh: 这家工厂今年新增了两百个工作岗位。
岗位.en: This factory added two hundred new jobs this year.

模仿@6.zh: 这只鹦鹉很聪明，能模仿好几种动物的叫声。
模仿@6.en: This parrot is very clever and can imitate the calls of several animals.

前提.zh: 在保证质量的前提下，我们要尽量降低成本。
前提.en: On the precondition that quality is guaranteed, we should cut costs as much as possible.

破产@6.zh: 这家公司欠了银行很多钱，最后只好宣布破产。
破产@6.en: This company owed the bank a lot of money and in the end had to declare bankruptcy.

清洁.zh: 每天下班后，清洁工人都会把办公室打扫得干干净净。
清洁.en: Every day after work, the cleaners tidy the office until it is spotless.

内衣.zh: 内衣最好用手洗，而且要和其他衣服分开洗。
内衣.en: Underwear is best washed by hand and separately from other clothes.

烫@6.zh: 她刚去理发店烫了头发，看起来年轻了好几岁。
烫@6.en: She has just had her hair permed at the salon and looks several years younger.

焦点.zh: 拍照时，要先把焦点对准人物的脸。
焦点.en: When taking photos, first set the focus on the person's face.

自豪@6.zh: 他自豪地告诉大家，这张桌子是他自己做的。
自豪@6.en: He proudly told everyone that he had made this table himself.

福利.zh: 政府提高了退休老人的福利待遇。
福利.en: The government has raised the welfare benefits of retired people.

故障.zh: 由于信号系统发生故障，地铁晚点了二十分钟。
故障.en: Because the signalling system broke down, the subway was twenty minutes late.

手法.zh: 骗子的手法越来越高明，大家要小心。
手法.en: Scammers' tricks are getting more and more sophisticated, so everyone should be careful.

指责.zh: 他自己迟到了，反而指责别人没有提前通知他。
指责.en: He was the one who was late, yet he blamed others for not telling him in advance.

闯@6.zh: 他二十岁就离开家乡，到上海去闯天下。
闯@6.en: At twenty he left his hometown and went to Shanghai to make his way in the world.

免疫.zh: 得过一次水痘的人，一般会终身免疫。
免疫.en: People who have had chickenpox once are usually immune for life.

戒指@6.zh: 她手上戴着一枚钻石戒指，非常漂亮。
戒指@6.en: She is wearing a diamond ring on her hand; it is very beautiful.

单纯@6.zh: 孩子的想法很单纯，喜欢就是喜欢。
单纯@6.en: Children think in a very simple way: if they like something, they like it.

割.zh: 这把小刀很锋利，一下子就把绳子割断了。
割.en: This little knife is very sharp — it cut through the rope in one go.

初步.zh: 经过初步检查，医生认为他的骨头没有问题。
初步.en: After a preliminary examination, the doctor believes there is nothing wrong with his bones.

假设@6.zh: 科学家通过实验证明了这个假设是正确的。
假设@6.en: The scientists proved through experiments that this hypothesis was correct.

困扰.zh: 交通堵塞一直是困扰大城市的一个难题。
困扰.en: Traffic congestion has long been a problem plaguing big cities.

布置.zh: 老师今天布置了很多数学作业。
布置.en: The teacher assigned a lot of maths homework today.

优先.zh: 应聘这个职位，会说日语的人将被优先录用。
优先.en: For this position, applicants who speak Japanese will be given priority in hiring.

吊.zh: 工人们用起重机把钢材吊到了楼顶。
吊.en: The workers used a crane to lift the steel up to the roof.

手臂.zh: 老师让学生们把手臂伸直，跟着音乐做操。
手臂.en: The teacher had the students stretch out their arms and do exercises to the music.

携带.zh: 外出旅行时，最好随身携带一些常用药。
携带.en: When travelling, it is best to carry some common medicines with you.

聚集.zh: 这一带聚集了全市大部分的高科技企业。
聚集.en: Most of the city's high-tech companies are clustered in this area.

指定.zh: 老师指定他担任这次活动的负责人。
指定.en: The teacher appointed him to be in charge of this event.

部位.zh: 这种按摩方法主要针对颈部和肩膀这两个部位。
部位.en: This massage technique mainly targets two areas: the neck and the shoulders.

融入.zh: 新同事性格开朗，很快就融入了我们这个集体。
融入.en: The new colleague is outgoing and quickly became part of our team.

激励.zh: 公司设立了奖金制度，以激励员工多提建议。
激励.en: The company set up a bonus system to motivate employees to make more suggestions.

坚定.zh: 面对诱惑，他态度坚定，一口拒绝了。
坚定.en: Faced with temptation, he stood firm and refused outright.

粒.zh: 农民辛苦种出的每一粒米都来之不易。
粒.en: Every grain of rice that farmers grow through hard work does not come easily.

高层.zh: 住在高层的好处是光线好，噪音也小。
高层.en: The advantage of living on a high floor is good light and less noise.

许可.zh: 在这里开餐馆，必须先办理卫生许可证。
许可.en: To open a restaurant here, you must first get a health permit.

灾难.zh: 对一个爱美的人来说，脸上长痘简直是一场灾难。
灾难.en: For someone who cares about their looks, a spot on the face is a real disaster.

以便.zh: 把重要的文件放在桌上，以便明天一早就能找到。
以便.en: Put the important documents on the desk so that you can find them first thing tomorrow.

军人.zh: 他爷爷年轻时是一名军人，参加过很多次战斗。
军人.en: His grandfather was a soldier when young and fought in many battles.

定义.zh: 数学课上，老师先解释了三角形的定义。
定义.en: In maths class, the teacher first explained the definition of a triangle.

图像.zh: 电视突然没有图像了，只能听到声音。
图像.en: The TV suddenly lost its picture; we could only hear the sound.

逗@6.zh: 这只小猫太好玩了，孩子们一直在逗它。
逗@6.en: This kitten is such fun that the children keep teasing it.

飘@6.zh: 秋风一吹，树叶纷纷从树上飘了下来。
飘@6.en: When the autumn wind blew, leaves came fluttering down from the trees.

修复.zh: 这个软件可以帮你修复手机系统的一些错误。
修复.en: This software can help you fix some errors in your phone's system.

常规.zh: 体检只是常规检查，你不用太紧张。
常规.en: The physical is just a routine check-up; there's no need to be nervous.

依赖.zh: 现在很多人对手机产生了严重的依赖。
依赖.en: Nowadays many people have become seriously dependent on their phones.

分散.zh: 下了旅游车，游客们分散在广场的各个角落拍照。
分散.en: After getting off the tour bus, the tourists scattered to every corner of the square to take photos.

误.zh: 他把盐误当成了糖，结果这道菜咸得没法吃。
误.en: He mistook salt for sugar, and the dish ended up too salty to eat.

添.zh: 你的饭不够的话，锅里还有，我再给你添一碗。
添.en: If you haven't had enough rice, there's more in the pot; I'll get you another bowl.

履行.zh: 既然答应了别人，就要履行自己的诺言。
履行.en: Since you made someone a promise, you must keep it.

竞赛.zh: 学校每年都举办一次知识竞赛，每个班都要派代表参加。
竞赛.en: The school holds a general-knowledge quiz every year, and every class sends representatives.

被迫.zh: 公司经营困难，他被迫离开了工作了十年的岗位。
被迫.en: With the company in trouble, he was forced to leave the job he had held for ten years.

争夺.zh: 两只小狗为了争夺一根骨头，叫个不停。
争夺.en: The two puppies kept barking as they fought over a bone.

扫描.zh: 我把这些旧照片都扫描到电脑里保存了起来。
扫描.en: I scanned all these old photos and saved them on my computer.

理念.zh: 现代教育理念认为，应该让孩子多动手、多思考。
理念.en: Modern educational thinking holds that children should be encouraged to do more hands-on work and think more.

排名.zh: 这所大学在全国高校中的排名一直很靠前。
排名.en: This university has always ranked near the top among the country's universities.

频率.zh: 最近他咳嗽的频率越来越高，最好去医院看看。
频率.en: Recently he has been coughing more and more often; he'd better see a doctor.

逃跑.zh: 敌人见势不妙，纷纷丢下武器逃跑。
逃跑.en: Seeing things going badly, the enemy dropped their weapons one after another and fled.

平等@6.zh: 在我们家，男孩和女孩受到的待遇是平等的。
平等@6.en: In our family, boys and girls are treated equally.

罐.zh: 这罐蜂蜜是邻居从老家带来的。
罐.en: This jar of honey was brought by a neighbour from their hometown.

众人.zh: 她一走进会场，就吸引了众人的目光。
众人.en: As soon as she walked into the venue, she drew everyone's eyes.

自愿@6.zh: 这些年轻人都是自愿来帮忙的，没有拿一分钱。
自愿@6.en: These young people all came to help of their own free will and didn't take a penny.

铜.zh: 这尊古老的雕像是用铜做的，表面已经发绿了。
铜.en: This ancient statue is made of bronze, and its surface has turned green.

暗示.zh: 老师在考试前暗示我们，第三章的内容很重要。
暗示.en: Before the exam, the teacher hinted to us that the material in chapter three was important.

尖.zh: 她站在门口，踮着脚尖往远处看。
尖.en: She stood at the door on tiptoe, looking into the distance.

箭.zh: 光阴似箭，转眼间我们已经毕业十年了。
箭.en: Time flies like an arrow; in the blink of an eye, it's been ten years since we graduated.

原始.zh: 那个地区至今还保留着大片原始森林。
原始.en: That region still preserves large areas of primeval forest today.

总算@6.zh: 找了整整一个下午，我总算找到了丢失的钥匙。
总算@6.en: After searching for a whole afternoon, I finally found my lost keys.

谈论.zh: 在背后谈论别人的隐私是很不礼貌的。
谈论.en: It's very rude to talk about other people's private affairs behind their backs.

扭.zh: 下楼梯时一脚踩空，把腰扭了，疼得直不起来。
扭.en: I missed a step going downstairs and wrenched my back; it hurt so much I couldn't stand up straight.

转换.zh: 毕业以后，他很快完成了从学生到职员的角色转换。
转换.en: After graduating, he quickly made the switch from student to employee.

搭配.zh: 这道菜用牛肉搭配青椒，味道特别好。
搭配.en: This dish pairs beef with green peppers and tastes especially good.

活跃@6.zh: 他的到来让晚会的气氛一下子活跃了起来。
活跃@6.en: His arrival livened up the atmosphere of the party at once.

净.zh: 你别净说别人，先看看你自己做得怎么样。
净.en: Stop just criticizing others; look at how you're doing first.

诞生.zh: 随着互联网的发展，很多新职业诞生了。
诞生.en: With the development of the internet, many new professions have come into being.

场合.zh: 他说话从来不分场合，常常让身边的人很尴尬。
场合.en: He never considers the occasion when he speaks, and often embarrasses those around him.

收购.zh: 每到秋天，商人们就来村里收购农民种的苹果。
收购.en: Every autumn, traders come to the village to buy up the apples the farmers grow.

重建.zh: 这座古庙在战争中被毁，二十年前才重建。
重建.en: This old temple was destroyed in the war and was only rebuilt twenty years ago.

串.zh: 妈妈从市场买回来一串新鲜的葡萄。
串.en: Mum brought home a bunch of fresh grapes from the market.

横.zh: 他在纸上画了一条横线，把两部分内容分开。
横.en: He drew a horizontal line on the paper to separate the two parts.

看好.zh: 赛前没有人看好这支球队，没想到他们最后拿了冠军。
看好.en: Before the tournament nobody rated this team, but they ended up winning the title.

眼光.zh: 这位投资人很有眼光，十年前就看好了这家公司。
眼光.en: This investor has real vision; he believed in this company ten years ago.

占据.zh: 在他的心中，家庭始终占据着最重要的位置。
占据.en: In his heart, family has always held the most important place.

夸张@6.zh: 这个演员的表演太夸张了，一点儿都不自然。
夸张@6.en: This actor's performance is too exaggerated and not natural at all.

一流.zh: 她是一位一流的厨师，做的菜在城里很有名。
一流.en: She is a first-class chef whose dishes are famous throughout the city.

管道.zh: 天然气通过地下管道输送到千家万户。
管道.en: Natural gas is delivered to countless homes through underground pipelines.

效应.zh: 全球气温不断升高，与温室效应有很大关系。
效应.en: The steady rise in global temperatures has a lot to do with the greenhouse effect.

射击@6.zh: 她在奥运会射击比赛中获得了金牌。
射击@6.en: She won a gold medal in the shooting event at the Olympics.

掏.zh: 他总爱用手指掏耳朵，医生说这样对耳朵不好。
掏.en: He always picks his ears with his finger, which the doctor says is bad for them.

认可.zh: 这所大学的学历在国外也是被认可的。
认可.en: Degrees from this university are recognised abroad as well.

中毒.zh: 冬天在不通风的房间里烧炭取暖，很容易发生一氧化碳中毒。
中毒.en: Burning charcoal for heat in an unventilated room in winter can easily cause carbon monoxide poisoning.

家属.zh: 公司组织员工和家属一起去海边度假。
家属.en: The company organised a seaside holiday for employees and their families.

坚决@6.zh: 妈妈态度很坚决，不让我一个人去旅行。
坚决@6.en: Mum was very firm and wouldn't let me travel alone.

外表.zh: 这家饭店外表很普通，但菜做得非常好吃。
外表.en: This restaurant looks ordinary from the outside, but the food is delicious.

十足.zh: 这个演员的表演幽默十足，逗得观众哈哈大笑。
十足.en: This actor's performance was full of humour and had the audience roaring with laughter.

窗口.zh: 电脑屏幕上突然弹出一个广告窗口，怎么也关不掉。
窗口.en: An ad window suddenly popped up on the computer screen and wouldn't close no matter what I did.

老实@6.zh: 这孩子在学校很老实，从不惹麻烦。
老实@6.en: This child is very well-behaved at school and never causes trouble.

势力.zh: 这个家族在当地很有势力，没人敢得罪他们。
势力.en: This family is very powerful locally; nobody dares to cross them.

抑制.zh: 这种药可以抑制细菌的生长。
抑制.en: This drug can inhibit the growth of bacteria.

精心.zh: 护士们精心照顾这位老人，他很快就恢复了健康。
精心.en: The nurses looked after the old man with great care, and he soon recovered.

极端.zh: 这个地区的气候非常极端，夏天酷热，冬天严寒。
极端.en: The climate in this region is extreme: scorching summers and bitterly cold winters.

理性.zh: 遇到问题时，我们应该理性地分析，而不是感情用事。
理性.en: When problems arise, we should analyze them rationally rather than act on emotion.

服用.zh: 孕妇在服用任何药物之前，都应该先问问医生。
服用.en: Pregnant women should consult a doctor before taking any medication.

遗产.zh: 他继承了父亲留下的一大笔遗产，却很快就挥霍光了。
遗产.en: He inherited a large fortune from his father but soon squandered it all.

捐赠.zh: 他去世后，家人按照他的遗愿把他的藏书捐赠给了学校。
捐赠.en: After he died, his family donated his book collection to the school according to his wishes.

皇帝.zh: 《皇帝的新装》是一个很有名的童话故事。
皇帝.en: The Emperor's New Clothes is a very famous fairy tale.

交谈.zh: 开车时尽量不要和乘客交谈，以免分心。
交谈.en: Try not to chat with passengers while driving so you don't get distracted.

取代.zh: 智能手机几乎已经取代了数码相机。
取代.en: Smartphones have all but replaced digital cameras.

模拟.zh: 考试前一周，老师给我们组织了一次模拟考试。
模拟.en: A week before the exam, the teacher gave us a mock exam.

住宅.zh: 这栋老房子原来是一位著名作家的住宅。
住宅.en: This old house was originally the residence of a famous writer.

丧失.zh: 那场意外让他永远丧失了听力。
丧失.en: That accident caused him to lose his hearing for good.

争论@6.zh: 关于晚饭吃什么，兄弟俩争论了半天。
争论@6.en: The two brothers argued for ages about what to have for dinner.

旋转.zh: 这家旋转餐厅在电视塔顶上，可以看到全城夜景。
旋转.en: This revolving restaurant sits on top of the TV tower, with a view of the whole city at night.

吞.zh: 蛇能把比自己的头大好几倍的动物整个吞下去。
吞.en: A snake can swallow whole an animal several times larger than its own head.

等级.zh: 你的会员等级越高，能享受的折扣就越多。
等级.en: The higher your membership level, the bigger the discounts you get.

正面.zh: 这次活动在社会上产生了很大的正面影响。
正面.en: This event had a big positive impact on society.

毫不.zh: 面对记者的提问，她毫不客气地指出了对方的错误。
毫不.en: Facing the reporter's question, she pointed out his mistake without mincing words.

隔壁@6.zh: 隔壁的狗叫了一个晚上，吵得我睡不着。
隔壁@6.en: The dog next door barked all night and kept me awake.

歪@6.zh: 他的领带歪了，自己却一点儿也没发现。
歪@6.en: His tie was crooked, but he didn't notice at all.

跪.zh: 小朋友跪在沙发上，扒着窗台往外看。
跪.en: The child knelt on the sofa, holding onto the windowsill to look outside.

举动.zh: 他在演唱会上突然跪下求婚，这个举动让全场都尖叫起来。
举动.en: He suddenly knelt down and proposed at the concert, and the gesture set the whole crowd screaming.

细菌.zh: 抹布用久了会滋生大量细菌，要经常更换。
细菌.en: Dishcloths breed lots of bacteria after long use, so change them often.

棉.zh: 这个地区气候干燥、阳光充足，很适合种棉花。
棉.en: This region is dry and sunny, ideal for growing cotton.

外交@6.zh: 他父亲是一名外交官，所以他在很多国家生活过。
外交@6.en: His father is a diplomat, so he has lived in many countries.

收益.zh: 他把存款拿去买了理财产品，每年的收益还不错。
收益.en: He put his savings into investment products, and the annual returns are decent.

顾.zh: 她只顾着玩手机，连饭都忘了吃。
顾.en: She was so absorbed in her phone that she even forgot to eat.

规矩@6.zh: 按照这里的规矩，进门前要先脱鞋。
规矩@6.en: According to the custom here, you take off your shoes before going in.

大使.zh: 这位著名演员被任命为这次环保活动的形象大使。
大使.en: This famous actor has been appointed ambassador for the environmental campaign.

崇拜.zh: 弟弟非常崇拜他的哥哥，什么都学哥哥。
崇拜.en: The younger boy idolises his big brother and copies everything he does.

信念.zh: 她始终怀着一个信念：只要努力，就一定能实现梦想。
信念.en: She always held one belief: as long as you work hard, you can realise your dream.

模样.zh: 女儿长大后，越来越像她妈妈年轻时的模样。
模样.en: As the daughter grows up, she looks more and more like her mother did when young.

当场.zh: 那个小偷刚伸手，就被保安当场抓住了。
当场.en: The thief had just reached out his hand when security caught him on the spot.

特定.zh: 这个词只在特定的场合使用，平时说话很少用到。
特定.en: This word is only used on particular occasions and rarely comes up in everyday speech.

看待.zh: 他已经变了很多，你不要再用老眼光看待他了。
看待.en: He has changed a lot, so stop seeing him the way you used to.

打架.zh: 两只猫在院子里打架，叫声吵醒了全家人。
打架.en: Two cats were fighting in the yard, and their yowling woke the whole family.

打造.zh: 他花了十年时间，把一家小餐馆打造成了全国知名的连锁品牌。
打造.en: Over ten years, he built a small restaurant into a nationally famous chain.

助手.zh: 这个语音助手能帮我设闹钟、查天气。
助手.en: This voice assistant can set alarms and check the weather for me.

得以.zh: 由于及时送到了医院，病人的生命得以保住。
得以.en: Because he was taken to hospital in time, the patient's life was saved.

上市.zh: 每年五月，新鲜的荔枝就开始上市了。
上市.en: Every May, fresh lychees start to appear on the market.

猜测.zh: 这只是我的猜测，还没有得到证实。
猜测.en: This is just my guess; it hasn't been confirmed.

典礼.zh: 九月一日，全校师生在操场上举行了隆重的开学典礼。
典礼.en: On 1 September, the whole school held a grand ceremony on the sports field to open the new term.

场地.zh: 学校的运动场地不够大，学生们只能轮流上体育课。
场地.en: The school's sports grounds aren't big enough, so students have to take turns having PE.

脂肪.zh: 多运动可以帮助燃烧身体里多余的脂肪。
脂肪.en: Exercising more can help burn excess fat in the body.

港口.zh: 货物从港口装上船，一个月后运到了欧洲。
港口.en: The goods were loaded onto a ship at the port and reached Europe a month later.

著作.zh: 鲁迅的著作被翻译成了很多种语言。
著作.en: Lu Xun's works have been translated into many languages.

放大.zh: 这台显微镜能把物体放大一千倍。
放大.en: This microscope can magnify objects a thousand times.

覆盖.zh: 这个城市的免费网络已经覆盖了所有公园。
覆盖.en: This city's free internet now covers all its parks.

渠道.zh: 这家公司的产品主要通过网络渠道销售。
渠道.en: This company's products are mainly sold through online channels.

气质.zh: 多读书能在不知不觉中改变一个人的气质。
气质.en: Reading a lot can gradually change a person's bearing without them noticing.

伤亡.zh: 幸运的是，这场大火没有造成人员伤亡。
伤亡.en: Fortunately, the fire caused no casualties.

缺陷.zh: 这个计划有一个明显的缺陷：没有考虑成本。
缺陷.en: This plan has an obvious flaw: it doesn't consider costs.

酒精.zh: 开车前绝对不能喝含有酒精的饮料。
酒精.en: You must never have drinks containing alcohol before driving.

总理@6.zh: 电视里正在播放总理的新年讲话。
总理@6.en: The TV is broadcasting the premier's New Year speech.

限.zh: 这次作文比赛每篇限八百字以内，超出的要扣分。
限.en: In this essay contest each entry is limited to 800 characters; anything over loses points.

骨头@6.zh: 小狗趴在门口，高兴地啃着一块骨头。
骨头@6.en: The puppy lay at the door, happily gnawing on a bone.

上级.zh: 他刚升职，就成了以前同事的上级。
上级.en: He was just promoted and became the boss of his former colleagues.

睁@6.zh: 医生让他睁开眼睛，看看灯光。
睁@6.en: The doctor asked him to open his eyes and look at the light.

金牌.zh: 这位老运动员终于在退役前夺得了人生第一块金牌。
金牌.en: This veteran athlete finally won the first gold medal of his career before retiring.

例外.zh: 他每天早上都去跑步，今天下雨也不例外。
例外.en: He goes running every morning, and today, even though it is raining, is no exception.

沉重.zh: 听到这个坏消息，大家的心情都很沉重。
沉重.en: Hearing this bad news, everyone felt heavy-hearted.

仪器.zh: 医生用一台专门的仪器检查了我的眼睛。
仪器.en: The doctor examined my eyes with a special instrument.

命名.zh: 这家公司用创始人女儿的名字给新产品命名。
命名.en: The company named its new product after the founder's daughter.

赋予.zh: 艺术家赋予了这些旧瓶子新的生命。
赋予.en: The artist gave these old bottles a new life.

示范.zh: 这所学校被评为全市的示范学校。
示范.en: This school has been named a model school for the whole city.

严厉.zh: 经理严厉地批评了经常迟到的员工。
严厉.en: The manager sternly criticised the employee who was often late.

封闭.zh: 长期生活在封闭的环境里，人容易变得孤独。
封闭.en: Living in a closed-off environment for a long time can easily make people lonely.

处罚.zh: 学校对考试作弊的学生进行了处罚。
处罚.en: The school punished the students who cheated in the exam.

血压.zh: 吃得太咸容易导致血压升高。
血压.en: Eating too much salt can easily raise your blood pressure.

遗传.zh: 医生说这种病和遗传有关，家里人最好都去检查一下。
遗传.en: The doctor said this illness is hereditary, so the whole family had better get checked.

识别.zh: 这款手机可以通过指纹识别主人的身份。
识别.en: This phone can identify its owner by fingerprint.

纠正.zh: 如果发现报道里有错误，我们会及时纠正。
纠正.en: If we find any errors in the report, we will correct them promptly.

期限.zh: 这份租房合同的期限是三年，到期后可以续签。
期限.en: The term of this lease is three years, and it can be renewed when it expires.

开启.zh: 这扇门需要刷员工卡才能开启，外人是进不去的。
开启.en: This door only opens with a staff card; outsiders can't get in.

用心.zh: 这份礼物虽然不贵，但看得出来他是用心准备的。
用心.en: This gift isn't expensive, but you can tell he put a lot of thought into it.

流动.zh: 现在年轻人换工作越来越频繁，人才流动也越来越快。
流动.en: Young people change jobs more and more often these days, so talent moves around faster and faster.

拦@6.zh: 他想闯红灯，被警察拦了下来。
拦@6.en: He tried to run the red light but was stopped by the police.

外界.zh: 这位作家很少接受采访，外界对他的私生活了解不多。
外界.en: This writer rarely gives interviews, so the outside world knows little about his private life.

奉献.zh: 很多志愿者在节假日默默奉献，帮助需要帮助的人。
奉献.en: Many volunteers quietly give their time during holidays to help people in need.

漫长.zh: 这里的冬天非常漫长，从十月一直持续到第二年四月。
漫长.en: Winter here is very long, lasting from October until April of the following year.

番.zh: 他把房间重新布置了一番，看起来焕然一新。
番.en: He rearranged the room, and it looks brand new.

喜剧.zh: 这部电影虽然是喜剧，结尾却让很多观众哭了。
喜剧.en: Although the film is a comedy, its ending made many viewers cry.

视觉.zh: 长时间盯着电脑屏幕，容易造成视觉疲劳。
视觉.en: Staring at a computer screen for a long time can easily cause eye strain.

香水.zh: 我在机场的免税店给妈妈买了一瓶香水。
香水.en: I bought my mom a bottle of perfume at the airport duty-free shop.

多余@6.zh: 搬家前，她把多余的家具都送给了邻居。
多余@6.en: Before moving, she gave her surplus furniture to the neighbours.

救助.zh: 政府设立了专项资金，用来救助生活困难的家庭。
救助.en: The government has set up a special fund to help families in hardship.

测量.zh: 护士正在给小朋友测量身高和体重。
测量.en: The nurse is measuring the children's height and weight.

走廊.zh: 医院走廊里坐满了等着看病的人。
走廊.en: The hospital corridor was full of people waiting to see a doctor.

汇.zh: 几条小河在这里汇成了一条大河。
汇.en: Several streams converge here to form a big river.

一同.zh: 毕业那天，全班同学一同在校门口拍了合影。
一同.en: On graduation day, the whole class took a group photo together at the school gate.

珠宝.zh: 小偷趁主人不在，偷走了家里所有的珠宝首饰。
珠宝.en: While the owners were away, the thief stole all the jewelry in the house.

赖.zh: 周末早上他总爱赖在床上，到中午才起来。
赖.en: On weekend mornings he likes to lie in bed and doesn't get up until noon.

冲击.zh: 巨大的海浪不断冲击着岸边的岩石。
冲击.en: Huge waves kept pounding the rocks along the shore.

水泥.zh: 这条小路以前是土路，去年才铺上了水泥。
水泥.en: This path used to be dirt; it was only paved with concrete last year.

职务.zh: 因为身体原因，他辞去了部门主任的职务。
职务.en: For health reasons, he resigned from his post as department head.

愁.zh: 他家里有钱，从来不用为吃穿发愁。
愁.en: His family is wealthy, so he has never had to worry about food or clothing.

都市.zh: 这部电视剧讲述了几个年轻人在都市里打拼的故事。
都市.en: This TV drama tells the story of a few young people trying to make it in the city.

专用.zh: 这是残疾人专用的停车位，请不要随便占用。
专用.en: This is a disabled parking space; please do not park in it.

天真@6.zh: 小女孩天真地问妈妈，月亮为什么会跟着我们走。
天真@6.en: The little girl innocently asked her mother why the moon follows us.

燃料.zh: 过去农村做饭主要用木柴当燃料。
燃料.en: In the past, rural households mostly used firewood as fuel for cooking.

面子.zh: 看在老朋友的面子上，这次就原谅他吧。
面子.en: For the sake of an old friend, let's forgive him this time.

披@6.zh: 下雨了，他披上雨衣就出门了。
披@6.en: It started raining, so he threw on a raincoat and went out.

认同.zh: 很多海外华人对中国文化有很强的认同感。
认同.en: Many overseas Chinese identify strongly with Chinese culture.

思路.zh: 你突然打断我，我的思路全乱了。
思路.en: You interrupted me so suddenly that I completely lost my train of thought.

严.zh: 这家公司管理很严，上班迟到一次就要扣钱。
严.en: This company is strictly managed; being late even once means a pay deduction.

尺寸.zh: 买家具之前，最好先量好房间的尺寸。
尺寸.en: Before buying furniture, it's best to measure the room first.

影子@6.zh: 晚上路灯一照，地上就出现了我们的影子。
影子@6.en: When the street lamps shine at night, our shadows appear on the ground.

海岸.zh: 台风即将登陆，海岸附近的居民都已经转移。
海岸.en: The typhoon is about to make landfall, and residents near the coast have all been evacuated.

地道@6.zh: 这家小饭馆做的是地道的四川菜。
地道@6.en: This little restaurant serves authentic Sichuan food.

通话.zh: 开车时用手机通话非常危险。
通话.en: Talking on your phone while driving is very dangerous.

迈.zh: 毕业以后，他们迈出了走向社会的第一步。
迈.en: After graduating, they took their first step into society.

担忧.zh: 专家担忧，持续的高温天气可能会影响今年的粮食产量。
担忧.en: Experts worry that the continuing heat could affect this year's grain harvest.

嫌.zh: 她嫌这家饭馆太吵，拉着我换了一家。
嫌.en: She found this restaurant too noisy and dragged me off to a different one.

赞同.zh: 对于周末加班的提议，全组只有他一个人举手赞同。
赞同.en: Of the whole team, he was the only one who raised his hand in favor of the proposal to work weekends.

融合.zh: 这座城市的建筑风格把传统和现代很好地融合在了一起。
融合.en: The city's architecture blends the traditional and the modern beautifully.

焦虑.zh: 孩子回家晚了也不打电话，妈妈在家里焦虑地等着。
焦虑.en: The child was late home and hadn't called, so the mother waited anxiously at home.

牢.zh: 他年轻时因为抢劫坐了五年牢，出来后决心重新做人。
牢.en: As a young man he served five years in prison for robbery, and after his release he resolved to turn over a new leaf.

延续.zh: 这部电视剧的第二季延续了第一季的风格，依然很受欢迎。
延续.en: The second season of this TV series carries on the style of the first and is still very popular.

电源.zh: 笔记本电脑没电了，附近有没有电源可以充电？
电源.en: My laptop is out of battery; is there a power outlet nearby where I can charge it?

学位.zh: 他一边工作一边读书，终于拿到了博士学位。
学位.en: He studied while working and finally obtained his doctoral degree.

考察.zh: 公司派他去南方考察那里的市场需求。
考察.en: The company sent him south to investigate market demand there.

岁月.zh: 在大学里度过的那段岁月，是我一生中最美好的回忆。
岁月.en: The years I spent at university are the best memories of my life.

伴随.zh: 青春期常常伴随着各种烦恼。
伴随.en: Adolescence is often accompanied by all kinds of worries.

争议.zh: 裁判的这个判罚存在争议，双方球员都很激动。
争议.en: The referee's call was disputed, and players on both sides got very worked up.

避.zh: 他最近好像在故意避着我，打电话也不接。
避.en: He seems to be deliberately avoiding me lately; he won't even answer my calls.

肠.zh: 他最近肠胃不好，吃点儿凉的就拉肚子。
肠.en: His stomach has been bad lately; eating anything cold gives him diarrhea.

决策.zh: 公司的重大决策都要经过董事会讨论。
决策.en: All of the company's major decisions must be discussed by the board.

终身.zh: 这位老教授获得了学会颁发的终身成就奖。
终身.en: The old professor received the society's lifetime achievement award.

预定.zh: 由于天气原因，飞机没能按预定时间起飞。
预定.en: Because of the weather, the plane couldn't take off at the scheduled time.

称呼@6.zh: 在中国，学生一般称呼老师为“王老师”“李老师”。
称呼@6.en: In China, students usually address teachers as "Teacher Wang" or "Teacher Li".

机遇.zh: 互联网的发展给年轻人带来了前所未有的机遇。
机遇.en: The development of the internet has brought young people unprecedented opportunities.

嘲笑.zh: 他第一次穿西装，被朋友们嘲笑像个服务员。
嘲笑.en: The first time he wore a suit, his friends mocked him for looking like a waiter.

贫困.zh: 这位企业家捐钱给贫困山区建了一所小学。
贫困.en: This entrepreneur donated money to build a primary school in a poor mountain area.

家园.zh: 战争让成千上万的人失去了家园。
家园.en: The war left tens of thousands of people without a home.

含义.zh: 在中国，红色有吉祥、喜庆的含义。
含义.en: In China, the colour red carries connotations of good luck and celebration.

清洗.zh: 空调用了一个夏天，应该请人来清洗一下了。
清洗.en: After a whole summer of use, the air conditioner should be cleaned by a professional.

遥远.zh: 那颗星星离地球非常遥远，它的光要走几千年才能到达。
遥远.en: That star is extremely far from Earth; its light takes thousands of years to arrive.

上台.zh: 颁奖典礼上，获奖的同学一个个上台领奖。
上台.en: At the awards ceremony, the winning students went up on stage one by one to collect their prizes.

气体.zh: 工厂排放的有毒气体对附近居民的健康造成了威胁。
气体.en: Toxic gases emitted by the factory pose a threat to the health of nearby residents.

捧.zh: 他捧起一把清凉的泉水，痛痛快快地洗了把脸。
捧.en: He scooped up a double handful of cool spring water and gave his face a good wash.

层次.zh: 这道菜的味道层次丰富，越吃越香。
层次.en: This dish has rich layers of flavour; the more you eat, the better it tastes.

服从.zh: 球员必须服从教练的安排，不能想怎么踢就怎么踢。
服从.en: Players must obey the coach's arrangements and cannot just play however they like.

渡.zh: 在大家的帮助下，他们一家终于渡过了难关。
渡.en: With everyone's help, the family finally got through their difficulties.

勉强.zh: 他的成绩勉强及格，差一点就没通过。
勉强.en: His score barely passed; he very nearly failed.

大地.zh: 一场大雪过后，大地白茫茫一片，美极了。
大地.en: After a heavy snowfall, the land was a vast expanse of white. It was beautiful.

砖.zh: 他在工地上搬了一天砖，累得腰都直不起来。
砖.en: He carried bricks on the building site all day and was too tired to straighten his back.

案例.zh: 这本书收集了很多成功企业的经营案例。
案例.en: This book collects many business cases from successful companies.

杂.zh: 这家小店卖的东西很杂，从文具到零食应有尽有。
杂.en: This little shop sells all sorts of things, from stationery to snacks.

捉.zh: 孩子们拿着小网兜在花丛中捉蝴蝶，玩得可开心了。
捉.en: The children were catching butterflies among the flowers with little nets, having a great time.

传达.zh: 这幅画通过明亮的颜色传达出一种快乐的情绪。
传达.en: This painting conveys a joyful mood through its bright colours.

图案.zh: 她在蛋糕上用奶油画了一个心形图案。
图案.en: She drew a heart-shaped pattern on the cake with cream.

纪律@6.zh: 这个班的课堂纪律很好，上课时没人说话。
纪律@6.en: This class has good discipline; nobody talks during lessons.

撤销.zh: 由于证据不足，法院撤销了原来的判决。
撤销.en: Because of insufficient evidence, the court overturned the original verdict.

闪电@6.zh: 小狗一看到闪电、听到雷声，就躲到床底下。
闪电@6.en: As soon as the puppy sees lightning and hears thunder, it hides under the bed.

演奏.zh: 这位小提琴家演奏的曲子让观众感动得流泪。
演奏.en: The piece this violinist played moved the audience to tears.

彩票.zh: 听说隔壁的老王中了彩票，一下子成了有钱人。
彩票.en: I heard old Wang next door won the lottery and became rich overnight.

法规.zh: 新的交通法规下个月起实施，酒后驾车将受到更严厉的处罚。
法规.en: The new traffic regulations take effect next month, and drink-driving will be punished more severely.

童话.zh: 下雪后的小镇美得像童话世界一样。
童话.en: After the snow, the little town was as beautiful as a fairy-tale world.

货币.zh: 欧元是很多欧洲国家共同使用的货币。
货币.en: The euro is the currency shared by many European countries.

阻碍.zh: 一棵倒下的大树阻碍了交通，车辆排起了长队。
阻碍.en: A fallen tree blocked traffic, and cars formed long queues.

激发.zh: 这次旅行激发了他学习外语的热情。
激发.en: This trip sparked his enthusiasm for learning foreign languages.

近来.zh: 近来他工作特别忙，经常很晚才回家。
近来.en: Lately he has been especially busy at work and often gets home very late.

相应.zh: 学校针对这个问题采取了相应的措施。
相应.en: The school has taken corresponding measures to deal with this problem.

沟.zh: 他骑车时没看清路，连人带车掉进了路旁的沟里。
沟.en: Not watching the road while cycling, he fell into the roadside ditch, bike and all.

同伴.zh: 小鸟受伤后飞不动了，它的同伴一直在旁边守着它。
同伴.en: The little bird was injured and couldn't fly, and its companion stayed by its side the whole time.

不已.zh: 看到地震后的废墟，在场的人都感叹不已。
不已.en: Seeing the ruins after the earthquake, everyone present sighed again and again.

天然.zh: 这里有一个天然形成的湖泊，四周群山环绕，风景非常美。
天然.en: There is a naturally formed lake here, surrounded by mountains, with beautiful scenery.

违规.zh: 比赛中这名球员多次违规，最后被裁判罚下场了。
违规.en: This player broke the rules several times during the match and was finally sent off by the referee.

金额.zh: 这份合同的金额高达五千万元，是公司今年最大的一笔生意。
金额.en: This contract is worth as much as 50 million yuan, the company's biggest deal this year.

舌头.zh: 小狗伸着舌头，在太阳下喘气。
舌头.en: The puppy was panting in the sun with its tongue hanging out.

工地.zh: 他大学毕业后在建筑公司上班，经常要去工地检查进度。
工地.en: After graduating he joined a construction company and often has to go to building sites to check progress.

周边.zh: 北京周边有很多适合周末游玩的地方。
周边.en: There are many places around Beijing that are good for weekend trips.

专利.zh: 这位工程师一共获得了二十多项发明专利。
专利.en: This engineer has been granted more than twenty invention patents.

特意.zh: 知道你要来，他特意请了一天假去机场接你。
特意.en: Knowing you were coming, he specially took a day off to pick you up at the airport.

捐款.zh: 这笔捐款将全部用于帮助山区的孩子上学。
捐款.en: All of this donation will be used to help children in the mountains go to school.

主演.zh: 她是这部电视剧的主演，最近走到哪儿都有人认出她。
主演.en: She's the lead in this TV series, and lately people recognize her wherever she goes.

合成.zh: 植物通过光合作用合成自身需要的营养物质。
合成.en: Plants synthesise the nutrients they need through photosynthesis.

预料.zh: 谁也没预料到这场雨会下得这么大。
预料.en: No one expected this rain to be so heavy.

约束.zh: 合同对双方都有约束力，任何一方都不能随意违反。
约束.en: The contract is binding on both parties, and neither may breach it at will.

胡子.zh: 他好几天没刮胡子了，看上去老了十岁。
胡子.en: He hasn't shaved for several days and looks ten years older.

首要.zh: 对于新手司机来说，安全是首要的。
首要.en: For new drivers, safety is of primary importance.

公告.zh: 因为设备维修，商场门口贴出了暂停营业的公告。
公告.en: Because of equipment repairs, a notice of temporary closure was posted at the mall entrance.

恶劣@6.zh: 工厂的工作环境非常恶劣，很多工人都辞职了。
恶劣@6.en: Working conditions at the factory were terrible, and many workers quit.

过后.zh: 暴风雨过后，天边出现了一道美丽的彩虹。
过后.en: After the storm, a beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky.

答复.zh: 这件事我得跟家人商量一下，明天再给你一个明确的答复。
答复.en: I need to talk this over with my family; I'll give you a definite answer tomorrow.

传输.zh: 新一代网络的数据传输速度比以前快了好几倍。
传输.en: Data transmission on the new generation of networks is several times faster than before.

同行.zh: 他的设计水平很高，连不少同行都很佩服他。
同行.en: His design skills are excellent; even many people in his own profession admire him.

利息@6.zh: 他向银行借了一笔钱，每个月都要还利息。
利息@6.en: He borrowed money from the bank and has to pay interest every month.

急救.zh: 老人突然晕倒在地，路过的医生马上对他进行了急救。
急救.en: The old man suddenly fainted, and a passing doctor immediately gave him emergency treatment.

主张@6.zh: 这位专家主张孩子应该多到户外活动。
主张@6.en: This expert advocates that children should spend more time outdoors.

辣椒@6.zh: 我不太能吃辣，请别在菜里放辣椒。
辣椒@6.en: I can't handle spicy food; please don't put chilli in the dish.

跟随.zh: 她十八岁就跟随父亲学习做生意。
跟随.en: At eighteen she began learning business by following her father.

罕见.zh: 这种蓝色的蝴蝶非常罕见，很多人从来没见过。
罕见.en: This blue butterfly is very rare; many people have never seen one.

潮流.zh: 这款设计顺应了环保的潮流，很受年轻人欢迎。
潮流.en: This design follows the green trend and is very popular with young people.

恰恰.zh: 很多人觉得休息浪费时间，可适当休息恰恰能提高效率。
恰恰.en: Many people think rest wastes time, but proper rest is precisely what improves efficiency.

村庄.zh: 洪水过后，这个村庄的房屋几乎全被冲毁了。
村庄.en: After the flood, almost every house in this village had been washed away.

打动.zh: 这首歌的歌词很简单，却打动了无数听众的心。
打动.en: The lyrics of this song are simple, yet they have touched the hearts of countless listeners.

争吵.zh: 隔壁夫妻经常大声争吵，邻居们都受不了了。
争吵.en: The couple next door often argue loudly, and the neighbours can't stand it any more.

推销.zh: 一个年轻人敲开我家的门，向我推销保险。
推销.en: A young man knocked on my door and tried to sell me insurance.

机制.zh: 科学家们至今还没有完全弄清这种疾病的发病机制。
机制.en: Scientists still haven't fully worked out the mechanism by which this disease develops.

深夜.zh: 已经是深夜了，街上几乎看不到行人。
深夜.en: It was already late at night, and there was hardly anyone on the streets.

透过.zh: 透过现象看本质，才能找到问题的真正原因。
透过.en: Only by looking through the surface to the essence can you find the real cause of a problem.

发育.zh: 这棵小树因为缺少阳光，发育得很不好。
发育.en: This sapling has grown poorly because it lacks sunlight.

一带.zh: 长江中下游一带夏天又热又潮湿。
一带.en: The area along the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze is hot and humid in summer.

热门.zh: 这个景点是今年夏天最热门的旅游地之一。
热门.en: This attraction is one of the hottest tourist destinations this summer.

终点.zh: 这趟公交车的终点是火车站，你坐到底就行。
终点.en: This bus terminates at the train station, so just ride it to the end.

精确.zh: 这台电子秤可以精确到零点一克，很适合做蛋糕时用。
精确.en: This digital scale is precise to 0.1 grams, which makes it ideal for baking.

面部.zh: 这款手机可以通过面部识别解锁，非常方便。
面部.en: This phone can be unlocked with facial recognition, which is very convenient.

规范.zh: 这家工厂的操作流程很规范，很少出安全事故。
规范.en: This factory's operating procedures are well standardised, and accidents rarely happen.

中断.zh: 由于网络中断，视频会议只好暂停。
中断.en: Because the internet connection was cut off, the video meeting had to be paused.

拜访.zh: 新年期间，我们一家去拜访了几位亲戚。
拜访.en: Over the New Year, our family paid visits to several relatives.

医药.zh: 随着人口老龄化，医药行业的市场需求越来越大。
医药.en: As the population ages, market demand in the pharmaceutical industry keeps growing.

原料@6.zh: 由于原料价格上涨，工厂的成本提高了不少。
原料@6.en: Because raw material prices rose, the factory's costs went up considerably.

动态.zh: 你可以关注我们的官方账号，了解最新的活动动态。
动态.en: You can follow our official account to keep up with the latest event news.

透明@6.zh: 公司的财务应该公开透明，让员工放心。
透明@6.en: A company's finances should be open and transparent so that staff can feel at ease.

调节.zh: 这台空调可以自动调节室内的温度和湿度。
调节.en: This air conditioner can automatically regulate indoor temperature and humidity.

频繁.zh: 这台旧电脑最近频繁死机，该换一台新的了。
频繁.en: This old computer has been crashing frequently lately; it's time to get a new one.

供给.zh: 市场上鸡蛋的供给大于需求，所以价格一直在下降。
供给.en: The supply of eggs on the market exceeds demand, so prices keep falling.

突发.zh: 他昨晚突发心脏病，被紧急送进了医院。
突发.en: He suddenly had a heart attack last night and was rushed to hospital.

听取.zh: 在做最后决定之前，校长认真听取了老师和家长的建议。
听取.en: Before making the final decision, the principal listened carefully to the suggestions of teachers and parents.

数目.zh: 五十万对刚工作的年轻人来说，可不是一笔小数目。
数目.en: Half a million is no small sum for a young person just starting work.

当选.zh: 他以最高票数当选为学生会主席。
当选.en: He was elected president of the student union with the most votes.

散发.zh: 志愿者们在地铁站门口向路人散发环保宣传单。
散发.en: Volunteers handed out environmental leaflets to passers-by at the subway entrance.

艺人.zh: 街头艺人在广场上表演杂技，吸引了很多游客。
艺人.en: Street performers were doing acrobatics in the square, attracting many tourists.

出名.zh: 这个小镇因为出产好茶而出名。
出名.en: This small town is well known for producing fine tea.

项链@6.zh: 她脖子上戴着一条闪闪发光的珍珠项链。
项链@6.en: She is wearing a shining pearl necklace around her neck.

杰出.zh: 他为中国足球的发展做出了杰出的贡献。
杰出.en: He made an outstanding contribution to the development of Chinese football.

鼓舞@6.zh: 教练的一番话鼓舞了全体队员的士气。
鼓舞@6.en: The coach's words boosted the morale of the whole team.

抄@6.zh: 老师让我们把黑板上的生词抄在本子上。
抄@6.en: The teacher told us to copy the new words on the blackboard into our notebooks.

棍.zh: 他从地上捡起一根棍，把挡在路中间的树枝拨开了。
棍.en: He picked up a stick from the ground and pushed aside the branches blocking the path.

佩服@6.zh: 她一边工作一边读完了博士，大家都很佩服她。
佩服@6.en: She finished her PhD while working, and everyone admires her.

树立.zh: 这家企业很注重树立良好的品牌形象。
树立.en: This company puts great emphasis on building a good brand image.

妨碍@6.zh: 你把车停在门口，会妨碍别人进出。
妨碍@6.en: If you park at the door, you'll get in the way of people going in and out.

消耗.zh: 长时间开着空调会消耗大量电能。
消耗.en: Running the air conditioner for long periods uses up a great deal of electricity.

以免.zh: 使用前请仔细阅读说明书，以免造成不必要的损失。
以免.en: Please read the instructions carefully before use to avoid unnecessary damage.

平凡.zh: 她只是一个平凡的家庭主妇，却把三个孩子都培养成了医生。
平凡.en: She is just an ordinary housewife, yet she raised all three of her children to become doctors.

花生@6.zh: 每年秋天，奶奶都要去地里收花生。
花生@6.en: Every autumn, Grandma goes to the field to harvest peanuts.

听话.zh: 我的电脑最近一点儿也不听话，动不动就死机。
听话.en: My computer won't do what it's told lately; it freezes at the drop of a hat.

言语.zh: 有时候一个拥抱比任何言语都更能安慰人。
言语.en: Sometimes a hug comforts people more than any words can.

前景.zh: 专家认为，人工智能在医疗领域的应用前景十分广阔。
前景.en: Experts believe the prospects for applying AI in medicine are very broad.

传真.zh: 现在大家都用电子邮件，办公室里的传真机已经很少用了。
传真.en: Everyone uses email now, so the office fax machine is hardly used any more.

片刻.zh: 他沉默了片刻，然后才回答我的问题。
片刻.en: He was silent for a moment before answering my question.

隐私.zh: 这款软件因为收集用户隐私受到了批评。
隐私.en: This app has been criticised for collecting users' private information.

庞大.zh: 他们家族非常庞大，过年时一张桌子根本坐不下。
庞大.en: Their family is enormous; at New Year one table can't possibly seat everyone.

极为.zh: 这种鸟数量极为稀少，已经被列为保护动物。
极为.en: This bird is extremely rare and has been listed as a protected species.

糖果.zh: 牙医提醒孩子们少吃糖果，饭后要记得刷牙。
糖果.en: The dentist reminded the children to eat fewer sweets and to brush their teeth after meals.

智力.zh: 研究表明，充足的睡眠对儿童的智力发展非常重要。
智力.en: Research shows that enough sleep is very important for children's intellectual development.

液体.zh: 水在零度以下会从液体变成固体。
液体.en: Below zero degrees, water turns from a liquid into a solid.

资本.zh: 开公司需要一大笔资本，他打算先向银行贷款。
资本.en: Starting a company needs a lot of capital, so he plans to take out a bank loan first.

券.zh: 凭这张入场券，您可以免费参观博物馆的所有展厅。
券.en: With this admission ticket, you can visit all the museum's halls for free.

误解.zh: 很多人误解了这句话的意思，其实它是在表扬人。
误解.en: Many people misunderstand this sentence; it is actually praising someone.

宴会@6.zh: 结婚那天，他们在酒店举办了一场盛大的宴会。
宴会@6.en: On their wedding day, they held a grand banquet at a hotel.

书面.zh: 请假必须提交书面申请，只是口头说一声是不够的。
书面.en: Leave requires a written application; just saying so verbally isn't enough.

岸@6.zh: 船慢慢靠岸，乘客们开始下船。
岸@6.en: The boat slowly came to shore, and the passengers began to get off.

有机.zh: 这些水果种植时不用化肥和农药，是真正的有机食品。
有机.en: These fruits are grown without chemical fertilizers or pesticides; they're genuinely organic food.

次数.zh: 随着年龄增长，奶奶去医院的次数越来越多。
次数.en: As she gets older, Grandma goes to the hospital more and more often.

素质.zh: 这项运动对运动员的身体素质要求很高。
素质.en: This sport places high demands on athletes' physical fitness.

联想.zh: 一提到夏天，人们就会联想到西瓜和冰淇淋。
联想.en: At the mention of summer, people think of watermelon and ice cream.

纠纷.zh: 邻居之间因为停车位问题发生了纠纷。
纠纷.en: The neighbours got into a dispute over parking spaces.

浴室.zh: 这套房子有两个卧室和一个带浴缸的浴室。
浴室.en: This flat has two bedrooms and a bathroom with a bathtub.

起点.zh: 毕业不是结束，而是人生新的起点。
起点.en: Graduation isn't an end but a new starting point in life.

榜样.zh: 哥哥学习很努力，是我学习的榜样。
榜样.en: My older brother studies very hard and is my role model.

创建.zh: 打开软件后，先点击右上角的按钮创建一个新账号。
创建.en: After opening the app, first click the button in the top right to create a new account.

后者.zh: 中医和西医各有优点：前者注重调理，后者见效更快。
后者.en: Chinese and Western medicine each have strengths: the former focuses on regulating the body, while the latter works faster.

不顾.zh: 他不顾自己的安全，跳进河里救起了落水的孩子。
不顾.en: Regardless of his own safety, he jumped into the river and rescued the child who had fallen in.

剩余.zh: 工厂把剩余的产品低价卖给了附近的商店。
剩余.en: The factory sold its surplus products cheaply to nearby shops.

差异.zh: 由于文化差异，两国人对同一个手势的理解完全不同。
差异.en: Because of cultural differences, people in the two countries understand the same gesture completely differently.

气味.zh: 这种花的气味能赶走蚊子。
气味.en: The scent of this flower can drive mosquitoes away.

推测.zh: 科学家根据化石推测，这种动物生活在一亿年前。
推测.en: Based on the fossils, scientists infer that this animal lived a hundred million years ago.

点燃.zh: 奥运会开幕式上，最后一名火炬手点燃了主火炬。
点燃.en: At the Olympic opening ceremony, the final torchbearer lit the main cauldron.

思念.zh: 这首诗表达了诗人对故乡深深的思念。
思念.en: This poem expresses the poet's deep longing for his hometown.

刹车.zh: 这辆自行车的刹车坏了，骑起来很危险。
刹车.en: The brakes on this bicycle are broken, so it is dangerous to ride.

歇@6.zh: 你忙了一整天了，快去床上歇着吧。
歇@6.en: You've been busy all day; go and lie down for a rest.

粥.zh: 胃不舒服的时候，喝点小米粥最好。
粥.en: When your stomach is upset, a little millet porridge is best.

原理.zh: 这个魔术的原理其实很简单，一说你就明白。
原理.en: The principle behind this magic trick is actually simple; you'll get it as soon as I explain.

层面.zh: 改革需要在国家层面统一规划，地方才能更好地执行。
层面.en: Reform needs unified planning at the national level so that local governments can carry it out better.

符号.zh: 加号和减号是数学中最常用的符号。
符号.en: The plus and minus signs are the most commonly used symbols in maths.

盛.zh: 这个碗太小了，盛不下这么多汤。
盛.en: This bowl is too small to hold so much soup.

清晨.zh: 每天清晨，爷爷都会到河边去钓鱼。
清晨.en: Every day in the early morning, Grandpa goes fishing by the river.

民间.zh: 剪纸是一种历史悠久的民间艺术。
民间.en: Paper-cutting is a folk art with a long history.

占有.zh: 他对女朋友的占有欲太强，连她和朋友吃饭都要管。
占有.en: He's too possessive of his girlfriend; he even wants a say when she has dinner with friends.

外来.zh: “咖啡”“沙发”这些词都是外来词，最早来自其他语言。
外来.en: Words like 'coffee' and 'sofa' are loanwords that originally came from other languages.

导师.zh: 读研究生期间，选一位好导师非常重要。
导师.en: When doing a graduate degree, choosing a good supervisor is very important.

开头.zh: 万事开头难，坚持下去就会越来越顺利。
开头.en: Every beginning is hard; keep at it and things will go more and more smoothly.

倾听.zh: 当朋友难过时，我们最需要做的就是静静地倾听。
倾听.en: When a friend is sad, what we most need to do is listen quietly.

消毒.zh: 餐厅的碗筷每天都要用高温消毒。
消毒.en: The restaurant's bowls and chopsticks must be sterilised at high temperature every day.

原先.zh: 他原先是一名中学老师，后来改行做了律师。
原先.en: He was originally a secondary-school teacher, but later switched careers to become a lawyer.

枕头.zh: 他一躺到枕头上就睡着了。
枕头.en: He fell asleep the moment his head hit the pillow.

探讨.zh: 这次研讨会主要探讨人工智能对教育的影响。
探讨.en: This seminar mainly explores the impact of AI on education.

主导.zh: 在这次谈判中，我方一直占据主导地位。
主导.en: Throughout these negotiations, our side held the dominant position.

论坛.zh: 下周，北京将举办一场关于人工智能的国际论坛。
论坛.en: Next week Beijing will host an international forum on artificial intelligence.

力度.zh: 按摩的力度要适中，太轻没效果，太重又会疼。
力度.en: Massage pressure should be moderate: too light has no effect, too hard will hurt.

拐.zh: 出租车拐进一条小巷，在一家饭馆门口停了下来。
拐.en: The taxi turned into a small lane and stopped in front of a restaurant.

备用.zh: 我在门口的花盆下面放了一把备用钥匙，以防忘带。
备用.en: I keep a spare key under the flowerpot by the door in case I forget mine.

型号.zh: 买打印机墨盒之前，要先查清楚打印机的型号。
型号.en: Before buying ink cartridges, check your printer's model number first.

发放.zh: 志愿者们在路口向市民免费发放口罩。
发放.en: Volunteers were handing out free face masks to residents at the intersection.

排练.zh: 合唱团每周三晚上在礼堂排练。
排练.en: The choir rehearses in the auditorium every Wednesday evening.

弱点.zh: 贪小便宜是人性的弱点，骗子正是利用了这一点。
弱点.en: Wanting something for nothing is a weakness of human nature, and that is exactly what swindlers exploit.

学员.zh: 驾校的教练对每一位学员都非常耐心。
学员.en: The driving school instructor is very patient with every learner.

专注.zh: 开车时一定要专注，不能一边开车一边看手机。
专注.en: You must stay focused when driving; you can't look at your phone while you drive.

漏洞.zh: 他的说法前后矛盾，到处是漏洞，没人相信他。
漏洞.en: His story contradicts itself and is full of holes; nobody believes him.

损坏.zh: 借来的书如果损坏了，要按价赔偿。
损坏.en: If a borrowed book is damaged, you must pay for it at its value.

才华.zh: 这次比赛给年轻设计师提供了一个展示才华的机会。
才华.en: This competition gives young designers a chance to show off their talent.

验证.zh: 登录前，系统要求用户通过手机短信验证身份。
验证.en: Before logging in, the system requires users to verify their identity by text message.

水面.zh: 一条大鱼突然跳出水面，把钓鱼的人吓了一跳。
水面.en: A big fish suddenly leapt out of the water, startling the angler.

栏.zh: 报名表上的“特长”一栏，他想了半天也不知道该填什么。
栏.en: He thought for ages about the "special skills" field on the application form but had no idea what to write.

传染@6.zh: 这种病不会传染，你不用担心。
传染@6.en: This illness isn't contagious, so you needn't worry.

查询.zh: 考试成绩下周公布，考生可以登录官网查询。
查询.en: Exam results will be released next week; candidates can log in to the official website to check them.

歌唱.zh: 鸟儿在枝头歌唱，春天真的来了。
歌唱.en: Birds are singing on the branches; spring has really arrived.

求助.zh: 迷路的游客只好向当地警察求助。
求助.en: The lost tourists had no choice but to ask the local police for help.

蛋白质.zh: 运动后适当补充蛋白质，有助于肌肉恢复。
蛋白质.en: Taking in some protein after exercise helps the muscles recover.

维生素.zh: 长期缺乏维生素C，容易得坏血病。
维生素.en: A long-term lack of vitamin C can easily lead to scurvy.

进度.zh: 老师根据学生的学习情况调整了教学进度。
进度.en: The teacher adjusted the pace of teaching according to how the students were doing.

精致.zh: 这家餐厅的菜不仅好吃，而且摆盘也非常精致。
精致.en: This restaurant's food is not only tasty but also exquisitely presented.

柔软.zh: 这张床垫太柔软了，睡久了腰反而会疼。
柔软.en: This mattress is too soft; sleeping on it for long actually makes your back hurt.

值班.zh: 春节期间，公司安排了几名员工轮流值班。
值班.en: During the Spring Festival, the company arranged for several employees to take turns on duty.

运营.zh: 她负责公司社交媒体账号的日常运营。
运营.en: She's in charge of the day-to-day running of the company's social media accounts.

一贯.zh: 这家公司一贯重视产品质量，很少收到投诉。
一贯.en: This company has always valued product quality and rarely receives complaints.

保管.zh: 你按我说的方法做，保管不会出错。
保管.en: Do it the way I told you, and you certainly won't go wrong.

卡片.zh: 生日那天，我收到了同学们亲手做的卡片。
卡片.en: On my birthday I received handmade cards from my classmates.

视力.zh: 他的视力不太好，坐在后排就看不清黑板。
视力.en: His eyesight isn't good; sitting in the back row, he can't see the blackboard clearly.

心目.zh: 这家餐厅一直是大家心目中最好吃的火锅店。
心目.en: This restaurant has always been everyone's idea of the best hotpot place.

滑雪.zh: 他第一次滑雪就摔断了腿，从此再也不敢上雪场了。
滑雪.en: He broke his leg the first time he went skiing and has never dared to go to a ski resort since.

胃口@6.zh: 看到满桌子的好菜，大家胃口大开。
胃口@6.en: Seeing a table full of delicious dishes, everyone's appetite was whetted.

高尚.zh: 他品德高尚，常常把自己的工资捐给有需要的人。
高尚.en: He is a man of noble character who often donates his salary to people in need.

负面.zh: 长期熬夜会给身体带来很多负面影响。
负面.en: Staying up late over a long period has many negative effects on your health.

珍珠.zh: 这种奶茶里加了很多黑色的珍珠，很受欢迎。
珍珠.en: This milk tea has lots of black pearls in it and is very popular.

采集.zh: 蜜蜂一整天都在花丛中忙着采集花粉。
采集.en: The bees spend the whole day busily collecting pollen among the flowers.

辅助.zh: 这个软件可以辅助医生更快地诊断疾病。
辅助.en: This software can help doctors diagnose illnesses more quickly.

生态.zh: 大量砍伐树木破坏了当地的生态平衡。
生态.en: Large-scale tree felling has upset the local ecological balance.

延伸.zh: 老师给我们推荐了几本课外延伸阅读的书。
延伸.en: The teacher recommended several books to us for extended reading outside class.

加以.zh: 这些建议很有价值，我们会认真加以研究。
加以.en: These suggestions are very valuable; we will study them carefully.

痒@6.zh: 这件毛衣穿在身上有点儿痒，我想换一件。
痒@6.en: This sweater feels a bit itchy on me; I want to change it.

设想.zh: 我们设想在山顶建一座小型天文台，供学生观察星空。
设想.en: We envisage building a small observatory on the hilltop for students to observe the stars.

再生.zh: 壁虎的尾巴断了以后还能再生。
再生.en: A gecko's tail can grow back after it breaks off.

崭新.zh: 搬进崭新的教学楼后，同学们都很兴奋。
崭新.en: After moving into the brand-new teaching building, the students were all excited.

高峰.zh: 节假日是旅游的高峰期，景点到处都是人。
高峰.en: Holidays are the peak travel season, and the sights are packed with people.

月球.zh: 科学家正在研究将来能否在月球表面建立基地。
月球.en: Scientists are studying whether a base could one day be built on the lunar surface.

老太太.zh: 楼下的老太太八十多岁了，每天还坚持去公园散步。
老太太.en: The old lady downstairs is over eighty but still goes for a walk in the park every day.

躲避.zh: 听到警报声后，居民们迅速躲避到附近的地下室里。
躲避.en: When they heard the siren, residents quickly took shelter in a nearby basement.

疲劳@6.zh: 长时间看电脑容易造成眼睛疲劳。
疲劳@6.en: Looking at a computer for a long time easily causes eye fatigue.

拾.zh: 秋天，孩子们在树下拾落叶，准备做书签。
拾.en: In autumn, the children pick up fallen leaves under the trees to make bookmarks.

温和.zh: 王老师性格温和，从来没对学生发过脾气。
温和.en: Mr Wang has a gentle temperament and has never lost his temper with students.

目录@6.zh: 这个网站的商品目录分得很清楚，找东西很方便。
目录@6.en: This website's product catalogue is clearly organised, so it's easy to find things.

耽误@6.zh: 别因为玩游戏耽误了学习。
耽误@6.en: Don't let gaming hold up your studies.

景象.zh: 站在山上往下看，眼前的景象让所有人都惊呆了。
景象.en: Looking down from the mountain, everyone was stunned by the sight before them.

淋.zh: 最后在蛋糕上淋一层巧克力酱就做好了。
淋.en: Finally, pour a layer of chocolate sauce over the cake and it's done.

彩虹@6.zh: 瀑布旁边的水雾里常常能看到一道彩虹。
彩虹@6.en: A rainbow can often be seen in the mist beside the waterfall.

后退.zh: 这次考试他的排名后退了十几名，父母很着急。
后退.en: He dropped more than ten places in the rankings in this exam, and his parents are worried.

枝.zh: 一只小鸟站在树枝上，欢快地唱着歌。
枝.en: A little bird perched on a branch, singing happily.

物体.zh: 物体从高处落下时，速度会越来越快。
物体.en: When an object falls from a height, it falls faster and faster.

职员.zh: 这家公司规模不大，只有二十几名职员。
职员.en: This company isn't big; it has only twenty-odd staff.

商标.zh: 这家公司的商标是一只红色的小鸟。
商标.en: This company's logo is a little red bird.

旅途.zh: 祝你旅途愉快，到了记得给我打个电话。
旅途.en: Have a pleasant trip, and remember to give me a call when you arrive.

本能.zh: 刚出生的小海龟凭着本能爬向大海。
本能.en: Newly hatched sea turtles crawl towards the sea by instinct.

塑造.zh: 家庭环境对孩子性格的塑造有很大影响。
塑造.en: The home environment has a big influence on shaping a child's character.

薪水.zh: 他这个月的薪水全都花在了房租上。
薪水.en: He spent his entire salary this month on rent.

衡量.zh: 他仔细衡量了两份工作的利弊，最后决定留在老家。
衡量.en: He carefully weighed the pros and cons of the two jobs and finally decided to stay in his hometown.

师父.zh: 这位少林寺的师父每天天不亮就起来练功。
师父.en: This master from the Shaolin Temple gets up before dawn every day to practise martial arts.

健全.zh: 学校教育的目的是培养身心健全的人。
健全.en: The aim of school education is to develop people who are sound in body and mind.

先前.zh: 他先前在一家银行工作，后来自己开了公司。
先前.en: He previously worked at a bank and later started his own company.

心爱.zh: 他终于把心爱的姑娘娶回了家。
心爱.en: He finally married the girl he loved.

调动.zh: 因为丈夫工作调动，他们全家从北京搬到了广州。
调动.en: Because the husband was transferred at work, the whole family moved from Beijing to Guangzhou.

默默.zh: 听完批评，他什么也没说，只是默默地低下了头。
默默.en: After hearing the criticism, he said nothing and just silently lowered his head.

辅导@6.zh: 考试前，王老师每天放学后给我们辅导数学。
辅导@6.en: Before the exam, Teacher Wang tutored us in maths every day after school.

未必@6.zh: 他说明天会来，可是我觉得他未必有时间。
未必@6.en: He said he'd come tomorrow, but I don't think he'll necessarily have time.

建筑物.zh: 地震中，这一带很多老旧的建筑物都倒塌了。
建筑物.en: In the earthquake, many old buildings in this area collapsed.

采购.zh: 饭店的厨师每天早上五点就去市场采购新鲜蔬菜。
采购.en: The restaurant's chef goes to the market at five every morning to buy fresh vegetables.

旅程.zh: 这次自驾游的旅程全长两千多公里，一路经过五个省。
旅程.en: This road trip covers more than 2,000 kilometres and passes through five provinces.

本土.zh: 很多外国快餐品牌进入中国后，都推出了本土化的菜品。
本土.en: After entering China, many foreign fast-food brands launched localized dishes.

阻挡.zh: 山上的树林能阻挡风沙，保护山下的农田。
阻挡.en: The forest on the mountain can block wind and sand and protect the farmland below.

恰当.zh: 在正式场合穿运动服显得不太恰当。
恰当.en: Wearing sportswear on a formal occasion seems rather inappropriate.

疑惑.zh: 他疑惑地看着我，不明白我为什么突然笑了。
疑惑.en: He looked at me, puzzled, not understanding why I had suddenly laughed.

监测.zh: 这块手表可以随时监测心率和睡眠情况。
监测.en: This watch can monitor your heart rate and sleep at any time.

称号.zh: 她把这个荣誉称号看作是对自己多年工作的肯定。
称号.en: She sees this honorary title as recognition of her years of work.

叉.zh: 老师在他写错的地方画了一个叉。
叉.en: The teacher drew a cross where he had made a mistake.

追究.zh: 如果产品出了质量问题，消费者有权追究商家的责任。
追究.en: If a product has quality problems, consumers have the right to hold the seller accountable.

拖延.zh: 他有拖延的坏习惯，作业总是最后一天才写。
拖延.en: He has a bad habit of procrastinating and always does his homework on the last day.

文物.zh: 工人在修路时挖出了一批古代文物，马上报告了有关部门。
文物.en: While repairing the road, workers dug up a batch of ancient relics and reported it to the authorities at once.

个体.zh: 他辞职后做起了个体户，开了一家小面馆。
个体.en: After quitting his job he became self-employed and opened a small noodle shop.

墙壁.zh: 这栋楼的隔音不好，隔着墙壁都能听到邻居说话。
墙壁.en: This building has poor soundproofing; you can hear the neighbours talking through the wall.

开关.zh: 他在黑暗中摸了半天，才找到墙上的开关。
开关.en: He groped around in the dark for ages before finding the switch on the wall.

昂贵.zh: 因为一次小小的失误，公司付出了昂贵的代价。
昂贵.en: Because of one small slip, the company paid a heavy price.

仍旧.zh: 多年过去了，这家小店的味道仍旧没变。
仍旧.en: Many years have passed, yet the food at this little shop still tastes the same.

圆满.zh: 在大家的努力下，这次运动会圆满结束了。
圆满.en: Thanks to everyone's efforts, the sports meet came to a successful close.

古典@6.zh: 这座城市有很多古典风格的建筑。
古典@6.en: This city has many buildings in the classical style.

大方@6.zh: 她穿得简单大方，给面试官留下了好印象。
大方@6.en: She dressed simply and tastefully, leaving a good impression on the interviewer.

启发@6.zh: 这部电影启发我重新思考人生的意义。
启发@6.en: This film inspired me to rethink the meaning of life.

壶@6.zh: 客人来了，奶奶赶紧泡了一壶绿茶。
壶@6.en: When the guests arrived, Grandma quickly made a pot of green tea.

步骤@6.zh: 做这道菜一共有五个步骤，第一步是洗菜。
步骤@6.en: Making this dish takes five steps; the first is washing the vegetables.

订单.zh: 你在网上买的东西发货了吗？我帮你查一下订单。
订单.en: Has the stuff you bought online been shipped? Let me check the order for you.

远程.zh: 技术人员通过网络远程帮我修好了电脑。
远程.en: The technician fixed my computer remotely over the internet.

选拔.zh: 这家公司通过考试选拔优秀的年轻人当管理人员。
选拔.en: This company selects outstanding young people as managers through examinations.

人事@6.zh: 新员工入职的材料要交到人事处。
人事@6.en: New employees must hand in their onboarding documents to the personnel office.

当今.zh: 他是当今世界上最优秀的钢琴家之一。
当今.en: He is one of the finest pianists in the world today.

可行.zh: 专家们讨论后认为，这个方案在技术上是可行的。
可行.en: After discussion, the experts concluded that the plan is technically feasible.

恰好.zh: 你要找的那本书，我恰好有一本，明天带给你。
恰好.en: As it happens I have a copy of the book you're looking for; I'll bring it tomorrow.

进化.zh: 鸟类的翅膀是经过几百万年慢慢进化而成的。
进化.en: Birds' wings slowly evolved over millions of years.

出示@6.zh: 进入考场时，考生需要出示准考证。
