出示@6.en: On entering the exam hall, candidates must show their admission ticket.

洪水.zh: 大雨下了一个星期，河里的洪水快要漫过大堤了。
洪水.en: After a week of heavy rain, the floodwater in the river is about to top the embankment.

风光.zh: 儿子考上了名牌大学，父母在亲戚面前觉得特别风光。
风光.en: When their son got into a top university, his parents felt very proud in front of their relatives.

为难.zh: 他已经尽力了，你就别再为难他了。
为难.en: He has already done his best, so stop making things difficult for him.

改编.zh: 他把一首老歌改编成了摇滚版，在网上很火。
改编.en: He rearranged an old song as a rock version, and it's a big hit online.

吸取@6.zh: 他善于吸取别人的经验，所以进步得很快。
吸取@6.en: He's good at learning from others' experience, so he has made rapid progress.

心愿.zh: 老人生前最大的心愿就是再见儿子一面。
心愿.en: The old man's greatest wish before he died was to see his son once more.

股市.zh: 他每天早上第一件事就是打开手机看股市行情。
股市.en: The first thing he does every morning is check the stock market on his phone.

至关重要.zh: 充足的睡眠对青少年的成长至关重要。
至关重要.en: Getting enough sleep is vital for teenagers' growth.

充实.zh: 他利用业余时间读书，不断充实自己。
充实.en: He uses his spare time to read, constantly enriching himself.

识.zh: 你真识货，这可是今年最好的茶叶。
识.en: You really know quality; this is the best tea of the year.

往后.zh: 这次就算了，往后再迟到，就要扣工资了。
往后.en: I'll let it go this time, but from now on if you're late again, your pay will be docked.

处处.zh: 他刚来公司，处处小心，生怕出错。
处处.en: He's new at the company and careful in everything, afraid of making mistakes.

不至于.zh: 现在出发的话，应该不至于迟到。
不至于.en: If we leave now, we shouldn't end up being late.

同类.zh: 有些动物会攻击自己的同类，争夺食物和地盘。
同类.en: Some animals attack their own kind, competing for food and territory.

醋@6.zh: 看到男朋友跟别的女孩聊天，她有点儿吃醋。
醋@6.en: Seeing her boyfriend chatting with another girl, she got a little jealous.

身心.zh: 连续加班一个月，他感到身心疲惫。
身心.en: After a month of nonstop overtime, he felt physically and mentally exhausted.

夸@6.zh: 邻居们都夸这个小姑娘懂事又有礼貌。
夸@6.en: The neighbours all praise this little girl for being sensible and polite.

干燥@6.zh: 饼干要放在干燥的地方，不然容易变软。
干燥@6.en: Biscuits should be kept in a dry place, or they'll go soft.

不禁.zh: 想起多年没见的外公，他不禁流下了眼泪。
不禁.en: Thinking of the grandfather he hadn't seen for years, he couldn't help shedding tears.

嗓子@6.zh: 那位歌手的嗓子很好，唱高音一点儿也不费力。
嗓子@6.en: That singer has a great voice; high notes cost him no effort at all.

使劲.zh: 听到这个好消息，他使劲地点了点头。
使劲.en: Hearing the good news, he nodded hard.

支出.zh: 为了买房，他们大大减少了日常生活的支出。
支出.en: To buy a home, they greatly cut their everyday expenses.

中奖.zh: 恭喜您中奖了！请凭有效证件到服务台领奖。
中奖.en: Congratulations, you've won a prize! Please bring valid ID to the service desk to collect it.

诗歌.zh: 这次诗歌朗诵比赛，有一百多名学生报名参加。
诗歌.en: More than a hundred students signed up for this poetry recitation contest.

征求@6.zh: 定装修方案之前，他先征求了家里每个人的看法。
征求@6.en: Before settling on the renovation plan, he first asked everyone in the family for their views.

全程.zh: 比赛将进行全程直播，观众可以在网上观看。
全程.en: The whole match will be broadcast live, and viewers can watch online.

认知.zh: 随着年龄增长，老人的认知能力会逐渐下降。
认知.en: With age, elderly people's cognitive abilities gradually decline.

周期.zh: 这个项目的研发周期比较长，至少需要两年。
周期.en: This project's development cycle is quite long; it needs at least two years.

坡.zh: 这条街的坡太陡了，推着自行车上去都很费劲。
坡.en: The slope of this street is so steep that even pushing a bike up it is hard work.

氛围.zh: 春节快到了，街上到处挂着红灯笼，节日氛围越来越浓。
氛围.en: Spring Festival is coming; red lanterns hang everywhere in the streets and the festive atmosphere is growing.

求婚.zh: 交往三年后，他终于鼓起勇气求婚了，没想到被拒绝了。
求婚.en: After dating for three years he finally plucked up the courage to propose, but to his surprise he was turned down.

信赖.zh: 这个品牌的质量一直很好，深受消费者信赖。
信赖.en: This brand's quality has always been good, and consumers trust it deeply.

口号.zh: 环保不能只喊口号，要从身边的小事做起。
口号.en: Protecting the environment isn't just about shouting slogans; it starts with little things in daily life.

拆除.zh: 市政府决定拆除路边所有违规建造的广告牌。
拆除.en: The city government decided to remove all illegally built billboards along the roads.

蜜蜂@6.zh: 那只蜜蜂在我耳边嗡嗡地飞了半天。
蜜蜂@6.en: That bee buzzed around my ear for ages.

品尝.zh: 到了成都，一定要品尝一下地道的火锅。
品尝.en: When you get to Chengdu, you must try some authentic hotpot.

一模一样.zh: 她今天穿的裙子和我的一模一样，真是太巧了。
一模一样.en: The dress she's wearing today is identical to mine. What a coincidence!

煤.zh: 这座小城过去靠挖煤为生，现在转型发展旅游业了。
煤.en: This small town used to live off coal mining; now it has switched to developing tourism.

收取.zh: 这家博物馆不收取任何费用，所有人都可以免费参观。
收取.en: This museum charges no fees at all; everyone can visit for free.

强化.zh: 公司决定进一步强化员工的安全意识。
强化.en: The company decided to further strengthen employees' safety awareness.

借助.zh: 现在很多学生借助网络来学习外语。
借助.en: Nowadays many students learn foreign languages with the help of the internet.

形态.zh: 这种昆虫一生要经历卵、幼虫、蛹和成虫四种形态。
形态.en: This insect passes through four forms in its life: egg, larva, pupa and adult.

夺取.zh: 敌人企图夺取这座城市，但遭到了顽强抵抗。
夺取.en: The enemy tried to seize the city but met fierce resistance.

不曾.zh: 他离开家乡二十年，却不曾忘记那里的一草一木。
不曾.en: He left his hometown twenty years ago, yet has never forgotten a single blade of grass or tree there.

摄像.zh: 这次活动由小王负责摄像，小李负责拍照。
摄像.en: At this event Xiao Wang is in charge of filming and Xiao Li of taking photos.

间接.zh: 虽然他没有直接参与，但他的建议间接促成了这次合作。
间接.en: Although he wasn't directly involved, his suggestion indirectly brought about this cooperation.

运送.zh: 这条铁路每天可以运送上万名旅客。
运送.en: This railway can carry tens of thousands of passengers a day.

打仗.zh: 爷爷常给我们讲他年轻时当兵打仗的故事。
打仗.en: Grandpa often tells us stories of his days as a young soldier at war.

特地.zh: 他特地请了一天假，陪父母去医院做检查。
特地.en: He took a day off specially to go with his parents for a check-up at the hospital.

强壮.zh: 这匹马又高又强壮，一天能跑上百公里。
强壮.en: This horse is tall and strong and can run over a hundred kilometres in a day.

出入.zh: 两份报告里的数据有些出入，需要重新核对一下。
出入.en: The figures in the two reports don't quite match and need to be checked again.

区分.zh: 孩子要学会区分什么是对的，什么是错的。
区分.en: Children need to learn to tell right from wrong.

报社@6.zh: 他把自己写的文章寄给了一家报社。
报社@6.en: He sent the article he had written to a newspaper.

筹备.zh: 这家博物馆从筹备到正式开放，一共用了五年时间。
筹备.en: From preparation to official opening, this museum took five years in all.

结尾.zh: 作文的结尾要和开头相呼应。
结尾.en: The ending of an essay should echo its beginning.

题材.zh: 这位作家最擅长写校园题材的小说。
题材.en: This writer is best at writing novels with campus life as their subject matter.

通用.zh: 这种充电器是通用的，各种品牌的手机都能用。
通用.en: This charger is universal; phones of every brand can use it.

钓鱼.zh: 这个湖禁止钓鱼，违者罚款两百元。
钓鱼.en: Fishing is forbidden in this lake; offenders will be fined 200 yuan.

迫切@6.zh: 这个地区的孩子迫切需要一所新学校。
迫切@6.en: The children in this area urgently need a new school.

打交道@6.zh: 他是一个程序员，每天主要跟电脑打交道。
打交道@6.en: He's a programmer and mostly deals with computers every day.

兼职@6.zh: 她白天上班，晚上还在一家咖啡店兼职。
兼职@6.en: She works during the day and also has a part-time job at a café in the evenings.

大致.zh: 这两本书的内容大致相同，你买一本就够了。
大致.en: These two books have roughly the same content; buying one is enough.

当代.zh: 这座美术馆主要展出当代艺术家的作品。
当代.en: This gallery mainly exhibits works by contemporary artists.

捕.zh: 这次出海，渔民们捕到了一条两米多长的大鱼。
捕.en: On this trip out to sea, the fishermen caught a fish over two metres long.

好感.zh: 这家店的服务员热情周到，让顾客很有好感。
好感.en: The staff in this shop are warm and attentive, which leaves customers with a good impression.

搜集.zh: 出发前，我在网上搜集了很多关于这座城市的旅游信息。
搜集.en: Before setting off, I gathered lots of travel information about the city online.

大臣.zh: 这位大臣向皇帝提出了许多改革的建议。
大臣.en: This minister put forward many proposals for reform to the emperor.

配备.zh: 这辆新车配备了自动驾驶系统。
配备.en: This new car is equipped with a self-driving system.

难免@6.zh: 两个人生活在一起，难免会有一些小矛盾。
难免@6.en: When two people live together, a few small conflicts are bound to happen.

泼.zh: 他正兴致勃勃地说着计划，朋友却给他泼了一盆冷水。
泼.en: He was excitedly describing his plan when his friend poured cold water on it.

招待@6.zh: 朋友来家里做客，我做了一桌好菜招待他们。
招待@6.en: When friends came to visit, I cooked a table full of good dishes to entertain them.

性能.zh: 这辆跑车的性能非常出色，几秒钟就能加速到一百公里。
性能.en: This sports car performs superbly; it can reach a hundred kilometres an hour in seconds.

过渡.zh: 春天是冬天向夏天过渡的季节。
过渡.en: Spring is the season of transition from winter to summer.

关怀.zh: 社区经常组织志愿者去关怀独居老人。
关怀.en: The community often organises volunteers to look after elderly people who live alone.

入选.zh: 凭着出色的表现，他入选了国家足球队。
入选.en: Thanks to his outstanding performance, he was picked for the national football team.

密度.zh: 铁的密度比水大，所以会沉到水底。
密度.en: Iron is denser than water, so it sinks to the bottom.

发光.zh: 这块手表的指针会在黑暗中发光，晚上也能看清时间。
发光.en: The hands of this watch glow in the dark, so you can read the time at night.

流通.zh: 这种旧版纸币已经停止流通了。
流通.en: This old banknote is no longer in circulation.

不时.zh: 开会的时候，窗外不时传来汽车的喇叭声。
不时.en: During the meeting, the sound of car horns came in through the window from time to time.

主流.zh: 电动汽车正在逐渐成为汽车市场的主流。
主流.en: Electric cars are gradually becoming the mainstream of the car market.

陪同.zh: 未成年人必须由家长陪同才能进入。
陪同.en: Minors may enter only when accompanied by a parent.

向往.zh: 很多年轻人都向往自由自在的工作方式。
向往.en: Many young people long for a free and easy way of working.

一身.zh: 他今天穿了一身西装，看起来特别精神。
一身.en: He's wearing a full suit today and looks really sharp.

中等.zh: 他的成绩在班里属于中等水平，不算好也不算差。
中等.en: His grades are about average for the class, neither good nor bad.

拥挤@6.zh: 节假日的时候，景点里总是很拥挤。
拥挤@6.en: On public holidays, tourist sites are always crowded.

一道.zh: 他和几个老同学一道回母校看望了老师。
一道.en: He went back to his old school together with a few former classmates to visit their teachers.

反馈.zh: 老师会在一周内反馈作业的批改结果。
反馈.en: The teacher will report back on the marked homework within a week.

精美.zh: 礼物的包装十分精美，我都舍不得拆开。
精美.en: The gift wrapping was so beautiful that I couldn't bear to open it.

挫折.zh: 这次创业遇到的挫折让他学到了很多东西。
挫折.en: The setbacks he met in this start-up taught him a great deal.

储存.zh: 松鼠在秋天会储存很多坚果，准备过冬。
储存.en: In autumn, squirrels store lots of nuts to get through the winter.

正规.zh: 他没受过正规的训练，全靠自学成了一名厨师。
正规.en: He never had any formal training and became a chef entirely through self-study.

储蓄.zh: 专家建议年轻人养成储蓄的习惯，不要每个月都花光。
储蓄.en: Experts advise young people to get into the habit of saving instead of spending everything each month.

事后.zh: 有问题要当面说清楚，不要事后再抱怨。
事后.en: If you have a problem, say it clearly to people's faces; don't complain after the fact.

看重.zh: 这家公司招人时很看重应聘者的团队合作能力。
看重.en: When hiring, this company places great importance on applicants' teamwork skills.

往来.zh: 我们两家公司已经有十几年的业务往来了。
往来.en: Our two companies have had business dealings for more than ten years.

后代.zh: 这位老人的后代现在分散在世界各地。
后代.en: This old man's descendants are now scattered all over the world.

制品.zh: 牛奶、酸奶和奶酪都属于乳制品。
制品.en: Milk, yogurt and cheese are all dairy products.

来往.zh: 妈妈不许我跟那些不三不四的人来往。
来往.en: Mum won't let me hang around with those shady characters.

未成年人.zh: 网络游戏公司应该限制未成年人每天的游戏时间。
未成年人.en: Online game companies should limit how long minors can play each day.

关爱.zh: 在老师和同学们的关爱下，他很快走出了失去亲人的痛苦。
关爱.en: With the care of his teachers and classmates, he soon got over the pain of losing a loved one.

特性.zh: 每种金属都有自己的特性，比如铜的导电性特别好。
特性.en: Every metal has its own properties; copper, for example, conducts electricity especially well.

草原.zh: 夏天的草原上开满了野花，一眼望不到边。
草原.en: In summer the grassland is covered in wildflowers stretching as far as the eye can see.

内涵.zh: 他是一个很有内涵的人，说话总能让人深思。
内涵.en: He is a person of real depth; what he says always makes people think.

灾.zh: 洪水过后，政府很快为受灾群众送去了食物和药品。
灾.en: After the flood, the government quickly sent food and medicine to the people affected.

凡是.zh: 凡是去过那家饭店的人，都说那里的烤鸭好吃。
凡是.en: Everyone who has been to that restaurant says its roast duck is delicious.

起初.zh: 起初大家都不看好这个项目，没想到它最后大获成功。
起初.en: At first nobody thought much of this project, but unexpectedly it was a huge success in the end.

小麦@6.zh: 我们平时吃的面粉，大多是用小麦磨成的。
小麦@6.en: Most of the flour we eat every day is ground from wheat.

氧气.zh: 植物在阳光下会吸收二氧化碳，放出氧气。
氧气.en: In sunlight, plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.

保健.zh: 人上了年纪，就要更加重视日常的保健。
保健.en: As people get older, they need to pay more attention to everyday health care.

弹性.zh: 这种运动鞋的鞋底很有弹性，跑步时脚不会累。
弹性.en: The soles of these trainers are very springy, so your feet don't get tired when you run.

转动.zh: 地球绕着自己的轴不停地转动，形成了白天和黑夜。
转动.en: The Earth keeps rotating on its own axis, creating day and night.

富裕.zh: 他出生在一个富裕的家庭，从小不愁吃穿。
富裕.en: He was born into a well-off family and never had to worry about food or clothing.

脆.zh: 这种玻璃很脆，不小心碰一下就碎了。
脆.en: This glass is very brittle; one careless knock and it shatters.

日益.zh: 随着网购的发展，快递行业日益繁忙。
日益.en: With the growth of online shopping, the courier industry is getting busier by the day.

株.zh: 这株兰花是爷爷养了十年的宝贝。
株.en: This orchid is a treasure Grandpa has been growing for ten years.

不适.zh: 刚到高原的游客常常会感到头晕等不适。
不适.en: Tourists who have just arrived on the plateau often feel dizziness and other discomfort.

野生.zh: 这种蘑菇是野生的，没有经过人工种植。
野生.en: These mushrooms grow wild; they aren't cultivated.

概率.zh: 经常锻炼的人，得心脏病的概率要低得多。
概率.en: People who exercise regularly are much less likely to get heart disease.

残疾.zh: 这所学校专门为残疾儿童提供教育。
残疾.en: This school specialises in educating disabled children.

补贴.zh: 政府给购买新能源汽车的人发放补贴。
补贴.en: The government gives subsidies to people who buy new-energy vehicles.

落地.zh: 杯子从桌上掉下来，落地时摔得粉碎。
落地.en: The cup fell off the table and smashed to pieces when it hit the floor.

体操.zh: 每天上午第二节课后，全校学生都要在操场上做广播体操。
体操.en: After the second class every morning, the whole school does group exercises to the radio on the sports field.

肥胖.zh: 儿童肥胖问题越来越严重，专家建议孩子们多运动。
肥胖.en: Childhood obesity is getting more serious, and experts advise children to exercise more.

持久.zh: 这款手机电池续航持久，充一次电能用两天。
持久.en: This phone's battery lasts a long time; one charge is good for two days.

称作.zh: 杭州因为风景优美，被称作“人间天堂”。
称作.en: Because of its beautiful scenery, Hangzhou is known as 'paradise on earth'.

台风.zh: 这位演员台风稳健，第一次上台一点儿也不紧张。
台风.en: This actor has a steady stage presence and wasn't nervous at all on his first time on stage.

承办.zh: 为了承办这届运动会，这座城市新建了三座体育馆。
承办.en: To host these games, the city built three new stadiums.

融化.zh: 冰淇淋拿在手里没多久就融化了。
融化.en: The ice cream melted not long after I picked it up.

款式.zh: 这家店的鞋子款式多样，价格也不贵。
款式.en: This shop's shoes come in many styles, and they're not expensive.

流程.zh: 新员工入职第一周，要先熟悉公司的工作流程。
流程.en: In their first week, new employees have to get familiar with the company's work procedures.

巧妙@6.zh: 设计师巧妙地利用了墙角，多出了一个书架的空间。
巧妙@6.en: The designer cleverly made use of the corner, creating room for a bookshelf.

书籍.zh: 这家旧书店收购各类二手书籍。
书籍.en: This second-hand bookshop buys all kinds of used books.

上述.zh: 符合上述条件的同学，可以在本周五之前报名。
上述.en: Students who meet the above conditions may sign up before this Friday.

碰撞.zh: 两种不同观点的碰撞，往往能产生新的想法。
碰撞.en: A clash between two different viewpoints often produces new ideas.

录制.zh: 歌手花了半年时间，终于录制完了新专辑。
录制.en: The singer spent half a year and finally finished recording the new album.

鲨鱼.zh: 有人在海边游泳时看到了鲨鱼，海滩被暂时关闭了。
鲨鱼.en: Someone swimming off the coast spotted a shark, and the beach was temporarily closed.

访谈.zh: 这个电视访谈节目每周邀请一位名人做嘉宾。
访谈.en: This TV talk show invites a celebrity guest every week.

土壤.zh: 长期使用化肥会让土壤变得越来越硬。
土壤.en: Long-term use of chemical fertiliser makes the soil harder and harder.

污水.zh: 城市污水经过处理后，可以用来浇花和冲厕所。
污水.en: After treatment, urban wastewater can be used to water plants and flush toilets.

眉毛@6.zh: 她每天出门前都要化妆，画一下眉毛。
眉毛@6.en: Every day before going out, she puts on make-up and draws her eyebrows.

扩展.zh: 安装了这个插件以后，软件就能扩展出很多新功能。
扩展.en: Once you install this plug-in, the software can be extended with lots of new features.

痛快@6.zh: 他答应得很痛快，一点儿也没犹豫。
痛快@6.en: He agreed readily, without the slightest hesitation.

繁殖.zh: 这种细菌在温暖潮湿的环境中繁殖得很快。
繁殖.en: This bacterium multiplies quickly in warm, humid conditions.

加重.zh: 这次涨房租，又加重了年轻人的生活负担。
加重.en: This rent increase has added to young people's financial burden yet again.

被动.zh: 比赛一开始我们就丢了两个球，处于非常被动的局面。
被动.en: We conceded two goals right at the start and were in a very passive position.

当面.zh: 这份礼物我想当面交给她，不想寄过去。
当面.en: I want to give her this present in person, not post it.

眼看.zh: 他眼看着火车开走了，却一点办法也没有。
眼看.en: He watched the train pull away, but there was nothing he could do.

课题.zh: 我们小组的研究课题是城市垃圾分类。
课题.en: Our group's research topic is urban waste sorting.

犹如.zh: 她的歌声犹如山间的泉水一样清澈。
犹如.en: Her singing is as clear as a mountain spring.

饥饿.zh: 世界上仍有很多人在忍受饥饿。
饥饿.en: There are still many people in the world suffering from hunger.

竖.zh: 听到这个好消息，大家都竖起大拇指称赞他。
竖.en: Hearing the good news, everyone gave him a thumbs-up in praise.

实质.zh: 两种说法表面上不同，实质上是一回事。
实质.en: The two statements differ on the surface, but in essence they are the same thing.

人为.zh: 调查发现，这次停电不是设备故障，而是人为操作失误造成的。
人为.en: The investigation found the power cut was caused not by equipment failure but by human error.

描写@6.zh: 这篇作文对人物的心理描写非常细致。
描写@6.en: This essay's description of the characters' inner thoughts is very detailed.

添加.zh: 请在微信上添加我为好友，有事随时联系。
添加.en: Please add me as a friend on WeChat and contact me any time.

要点.zh: 这篇课文的要点，老师已经在黑板上列出来了。
要点.en: The teacher has already listed the main points of this text on the blackboard.

截止.zh: 这次征文比赛的截止日期是下个月十号。
截止.en: The deadline for this essay competition is the tenth of next month.

发病.zh: 他有哮喘，一发病就喘不过气来。
发病.en: He has asthma; whenever it flares up he can't catch his breath.

匆匆.zh: 他每次回老家都来去匆匆，住不了两天就走。
匆匆.en: Every time he goes back home it's a flying visit; he leaves after barely two days.

高等.zh: 这门高等数学课太难了，很多学生都没及格。
高等.en: This advanced mathematics course is so hard that many students failed it.

当下.zh: 他一听说母亲病了，当下就买了回家的车票。
当下.en: As soon as he heard his mother was ill, he bought a ticket home on the spot.

描绘.zh: 他在信中描绘了自己对未来生活的美好设想。
描绘.en: In his letter he described his beautiful vision of his future life.

观光.zh: 游客可以坐观光车游览整个公园。
观光.en: Visitors can tour the whole park on the sightseeing buggy.

舅舅@6.zh: 我妈妈只有一个弟弟，就是我的小舅舅，他只比我大八岁。
舅舅@6.en: My mum has only one younger brother—my young uncle, who is just eight years older than me.

时速.zh: 这段路限速六十，他却开到了时速一百二十公里，被交警拦了下来。
时速.en: The speed limit on this stretch is 60, but he was doing 120 kilometres an hour and got pulled over by traffic police.

归还.zh: 警察把找回的钱包归还给了失主。
归还.en: The police returned the recovered wallet to its owner.

相连.zh: 卧室和阳台相连，早上阳光可以直接照进来。
相连.en: The bedroom connects to the balcony, so the morning sun shines straight in.

限于.zh: 限于时间关系，今天的讨论就到这里。
限于.en: Due to time constraints, we'll end today's discussion here.

公益.zh: 这则公益广告提醒大家开车时不要看手机。
公益.en: This public service ad reminds everyone not to look at their phone while driving.

乐器@6.zh: 钢琴常常被人们称为“乐器之王”。
乐器@6.en: The piano is often called "the king of instruments".

事项.zh: 考试开始前，监考老师宣读了注意事项。
事项.en: Before the exam began, the invigilator read out the points to note.

天然气.zh: 冬天一到，天然气的用量就大幅增加。
天然气.en: As soon as winter arrives, natural gas consumption rises sharply.

赞赏.zh: 观众们纷纷赞赏这位年轻演员的精彩表演。
赞赏.en: Audience members one after another praised the young actor's brilliant performance.

解读.zh: 同一首诗，不同的人可能会有不同的解读。
解读.en: Different people may interpret the same poem in different ways.

棕色.zh: 这只小熊有一身棕色的毛，看起来非常可爱。
棕色.en: This little bear has brown fur all over and looks very cute.

对应.zh: 请把左边的词语和右边对应的解释连起来。
对应.en: Please match the words on the left with the corresponding explanations on the right.

明亮.zh: 她有一双明亮的大眼睛，笑起来特别好看。
明亮.en: She has big bright eyes and looks especially lovely when she smiles.

通风.zh: 地下室不通风，一直有股潮湿的味道。
通风.en: The basement has no ventilation and always smells damp.

奔跑.zh: 他在雨中奔跑着，想赶上最后一班公交车。
奔跑.en: He ran through the rain, trying to catch the last bus.

减弱.zh: 到了傍晚，阳光渐渐减弱，天色暗了下来。
减弱.en: Towards evening, the sunlight slowly faded and the sky grew dark.

绘画.zh: 这次展览展出了一百多幅儿童绘画作品。
绘画.en: This exhibition displays more than a hundred children's paintings.

后期.zh: 比赛进入后期，双方队员的体力都明显下降了。
后期.en: As the match entered its later stage, players on both sides were visibly tiring.

棒球.zh: 他戴上手套，准备接住飞过来的棒球。
棒球.en: He put on his glove, ready to catch the incoming baseball.

议论@6.zh: 别在背后议论别人，这样很不礼貌。
议论@6.en: Don't talk about people behind their backs; it's very rude.

方位.zh: 这个城市的路都是斜的，我刚来时总搞不清方位。
方位.en: The roads in this city all run at angles, and when I first arrived I could never get my bearings.

衰老.zh: 长期熬夜会让皮肤加速衰老。
衰老.en: Staying up late over a long period makes your skin age faster.

理财.zh: 银行推出了一款新的理财产品，收益比存款高一些。
理财.en: The bank launched a new investment product with slightly higher returns than a savings account.

上当@6.zh: 我花三百块买了一个假包，真是上当了。
上当@6.en: I paid three hundred yuan for a fake bag—I was really taken in.

筛选.zh: 研究人员从上千种植物中筛选出了三种可以入药的。
筛选.en: From over a thousand plants, the researchers screened out three that can be used as medicine.

桥梁.zh: 这座新建成的桥梁把两个岛连在了一起。
桥梁.en: This newly completed bridge links the two islands.

手势.zh: 交警用手势指挥着来往的车辆。
手势.en: The traffic officer directed passing vehicles with hand signals.

观赏.zh: 这种鱼颜色鲜艳，很有观赏价值。
观赏.en: This fish is brightly coloured and has great ornamental value.

重心.zh: 搬重东西的时候，要把身体的重心放低。
重心.en: When lifting heavy things, keep your centre of gravity low.

开创.zh: 他的发明开创了一个新时代。
开创.en: His invention ushered in a new era.

谦虚@6.zh: 他总说自己做得不好，其实是太谦虚了。
谦虚@6.en: He always says he didn't do well, but really he's just being too modest.

源于.zh: 他的自信源于多年来的努力和积累。
源于.en: His self-confidence comes from years of hard work and experience.

启示.zh: 大自然给了人类很多启示，飞机的发明就受到了鸟的影响。
启示.en: Nature has given humans much inspiration; the invention of the aeroplane was influenced by birds.

构造.zh: 老师用模型给我们介绍了人体心脏的构造。
构造.en: The teacher used a model to show us the structure of the human heart.

国旗.zh: 运动员站在领奖台上，看着国旗慢慢升起，激动得流下了眼泪。
国旗.en: Standing on the podium watching the national flag slowly rise, the athlete shed tears of emotion.

漂.zh: 他把折好的纸船放进河里，看着它慢慢漂走了。
漂.en: He put the folded paper boat in the river and watched it drift slowly away.

剧烈.zh: 他突然感到胃部一阵剧烈的疼痛，赶紧去了医院。
剧烈.en: He suddenly felt a severe pain in his stomach and hurried to the hospital.

水库.zh: 连续下了一周大雨，水库的水位已经超过了警戒线。
水库.en: After a week of nonstop heavy rain, the reservoir's water level has passed the warning line.

成千上万.zh: 这场演唱会吸引了成千上万的歌迷。
成千上万.en: The concert drew thousands upon thousands of fans.

发票@6.zh: 出差回来以后，要拿发票去公司报销。
发票@6.en: After a business trip, you take the invoices to the company to be reimbursed.

巩固.zh: 这场胜利巩固了他们在联赛中第一名的位置。
巩固.en: This win consolidated their first place in the league.

艰辛.zh: 他历尽艰辛，终于找到了失散多年的妹妹。
艰辛.en: After going through countless hardships, he finally found the sister he had lost touch with for years.

广阔.zh: 飞机下面是一片广阔的草原。
广阔.en: Below the plane lies a vast grassland.

保暖.zh: 这件羽绒服又轻又保暖，非常适合冬天穿。
保暖.en: This down jacket is light and warm, perfect for winter.

祝愿.zh: 在毕业典礼上，校长祝愿每位同学都有美好的未来。
祝愿.en: At the graduation ceremony, the principal wished every student a bright future.

大吃一惊.zh: 十年没见，老同学的变化让我大吃一惊。
大吃一惊.en: I hadn't seen my old classmate for ten years, and I was amazed at how much he'd changed.

叙述@6.zh: 这篇小说用第一人称叙述了一个孩子的成长。
叙述@6.en: This novel narrates a child's growing up in the first person.

山顶.zh: 站在山顶往下看，整个城市都在眼前。
山顶.en: Looking down from the mountaintop, the whole city lay before us.

过时.zh: 技术发展太快，几年前学的知识现在可能已经过时了。
过时.en: Technology moves so fast that what you learned a few years ago may already be outdated.

路程.zh: 还有十公里的路程，坚持一下就到了。
路程.en: There are only ten kilometres to go; hang in there and we'll be there.

引入.zh: 老师用一个有趣的故事引入了今天的课题。
引入.en: The teacher introduced today's topic with an interesting story.

成效.zh: 这项改革已初见成效，市民看病比以前方便多了。
成效.en: The reform is already showing results; it's much easier for residents to see a doctor than before.

众所周知.zh: 众所周知，熊猫是中国特有的动物。
众所周知.en: As everyone knows, the panda is an animal found only in China.

顽强.zh: 石缝里长出了一棵小草，它的生命力真顽强。
顽强.en: A blade of grass has grown out of a crack in the rock; its life force is truly tenacious.

传染病.zh: 这种传染病传播速度很快，必须马上隔离病人。
传染病.en: This infectious disease spreads very fast; patients must be isolated immediately.

匆忙@6.zh: 这次旅行太匆忙了，很多地方都没来得及去。
匆忙@6.en: This trip was too rushed; we didn't have time to visit many places.

要素.zh: 资金、技术和人才是企业发展的三大要素。
要素.en: Capital, technology and talent are the three key elements of a company's growth.

转让.zh: 他把自己的专利转让给了一家大公司。
转让.en: He transferred his patent to a large company.

不成.zh: 这个办法不成，我们得再想想别的。
不成.en: This method won't work; we'll have to think of something else.

景观.zh: 公园里新建了一个水上景观，晚上还有灯光秀。
景观.en: The park has a new water feature, and there's a light show in the evening too.

淹没.zh: 一夜大雨过后，河边的小路完全被水淹没了。
淹没.en: After a night of heavy rain, the riverside path was completely under water.

背心.zh: 工人们都穿着橙色的反光背心，在马路上施工。
背心.en: The workers, all in orange reflective vests, were doing roadworks.

一再@6.zh: 因为天气不好，我们的航班一再推迟，到半夜才起飞。
一再@6.en: Because of the bad weather, our flight was delayed again and again and didn't take off until midnight.

白白.zh: 机会就在眼前，千万别白白浪费了。
白白.en: The opportunity is right in front of you; don't waste it.

野外.zh: 这种植物在野外已经很难找到了。
野外.en: This plant is now very hard to find in the wild.

培育.zh: 春天，林场的工人们在温室里培育树苗。
培育.en: In spring, the forestry workers raise saplings in the greenhouse.

弯曲.zh: 做这个动作时膝盖要微微弯曲，不要站得太直。
弯曲.en: When doing this movement, keep your knees slightly bent; don't stand too straight.

亲属.zh: 这项手续只能由本人或者直系亲属代为办理。
亲属.en: This procedure can only be handled by the person themselves or an immediate family member.

发电.zh: 这座大坝建成以后，每年可以发电几十亿度。
发电.en: Once built, this dam will be able to generate billions of kilowatt-hours of electricity a year.

创办.zh: 大学毕业后，他和两个朋友一起创办了一家网络公司。
创办.en: After graduating, he and two friends set up an internet company.

齐全.zh: 这家医院设备齐全，可以做各种检查。
齐全.en: This hospital is fully equipped and can carry out all kinds of tests.

太阳能.zh: 这辆车不用汽油，完全靠太阳能驱动。
太阳能.en: This car uses no petrol; it runs entirely on solar power.

远方.zh: 年轻时，他总梦想着去远方看看外面的世界。
远方.en: When he was young, he always dreamed of going far away to see the world.

名额.zh: 今年奖学金的名额增加了一倍，有更多学生可以申请。
名额.en: The number of scholarship places has doubled this year, so more students can apply.

解答.zh: 关于产品的任何问题，客服人员都会为您解答。
解答.en: Our customer service staff will answer any questions you have about the product.

轮椅.zh: 这座图书馆专门为坐轮椅的读者修建了无障碍通道。
轮椅.en: This library built an accessible entrance especially for readers in wheelchairs.

求救.zh: 船在海上遇到风暴，船长立刻发出了求救信号。
求救.en: The ship ran into a storm at sea, and the captain immediately sent out a distress signal.

灰尘@6.zh: 我拿起那本旧书轻轻一拍，灰尘到处乱飞。
灰尘@6.en: When I picked up the old book and gave it a light pat, dust flew everywhere.

盼望@6.zh: 他在外地工作，家人一直盼望他早点儿回来。
盼望@6.en: He works far from home, and his family has long been hoping he'll come back soon.

输出.zh: 学语言不能只输入不输出，要多开口说。
输出.en: When learning a language, it can't be all input and no output; you need to speak a lot.

轮流@6.zh: 爸爸住院期间，我们兄弟姐妹几个轮流去医院照顾他。
轮流@6.en: While Dad was in hospital, we brothers and sisters took turns looking after him there.

鲜明.zh: 这两个人的性格形成了鲜明的对比。
鲜明.en: The two people's personalities form a sharp contrast.

诸多.zh: 虽然面临诸多困难，他依然坚持完成了这个项目。
诸多.en: Despite facing numerous difficulties, he still saw the project through.

木材.zh: 为了保护森林，政府严格限制木材的砍伐和出口。
木材.en: To protect the forests, the government strictly limits the logging and export of timber.

闻名.zh: 这家老字号饭店的烤鸭闻名全国。
闻名.en: This long-established restaurant's roast duck is famous throughout the country.

切实.zh: 学校要切实减轻学生的课业负担。
切实.en: Schools must genuinely reduce students' workload.

结实@6.zh: 他从小练游泳，身体特别结实，很少感冒。
结实@6.en: He has swum since childhood, so he's very strong and rarely catches colds.

古人.zh: 古人说“读万卷书，行万里路”，意思是学习和实践都很重要。
古人.en: The ancients said 'read ten thousand books, travel ten thousand miles', meaning both study and experience matter.

船只.zh: 这条运河每天都有大量船只往来。
船只.en: Large numbers of boats travel up and down this canal every day.

配套.zh: 新买的电脑还送了配套的鼠标和键盘。
配套.en: The new computer came with a matching mouse and keyboard.

前期.zh: 这个项目前期投入很大，要两三年以后才能赚钱。
前期.en: This project needs heavy investment in its early stage and will take two or three years to turn a profit.

还原.zh: 电脑中了病毒，他只好把系统还原到上个星期的状态。
还原.en: His computer got a virus, so he had to restore the system to how it was last week.

延期.zh: 因为签证还没办好，我们的旅行只好延期。
延期.en: Because our visas aren't ready yet, we have to postpone our trip.

不宜.zh: 这部电影有不少暴力镜头，不宜儿童观看。
不宜.en: This film has quite a few violent scenes and is unsuitable for children.

垂直.zh: 这面墙并不垂直于地面，看上去有点歪。
垂直.en: This wall isn't perpendicular to the floor; it looks a little crooked.

出境.zh: 他因为欠钱不还，被法院限制出境了。
出境.en: Because he refused to repay his debts, the court banned him from leaving the country.

治理.zh: 经过多年治理，这条臭水沟变成了美丽的小河。
治理.en: After years of clean-up work, this smelly ditch has become a beautiful stream.

姑姑@6.zh: 每年春节，爸爸都会带我们去看他的姐姐，也就是我的姑姑。
姑姑@6.en: Every Spring Festival, Dad takes us to visit his elder sister—my aunt.

幅度.zh: 这次考试，他的成绩提高的幅度最大。
幅度.en: In this exam, his marks improved by the greatest margin.

暖气.zh: 暖气坏了，我们只好穿着羽绒服在屋里看电视。
暖气.en: The heating broke, so we had to watch TV indoors in our down jackets.

悲观@6.zh: 医生说他的病情并不悲观，治好的可能性很大。
悲观@6.en: The doctor said his condition isn't hopeless; there's a good chance of a cure.

评选.zh: 这次评选活动由观众投票决定最受欢迎的歌手。
评选.en: In this selection event, the audience votes to decide the most popular singer.

率领.zh: 主教练率领球队来到北京参加比赛。
率领.en: The head coach led the team to Beijing for the competition.

创立.zh: 达尔文创立的进化论，彻底改变了人们对生命的认识。
创立.en: The theory of evolution founded by Darwin completely changed how people understand life.

自助.zh: 现在很多银行都有自助取款机，取钱很方便。
自助.en: Many banks now have self-service cash machines, so withdrawing money is easy.

祖先.zh: 据说这个村子里的人都有同一个祖先。
祖先.en: It is said that everyone in this village shares the same ancestor.

委屈@6.zh: 孩子受了委屈，一回家就哭了起来。
委屈@6.en: The child had been treated unfairly and burst into tears as soon as he got home.

特长.zh: 在简历中，你可以写上自己的特长和爱好。
特长.en: On your CV you can list your special skills and hobbies.

薄弱.zh: 找出自己学习上的薄弱环节，再有针对性地练习。
薄弱.en: Find the weak links in your studies and then practise them specifically.

主办.zh: 本届音乐节由市文化局主办，共持续三天。
主办.en: This year's music festival is hosted by the city's culture bureau and lasts three days.

公认.zh: 熬夜对健康有害，这是公认的事实。
公认.en: That staying up late harms your health is a universally acknowledged fact.

开设.zh: 这家银行在海外开设了二十多家分行。
开设.en: This bank has opened more than twenty branches overseas.

百分点.zh: 这次考试的及格率比上次提高了五个百分点。
百分点.en: The pass rate in this exam rose by five percentage points compared with last time.

专题.zh: 下周的班会将围绕“网络安全”开展专题讨论。
专题.en: Next week's class meeting will hold a discussion on the special topic of online safety.

用餐.zh: 飞机上，空乘人员提醒乘客用餐时把座椅调直。
用餐.en: On the plane, the flight attendants reminded passengers to put their seats upright during the meal.

工夫.zh: 一转眼的工夫，孩子就跑得不见了。
工夫.en: In the blink of an eye, the child had run off and disappeared.

看似.zh: 他看似不在乎，其实心里比谁都着急。
看似.en: He seems not to care, but inside he's more anxious than anyone.

生成.zh: 付款成功后，系统会自动生成订单号。
生成.en: Once payment succeeds, the system automatically generates an order number.

繁忙.zh: 春节前后，火车站的工作十分繁忙。
繁忙.en: Around the Spring Festival, work at the railway station is extremely busy.

订婚.zh: 订婚以后，两家人常常一起吃饭，关系越来越好。
订婚.en: After the engagement, the two families often ate together and grew closer and closer.

习俗.zh: 在一些地方，结婚时有给客人发喜糖的习俗。
习俗.en: In some places, it's the custom to give guests wedding sweets.

金子.zh: 是金子总会发光的，只要坚持努力，总有一天会被人看见。
金子.en: Gold will always shine; keep working hard and one day people will notice you.

口腔.zh: 他去医院看牙，挂了口腔科的号。
口腔.en: He went to the hospital about his teeth and registered with the dental department.

寿命@6.zh: 这种电池的使用寿命大约是五年。
寿命@6.en: The service life of this battery is about five years.

划分.zh: 这座城市被划分为东、西两个区。
划分.en: The city is divided into two districts, east and west.

体积.zh: 这个箱子体积太大，放不进汽车的后备箱。
体积.en: This box is too bulky to fit in the car boot.

地域.zh: 招聘时不应该有地域歧视，不能因为老家在哪儿就拒绝别人。
地域.en: Hiring shouldn't involve regional discrimination; you can't reject someone because of where they come from.

热点.zh: 这个小岛成了今年夏天的旅游热点。
热点.en: This small island became this summer's hot tourist destination.

人行道.zh: 有人把电动车停在人行道上，挡住了行人。
人行道.en: Someone parked an e-bike on the sidewalk, blocking pedestrians.

周到@6.zh: 他考虑问题很周到，每个细节都想到了。
周到@6.en: He thinks things through very thoroughly and considers every detail.

摆放.zh: 客厅里摆放着几盆绿色植物，看起来很有生气。
摆放.en: There are several potted plants in the living room, which makes it look lively.

精通.zh: 这位老师傅精通汽车修理，什么毛病都难不倒他。
精通.en: This old mechanic is an expert at car repair; no fault is too much for him.

看中.zh: 我们看了十几套房子，终于看中了一套离公司近的。
看中.en: We looked at more than a dozen flats and finally settled on one close to the office.

自来水.zh: 以前村里人都去井里打水，现在家家都通了自来水。
自来水.en: Villagers used to draw water from the well; now every home has running water.

地形.zh: 云南地形以山地为主，平原很少。
地形.en: Yunnan's terrain is mainly mountainous, with very few plains.

细致.zh: 作者对人物心理的描写细致入微，读来十分感人。
细致.en: The author's portrayal of the characters' inner lives is meticulous in every detail and deeply moving.

畅销.zh: 这款手机在年轻人中非常畅销，经常卖断货。
畅销.en: This phone sells extremely well among young people and often sells out.

名气.zh: 这部电影让这位年轻导演的名气越来越大。
名气.en: This film has made the young director more and more famous.

适宜.zh: 这种花不适宜放在阳光直射的地方。
适宜.en: This flower isn't suited to being placed in direct sunlight.

养老.zh: 年轻时多存点钱，将来养老才不用发愁。
养老.en: Save more while you're young, so you won't have to worry about old age.

百货.zh: 小镇上只有一家百货店，日用品基本都能买到。
百货.en: There's only one general store in the small town, but you can get most everyday items there.

比方.zh: 比方说，你可以每天早上读半小时中文。
比方.en: For example, you could read Chinese for half an hour every morning.

路面.zh: 这条马路年久失修，路面坑坑洼洼的。
路面.en: This road hasn't been repaired for years, and its surface is full of potholes.

局限.zh: 这项研究的样本太少，结论存在一定的局限性。
局限.en: This study's sample is too small, so its conclusions have certain limitations.

酱油@6.zh: 做红烧肉时要放酱油，颜色才好看。
酱油@6.en: When making braised pork, you add soy sauce so that the colour looks good.

青春期.zh: 他青春期的时候长得特别快，一年长高了十厘米。
青春期.en: He grew very fast during puberty, gaining ten centimetres in a year.

面粉.zh: 妈妈去超市买了一袋面粉，准备周末包饺子。
面粉.en: Mum bought a bag of flour at the supermarket to make dumplings at the weekend.

快捷.zh: 这家快递公司服务快捷，昨天寄的东西今天就到了。
快捷.en: This courier company is fast; something sent yesterday arrived today.

空地.zh: 市政府计划在这块空地上建一座公园。
空地.en: The city government plans to build a park on this vacant lot.

压缩.zh: 他把这些照片压缩成一个文件，发到了我的邮箱。
压缩.en: He compressed these photos into one file and sent it to my email.

财物.zh: 小偷趁家里没人，偷走了不少财物。
财物.en: Taking advantage of nobody being home, the thief stole quite a lot of valuables.

考古.zh: 这次考古发掘出土了一批珍贵的青铜器。
考古.en: This archaeological dig unearthed a batch of precious bronzes.

限度.zh: 我们要最大限度地减少浪费。
限度.en: We must reduce waste as much as possible.

姨.zh: 暑假我去小姨家住了一个月，她天天带我出去玩。
姨.en: In the summer holidays I stayed at my youngest aunt's for a month, and she took me out every day.

排放.zh: 汽车尾气的排放是城市空气污染的主要原因之一。
排放.en: Car exhaust emissions are one of the main causes of urban air pollution.

白领.zh: 很多年轻白领下班后还要去健身房锻炼。
白领.en: Many young office workers go to the gym after work.

滑冰.zh: 她穿上冰鞋，第一次滑冰就摔了好几跤。
滑冰.en: She put on her skates and fell several times the first time she went skating.

密集.zh: 市中心高楼密集，到了晚上灯火通明。
密集.en: The city centre is packed with high-rises, and at night it's brightly lit.

交际@6.zh: 学好一门外语，可以扩大你的交际范围。
交际@6.en: Learning a foreign language well can widen your social circle.

仰.zh: 他仰起头，一口气把一瓶水喝光了。
仰.en: He tipped his head back and drank the whole bottle of water in one go.

字幕@6.zh: 这部电影没有字幕，我只能听懂一半。
字幕@6.en: This film has no subtitles, so I can only understand half of it.

亚军.zh: 决赛中他只慢了零点一秒，遗憾地获得了亚军。
亚军.en: In the final he was only a tenth of a second slower and had to settle for second place.

徒弟.zh: 老画家收了一个徒弟，把自己的技艺全部传给了他。
徒弟.en: The old painter took on an apprentice and passed on all his skills to him.

前者.zh: 城市生活方便，乡村生活安静，我父母更喜欢前者，所以一直住在城里。
前者.en: City life is convenient and country life is quiet; my parents prefer the former, so they've always lived in town.

号召.zh: 在班长的号召下，同学们纷纷为生病的同学捐款。
号召.en: Answering the class monitor's call, the students donated money for their sick classmate.

间隔.zh: 种树时，每两棵树之间要间隔三米。
间隔.en: When planting, leave a gap of three metres between each pair of trees.

感想@6.zh: 参观完博物馆，老师让我们写一篇感想。
感想@6.en: After the museum visit, the teacher asked us to write up our impressions.

入境.zh: 飞机降落以后，乘客要先排队办理入境手续。
入境.en: After the plane lands, passengers first queue to go through entry formalities.

照明.zh: 停电后，大家只能用手机来照明。
照明.en: After the power went out, everyone had to use their phones for light.

地质.zh: 地质专家正在研究这一带为什么经常发生滑坡。
地质.en: Geology experts are studying why landslides happen so often in this area.

相差.zh: 这两件衣服看起来差不多，价格却相差一倍。
相差.en: These two garments look much the same, yet one costs twice as much as the other.

账单.zh: 这个月的电费账单比上个月高了一倍。
账单.en: This month's electricity bill is twice as high as last month's.

短缺.zh: 很多农村医院面临医生短缺的问题。
短缺.en: Many rural hospitals face a shortage of doctors.

菊花.zh: 夏天喝点菊花茶，可以清热降火。
菊花.en: Drinking some chrysanthemum tea in summer helps cool the body.

书写.zh: 他书写工整，老师常常把他的作业贴在墙上给大家看。
书写.en: His handwriting is so neat that the teacher often pins his homework on the wall for everyone to see.

大都.zh: 他的朋友大都是大学同学，毕业后还经常见面。
大都.en: His friends are mostly university classmates, and they still meet often since graduating.

文献.zh: 图书馆保存着大量珍贵的历史文献。
文献.en: The library holds a large number of valuable historical documents.

夸奖.zh: 孩子做了好事，父母应该及时夸奖。
夸奖.en: When children do something good, parents should praise them right away.

盲人.zh: 这位盲人钢琴家虽然看不见，却能弹出动人的音乐。
盲人.en: Though he can't see, this blind pianist plays moving music.

潮湿@6.zh: 地下室很潮湿，放在那里的书都发霉了。
潮湿@6.en: The basement is very damp; the books kept there have all gone mouldy.

讲解.zh: 这道题我不太明白，你能再给我讲解一遍吗？
讲解.en: I don't really understand this question; could you explain it to me once more?

容量.zh: 手机内存容量不够了，照片都存不进去了。
容量.en: My phone's storage is full; I can't save any more photos.

编写.zh: 他花了一个星期，编写了一个自动统计成绩的小程序。
编写.en: He spent a week writing a small program that tallies grades automatically.

香肠@6.zh: 这种香肠是用猪肉做的，味道有点儿甜。
香肠@6.en: This sausage is made of pork and tastes a little sweet.

抽奖.zh: 购物满两百元就可以参加抽奖，最高能抽到一部手机。
抽奖.en: Spend 200 yuan and you can enter the prize draw; the top prize is a mobile phone.

认错.zh: 他这个人特别要面子，明知道自己错了也不肯认错。
认错.en: He cares so much about saving face that he won't admit he's wrong even when he knows it.

传授.zh: 这位冠军经常向年轻选手传授比赛经验。
传授.en: This champion often passes on his competition experience to young players.

伤员.zh: 医生和护士连夜抢救伤员，一直忙到天亮。
伤员.en: Doctors and nurses worked through the night to save the wounded, busy until dawn.

均匀@6.zh: 先把鸡蛋和少量盐搅拌均匀，再倒进热油锅里。
均匀@6.en: First beat the eggs with a little salt until evenly mixed, then pour them into the hot oiled pan.

起源.zh: 有人认为，足球起源于中国古代的蹴鞠。
起源.en: Some people believe football originated from cuju, an ancient Chinese game.

火柴@6.zh: 小时候，奶奶做饭都是用火柴点火。
火柴@6.en: When I was little, Grandma always lit the stove with matches.

倒闭.zh: 因为网上购物越来越方便，街上不少书店都倒闭了。
倒闭.en: Because online shopping has become so convenient, many bookshops on the street have closed down.

耳环@6.zh: 她刚打了耳洞，还不能戴太重的耳环。
耳环@6.en: She's just had her ears pierced and can't wear heavy earrings yet.

坚固.zh: 这个行李箱的外壳很坚固，摔几次也不会坏。
坚固.en: This suitcase has a very sturdy shell; it won't break even if dropped a few times.

兴起.zh: 这座城市是在清朝时因为贸易而兴起的。
兴起.en: This city rose to prominence through trade during the Qing dynasty.

为期.zh: 学校组织了一次为期五天的夏令营。
为期.en: The school organised a summer camp lasting five days.

多亏@6.zh: 多亏了这张地图，我们才没在山里迷路。
多亏@6.en: Thanks to this map, we didn't get lost in the mountains.

用处.zh: 你学这个到底有什么用处？我看一点用都没有。
用处.en: What's the point of learning this? It seems completely useless to me.

海域.zh: 一艘货船在南海海域遇险，救援人员已经赶往现场。
海域.en: A cargo ship ran into trouble in the waters of the South China Sea, and rescuers are rushing to the scene.

输送.zh: 心脏不停地跳动，把血液输送到全身。
输送.en: The heart beats nonstop, pumping blood throughout the body.

功效.zh: 这种草药有清热解毒的功效。
功效.en: This herb has the effect of clearing heat and removing toxins.

口头.zh: 他们只是口头约定，并没有签正式的合同。
口头.en: They only had a verbal agreement and never signed a formal contract.

就读.zh: 这所小学目前有一千多名学生就读。
就读.en: More than a thousand pupils currently attend this primary school.

勇于.zh: 优秀的企业家都勇于尝试新事物。
勇于.en: Great entrepreneurs all have the courage to try new things.

日夜.zh: 母亲日夜守在病床前，人都瘦了一大圈。
日夜.en: Mother kept watch by the sickbed day and night and grew visibly thinner.

反思.zh: 这次事故值得每个人认真反思。
反思.en: This accident deserves serious reflection from everyone.

麦克风@6.zh: 主持人拿着麦克风走到了舞台中间。
麦克风@6.en: The host walked to the middle of the stage holding the microphone.

公元@6.zh: 秦始皇在公元前221年统一了中国。
公元@6.en: Qin Shi Huang unified China in 221 BC.

流量.zh: 节假日期间，景区的游客流量比平时增加了三倍。
流量.en: During the holidays, the flow of visitors to the scenic area was three times higher than usual.

厂商.zh: 国内外汽车厂商纷纷降价，希望吸引更多消费者。
厂商.en: Car makers at home and abroad have cut prices one after another, hoping to attract more buyers.

高原.zh: 青藏高原平均海拔四千米以上，被称为“世界屋脊”。
高原.en: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau averages over 4,000 meters above sea level and is called "the roof of the world".

套餐.zh: 我换了一个新的手机套餐，每个月的话费便宜了不少。
套餐.en: I switched to a new phone plan and my monthly bill is a lot cheaper.

图表.zh: 报告里的数据太多了，最好用图表来展示，这样更直观。
图表.en: There is too much data in the report; it's better to present it in charts so it's easier to grasp.

考核.zh: 公司每年年底都会对员工的工作表现进行考核。
考核.en: At the end of every year, the company assesses its employees' performance.

食欲.zh: 这道菜颜色鲜艳，香味扑鼻，让人食欲大增。
食欲.en: This dish is brightly colored and smells wonderful; it really whets your appetite.

风雨.zh: 两人一起经历了几十年的风雨，感情越来越深。
风雨.en: The two of them have weathered decades of ups and downs together, and their bond keeps growing deeper.

瓷器.zh: 搬家的时候，这些瓷器要用报纸包好，免得打碎。
瓷器.en: When we move, this china needs to be wrapped in newspaper so it doesn't break.

日后.zh: 您的帮助我会一直记在心里，日后一定好好报答。
日后.en: I'll always remember your help, and I'll be sure to repay you some day.

严禁.zh: 图书馆内严禁饮食和大声喧哗。
严禁.en: Eating, drinking and loud noise are strictly prohibited in the library.

劳动力.zh: 机器人的使用大大节省了劳动力，提高了生产效率。
劳动力.en: Using robots has saved a great deal of manpower and raised productivity.

抽象@6.zh: 这幅抽象画很多人都看不懂。
抽象@6.en: Many people can't make sense of this abstract painting.

采纳.zh: 这条建议被采纳以后，食堂排队的时间缩短了一半。
采纳.en: After this suggestion was adopted, queuing time in the canteen was cut by half.

分工.zh: 这次活动分工明确，有人负责宣传，有人负责接待。
分工.en: The roles for this event are clearly divided: some people handle publicity, others handle reception.

率先.zh: 比赛进行到第十分钟，主队率先打进一球。
率先.en: Ten minutes into the match, the home team scored the opening goal.

历经.zh: 这项研究历经十年，终于取得了重大突破。
历经.en: After ten years of work, this research has finally made a major breakthrough.

对立.zh: 黑与白、冷与热都是对立的概念。
对立.en: Black and white, hot and cold are opposite concepts.

科幻.zh: 这部科幻电影讲述了人类移民火星的故事。
科幻.en: This science fiction film tells the story of humans settling on Mars.

厂家.zh: 直接从厂家进货，价格要比从批发商那里便宜得多。
厂家.en: Buying stock directly from the factory is much cheaper than going through a wholesaler.

跳水.zh: 他站在十米高的跳台上，深吸一口气，完成了一个漂亮的跳水动作。
跳水.en: Standing on the ten-meter platform, he took a deep breath and performed a beautiful dive.

推行.zh: 这项新政策先在几个城市试点，然后再在全国推行。
推行.en: The new policy will be piloted in a few cities first and then rolled out nationwide.

话筒.zh: 他拿起话筒，听到电话那头传来妈妈的声音。
话筒.en: He picked up the receiver and heard his mother's voice on the other end of the line.

钟头.zh: 从这儿开车去机场，不堵车的话两个钟头就到了。
钟头.en: If there's no traffic, it takes two hours to drive from here to the airport.

台球.zh: 他一杆把桌上的台球全打进了洞，大家都看呆了。
台球.en: He potted every ball on the table in a single turn, and everyone stared in amazement.

互助.zh: 同学们成立了学习互助小组，成绩好的帮助成绩差的。
互助.en: The students set up a study support group in which the stronger students help the weaker ones.

丰收.zh: 果农们望着满树的苹果，脸上露出了丰收的喜悦。
丰收.en: Looking at the trees laden with apples, the fruit farmers beamed with the joy of a bumper harvest.

田径.zh: 这所大学的田径队在全国比赛中获得了好几块金牌。
田径.en: This university's athletics team won several gold medals in the national competition.

趣味.zh: 这个小游戏既有趣味性又能学到知识。
趣味.en: This little game is both fun and educational.

枯燥.zh: 背单词虽然枯燥，但却是学外语的基础。
枯燥.en: Memorising vocabulary may be dull, but it's the foundation of learning a foreign language.

解说.zh: 这场足球比赛由一位著名的体育评论员现场解说。
解说.en: A well-known sports commentator provided live commentary for this soccer match.

一口气.zh: 这本小说太好看了，我一口气就读完了。
一口气.en: This novel was so good that I read it in one sitting.

方言.zh: 他说的是上海方言，外地人很难听懂。
方言.en: He speaks the Shanghai dialect, which outsiders find hard to understand.

确立.zh: 这次会议确立了公司未来五年的发展方向。
确立.en: This meeting established the company's direction of development for the next five years.

单调@6.zh: 这幅画颜色太单调了，可以再加点儿绿色。
单调@6.en: The colours of this painting are too dull; you could add some green.

淹.zh: 这条街一下大雨就会被淹，车根本开不过去。
淹.en: This street floods every time it rains hard, and cars can't get through at all.

优异.zh: 这款新手机在测试中表现优异。
优异.en: This new phone performed outstandingly in testing.

媳妇.zh: 他娶了个好媳妇，把家里照顾得井井有条。
媳妇.en: He married a good wife, who keeps the household in perfect order.

北极.zh: 据说在北极的冬夜，经常能看到美丽的极光。
北极.en: It is said that on winter nights in the Arctic you can often see the beautiful aurora.

博览会.zh: 2010年，上海成功举办了世界博览会。
博览会.en: In 2010 Shanghai successfully hosted the World Expo.

儿科.zh: 她是一名儿科医生，每天要给几十个小朋友看病。
儿科.en: She's a pediatrician and sees dozens of children every day.

变质.zh: 这些罐头已经过期变质，不能再吃了。
变质.en: These tins are past their date and have gone bad; they can't be eaten.

贵重.zh: 这份礼物太贵重了，我真的不能收。
贵重.en: This gift is too valuable; I really can't accept it.

动听.zh: 他说得再动听，我也不会相信他了。
动听.en: No matter how nice he makes it sound, I won't believe him anymore.

二氧化碳.zh: 汽车排放的二氧化碳是造成全球变暖的原因之一。
二氧化碳.en: The carbon dioxide emitted by cars is one of the causes of global warming.

急切.zh: 听到门铃响，小狗急切地跑到门口。
急切.en: Hearing the doorbell, the puppy eagerly ran to the door.

长寿.zh: 这个村子里的老人大多很长寿，九十岁以上的就有二十多位。
长寿.en: Most of the elderly in this village live long lives; more than twenty are over ninety.

脚印.zh: 警察在窗户下面发现了几个可疑的脚印。
脚印.en: The police found several suspicious footprints under the window.

流入.zh: 大量外资流入国内市场，带动了经济增长。
流入.en: Large amounts of foreign capital flowed into the domestic market and drove economic growth.

小气@6.zh: 别那么小气，借我一支笔又不会怎么样。
小气@6.en: Don't be so stingy; lending me a pen won't hurt you.

接连.zh: 这支球队接连输了五场比赛，教练压力很大。
接连.en: This team has lost five matches in a row, and the coach is under great pressure.

进而.zh: 他先学会了做饭，进而开了一家自己的小餐馆。
进而.en: He first learned to cook, and then went a step further and opened his own little restaurant.

简化.zh: 汉字简化以后，学习起来容易多了。
简化.en: Since Chinese characters were simplified, they have become much easier to learn.

诚信.zh: 一个人如果失去了诚信，就很难再得到别人的信任。
诚信.en: Once a person loses their integrity, it's very hard to win back other people's trust.

可口.zh: 这家餐厅的点心香甜可口，很受孩子们的欢迎。
可口.en: This restaurant's pastries are sweet and tasty, and very popular with children.

再三@6.zh: 他犹豫再三，最后还是没有把那封信寄出去。
再三@6.en: After hesitating again and again, he still didn't send the letter in the end.

海面.zh: 风停了，海面平静得像一面镜子。
海面.en: The wind died down, and the sea was as calm as a mirror.

不耐烦@6.zh: 他问了好几遍同样的问题，老师也没有不耐烦。
不耐烦@6.en: He asked the same question several times, yet the teacher never grew impatient.

奖牌.zh: 比赛结束后，运动员们高高举起奖牌，向观众挥手致意。
奖牌.en: After the competition, the athletes held their medals high and waved to the crowd.

平方@6.zh: 这个公园占地五千平方米，里面还有一个湖。
平方@6.en: This park covers five thousand square metres and even has a lake.
