噪声.en: Living in a noisy environment for a long time can damage your hearing.

余额.zh: 我查了一下银行卡，发现余额只剩下两百块了。
余额.en: I checked my bank card and found the balance was down to just two hundred yuan.

海拔.zh: 由于海拔太高，很多游客一到拉萨就出现了高原反应。
海拔.en: Because the altitude is so high, many tourists get altitude sickness as soon as they arrive in Lhasa.

跟前.zh: 小狗一听到主人的声音，就跑到他跟前摇尾巴。
跟前.en: As soon as the puppy heard its owner's voice, it ran up to him wagging its tail.

自言自语.zh: 奶奶年纪大了，常常一个人坐在窗前自言自语。
自言自语.en: Grandma is getting old and often sits alone by the window talking to herself.

山坡.zh: 几头牛在山坡上悠闲地吃着草。
山坡.en: A few cows were grazing leisurely on the slope.

只顾.zh: 做父母的不能只顾工作，也要多陪陪孩子。
只顾.en: Parents can't just focus on work; they also need to spend time with their kids.

灾害@6.zh: 今年的洪水灾害影响了很多农民的收成。
灾害@6.en: This year's flood disaster affected many farmers' harvests.

夏令营@6.zh: 这个科学夏令营让孩子们在山里观察星星。
夏令营@6.en: This science summer camp lets children observe the stars in the mountains.

干旱.zh: 这种植物非常耐干旱，在沙漠里也能生长。
干旱.en: This plant is very drought-resistant and can grow even in the desert.

定价.zh: 新产品该怎么定价，公司还在讨论中。
定价.en: The company is still discussing how to price the new product.

坚硬.zh: 这种坚果的外壳十分坚硬，要用锤子才能敲开。
坚硬.en: The shell of this nut is so hard you need a hammer to crack it.

内科@6.zh: 她是一位内科医生，在这家医院工作了十年。
内科@6.en: She's a doctor of internal medicine and has worked at this hospital for ten years.

技艺.zh: 这位杂技演员技艺高超，观众们掌声不断。
技艺.en: This acrobat is so highly skilled that the audience kept applauding.

专科.zh: 这是一家眼科专科医院，治疗近视很有经验。
专科.en: This is a specialist eye hospital with a lot of experience treating nearsightedness.

文艺.zh: 她从小就喜欢文艺，唱歌跳舞样样都会。
文艺.en: She has loved the arts since childhood and can both sing and dance.

一律@6.zh: 公司规定，迟到的员工一律扣钱。
一律@6.en: Company rules say that all late employees, without exception, lose pay.

对称.zh: 仔细看会发现，蝴蝶的两只翅膀是完全对称的。
对称.en: Look closely and you'll see a butterfly's two wings are perfectly symmetrical.

顿时.zh: 灯一灭，屋子里顿时一片漆黑。
顿时.en: The moment the lights went out, the room was plunged into darkness.

畅通.zh: 请保持消防通道畅通，不要在这里停车。
畅通.en: Please keep the fire lane clear and do not park here.

截至.zh: 截至目前，这部电影的票房已经突破十亿元。
截至.en: As of now, this film's box office has passed one billion yuan.

公安.zh: 他毕业后当了一名公安干警，负责维护社会治安。
公安.en: After graduating he became a police officer, responsible for keeping public order.

科目.zh: 驾照考试一共有四个科目，他已经通过了三个。
科目.en: The driving test has four parts in total, and he has already passed three.

高超.zh: 魔术师用高超的技巧把一枚硬币变没了。
高超.en: With masterly skill, the magician made a coin vanish.

招生.zh: 暑假前，各个培训机构纷纷打出了招生广告。
招生.en: Before the summer holidays, training schools everywhere put out ads to recruit students.

出游.zh: 天气暖和了，正是全家出游的好时候。
出游.en: Now that it's warmer, it's the perfect time for a family outing.

心疼.zh: 这件新外套刚穿一天就弄破了，我心疼得不得了。
心疼.en: I tore this new coat after wearing it for only one day, and it really pains me.

加剧.zh: 长时间熬夜会加剧头痛的症状。
加剧.en: Staying up late for long periods will make headache symptoms worse.

适度.zh: 孩子玩游戏要适度，不能一玩就是一整天。
适度.en: Kids should play games in moderation, not for a whole day at a time.

长辈@6.zh: 吃饭的时候，要等长辈先动筷子。
长辈@6.en: At meals, you should wait for your elders to pick up their chopsticks first.

定时.zh: 我给空调设了定时，两个小时以后它会自动关掉。
定时.en: I set the timer on the air conditioner, so it will switch off automatically in two hours.

减压.zh: 工作压力大的时候，他就去健身房跑步减压。
减压.en: When work gets stressful, he goes to the gym and runs to unwind.

附件.zh: 合同的附件与正文具有同等的法律效力。
附件.en: The annexes to a contract have the same legal force as the main text.

化石.zh: 这块石头里有一条鱼的化石，已经有几百万年了。
化石.en: This stone contains the fossil of a fish that is millions of years old.

入门.zh: 学书法入门不难，但要写好就得下苦功了。
入门.en: Getting started with calligraphy isn't hard, but writing well takes a lot of hard work.

淘气@6.zh: 我弟弟是个有名的淘气包，邻居们没有不认识他的。
淘气@6.en: My little brother is a notorious little rascal; every neighbour knows him.

飞速.zh: 一辆摩托车从我身边飞速驶过。

贴近.zh: 他把耳朵贴近门，想听听里面的人在说什么。
贴近.en: He put his ear close to the door, trying to hear what the people inside were saying.

踏实.zh: 考试前准备充分，心里就踏实多了。
踏实.en: When you've prepared well before an exam, you feel much more at ease.

学问@6.zh: 做菜也是一门学问，火候很重要。
学问@6.en: Cooking is a body of knowledge too; controlling the heat is very important.

大伙儿.zh: 饭菜都做好了，大伙儿快趁热来吃吧！
大伙儿.en: The food is ready, everyone; come and eat it while it's hot!

晾.zh: 洗完的衣服要及时拿到阳台上晾干。
晾.en: Washed clothes should be taken out to the balcony to dry promptly.

简介.zh: 买书之前，我习惯先看看封底的内容简介。
简介.en: Before buying a book, I usually read the synopsis on the back cover.

炎症.zh: 伤口没有及时处理，结果引起了炎症。
炎症.en: The wound wasn't treated in time and became inflamed.

与其@6.zh: 与其每天抱怨工作，不如去找一份新工作。
与其@6.en: Rather than complaining about your job every day, you'd do better to find a new one.

借鉴.zh: 这篇文章的写法很值得大家借鉴。
借鉴.en: The way this article is written is well worth learning from.

亏损.zh: 由于经营不善，这家书店去年亏损了二十多万元。
亏损.en: Due to poor management, this bookshop lost over 200,000 yuan last year.

炎热.zh: 在炎热的夏天，人们都喜欢去游泳。
炎热.en: In the sweltering summer, everyone likes to go swimming.

后人.zh: 他的发明造福了后人，至今仍被人们怀念。
后人.en: His invention benefited later generations, and he is still remembered today.

转交.zh: 李经理今天不在，你的材料我会替你转交。
转交.en: Manager Li isn't in today; I'll pass your documents on to him for you.

遗址.zh: 圆明园遗址公园每年都吸引大量游客前来参观。
遗址.en: The Old Summer Palace Ruins Park attracts large numbers of visitors every year.

其间.zh: 从提交申请到正式批准用了三个月，其间我又补交了两次材料。
其间.en: It took three months from applying to official approval, and in the meantime I had to submit extra documents twice.

固体.zh: 黄油在冰箱里是固体，加热后就变成了液体。
固体.en: Butter is solid in the fridge but turns liquid when heated.

新款.zh: 这是我们公司今年推出的新款手机，功能比旧款强多了。
新款.en: This is the new phone model our company launched this year; it's much more capable than the old one.

内外.zh: 为了迎接检查，大家把校园内外打扫得干干净净。
内外.en: To get ready for the inspection, everyone cleaned the campus inside and out.

房价.zh: 最近几个月，这个城市的房价一直在下跌。
房价.en: Property prices in this city have kept falling over the past few months.

播种.zh: 爷爷说现在还太冷，等过了清明再播种。
播种.en: Grandpa says it's still too cold now; we'll sow after Qingming.

鲜艳@6.zh: 春天到了，公园里开满了鲜艳的花朵。
鲜艳@6.en: Spring has arrived, and the park is full of brightly coloured flowers.

报刊.zh: 他退休后常给一些报刊写文章。
报刊.en: After retiring, he often writes articles for newspapers and magazines.

看不起@6.zh: 他因为家里穷，曾经被同学看不起。
看不起@6.en: Because his family was poor, he was once looked down on by his classmates.

修订.zh: 公司正在修订员工手册，增加了一些新规定。
修订.en: The company is revising the employee handbook and adding some new rules.

招手.zh: 看到我进门，她笑着向我招手，让我坐到她旁边。
招手.en: When she saw me come in, she smiled and beckoned me to sit next to her.

只得.zh: 外面下起了大雨，运动会只得推迟到下周举行。
只得.en: It started pouring, so the sports meet had to be postponed to next week.

优化.zh: 政府不断优化营商环境，吸引了更多企业投资。
优化.en: The government keeps improving the business environment, attracting more companies to invest.

庄稼.zh: 秋天到了，农民们正忙着在田里收割庄稼。
庄稼.en: Autumn has arrived, and the farmers are busy harvesting the crops in the fields.

新颖.zh: 这位作家的写作角度很新颖，读者们都很喜欢。
新颖.en: This writer's angle is very original, and readers love it.

传承.zh: 这家老字号已经传承了一百多年，味道一直没变。
传承.en: This time-honored shop has been handed down for over a hundred years, and its flavor has never changed.

多媒体.zh: 老师用多媒体课件上课，学生们听得特别认真。
多媒体.en: The teacher used multimedia slides in class, and the students listened especially closely.

稿子.zh: 他上台演讲时太紧张，忘了带稿子，只好临场发挥。
稿子.en: He was so nervous going on stage that he forgot his script and had to improvise.

象棋@6.zh: 他从小就跟爸爸学下象棋，现在已经很厉害了。
象棋@6.en: He learned Chinese chess from his dad as a child and is now very good.

奶粉.zh: 这家超市的进口奶粉正在打折，很多年轻父母都来抢购。
奶粉.en: Imported formula is on sale at this supermarket, and lots of young parents are rushing to buy it.

晴朗.zh: 晴朗的夜晚，在郊外可以看到满天的星星。
晴朗.en: On a clear night, you can see a sky full of stars out in the countryside.

轮子.zh: 这辆玩具车少了一个轮子，跑不起来了。
轮子.en: This toy car is missing a wheel and won't run.

空闲@6.zh: 他工作很忙，几乎没有空闲时间陪孩子。
空闲@6.en: He's very busy at work and has almost no free time to spend with his children.

岁数.zh: 爷爷岁数大了，耳朵有点儿背，你说话大声点儿。
岁数.en: Grandpa is getting on in years and is a bit hard of hearing, so speak up.

郊外.zh: 城里太吵了，他退休后搬到郊外住了。
郊外.en: The city was too noisy, so after retiring he moved out to the outskirts.

湿度.zh: 这种植物喜欢温暖的环境，对空气湿度的要求也比较高。
湿度.en: This plant likes warm conditions and also needs fairly high humidity.

往年.zh: 跟往年相比，今年报考研究生的人数又增加了。
往年.en: Compared with past years, the number of people applying for graduate school has gone up again this year.

节能.zh: 夏天把空调温度调到二十六度，既舒服又节能。
节能.en: In summer, setting the AC to 26 degrees is both comfortable and saves energy.

便捷.zh: 手机支付既安全又便捷，现在很多人出门都不带现金了。
便捷.en: Mobile payment is safe and convenient, so many people no longer carry cash when they go out.

勤劳.zh: 她是个勤劳的农家姑娘，每天天不亮就下地干活。
勤劳.en: She is a hardworking farm girl who goes to work in the fields before dawn every day.

中旬@6.zh: 这批货最晚下个月中旬就能到。
中旬@6.en: This shipment will arrive by the middle of next month at the latest.

用人.zh: 最近店里生意特别好，正是用人的时候。
用人.en: Business at the shop has been booming lately, so it's exactly when we need more hands.

口感.zh: 这款酸奶加了水果粒，口感更丰富了。
口感.en: This yogurt has added fruit pieces, giving it a richer texture.

念书.zh: 我妹妹在北京念书，每年只有寒暑假才回家。
念书.en: My younger sister is at school in Beijing and only comes home during the winter and summer breaks.

招收.zh: 这个舞蹈班只招收五岁以上的儿童。
招收.en: This dance class only takes children aged five and over.

理科.zh: 高二分科的时候，她选了理科，因为她想当工程师。
理科.en: When students chose their tracks in the second year of high school, she picked sciences because she wants to be an engineer.

胶带.zh: 海报掉下来了，你帮我用胶带把它重新贴上吧。
胶带.en: The poster fell down; could you help me stick it back up with tape?

平方米.zh: 这个广场占地两万平方米，可以同时容纳上万人。
平方米.en: The square covers 20,000 square meters and can hold over ten thousand people at once.

类别.zh: 垃圾分为四个类别，请大家按要求投放。
类别.en: Garbage is divided into four categories; please dispose of it accordingly.

涌现.zh: 最近几年，市场上涌现出各种各样的新能源汽车。
涌现.en: In recent years, all kinds of new-energy vehicles have flooded onto the market.

联网.zh: 现在很多家电都可以联网，用手机就能远程控制。
联网.en: Many home appliances can now go online and be controlled remotely from your phone.

客车.zh: 一辆载有三十名乘客的客车在高速公路上发生了事故。
客车.en: A coach carrying thirty passengers had an accident on the highway.

团圆.zh: 在外地工作的哥哥今年终于能回家过年，全家团圆了。
团圆.en: My brother, who works far away, can finally come home for New Year, so the whole family is reunited.

棋子.zh: 孩子把棋子撒了一地，我们找了半天才找齐。
棋子.en: The kid scattered the pieces all over the floor, and it took us ages to find them all.

吉祥.zh: 龙在中国文化中象征着吉祥。
吉祥.en: In Chinese culture, the dragon symbolises good fortune.

求职.zh: 他在求职网站上投了几十份简历，终于收到了面试通知。
求职.en: He sent out dozens of résumés on job sites and finally got an interview.

发愁@6.zh: 妈妈每天都为做什么菜发愁。
发愁@6.en: Every day Mum frets about what to cook.

散文.zh: 这本杂志主要刊登散文和诗歌。
散文.en: This magazine mainly publishes essays and poetry.

相声.zh: 春节晚会上的这段相声把全场观众都逗笑了。
相声.en: This crosstalk act at the Spring Festival Gala made the whole audience laugh.

朴素.zh: 老一辈人艰苦朴素的作风值得我们学习。
朴素.en: The older generation's hard-working, frugal ways are worth learning from.

国歌.zh: 运动员站上领奖台，听到国歌响起，激动得流下了眼泪。
国歌.en: Standing on the podium and hearing the national anthem play, the athlete was moved to tears.

倒车.zh: 停车场太窄，他倒车的时候不小心撞到了柱子。
倒车.en: The parking lot was so tight that he accidentally hit a pillar while backing up.

防治.zh: 春天是花粉过敏的高发季节，要做好防治工作。
防治.en: Spring is peak season for pollen allergies, so prevention and treatment are important.

风力.zh: 这个地区建了很多风力发电站，为城市提供清洁能源。
风力.en: Many wind power stations have been built in this region, supplying the city with clean energy.

乐曲.zh: 这首乐曲旋律优美，听了让人心情放松。
乐曲.en: This piece has a beautiful melody that puts you at ease.

片面@6.zh: 只看一个人的成绩来判断他，是很片面的。
片面@6.en: Judging a person only by his grades is very one-sided.

清淡@6.zh: 这家餐厅的菜味道很清淡，适合老人吃。
清淡@6.en: The food in this restaurant is light, which suits elderly people.

酒水.zh: 这家饭店规定，客人不能自带酒水。
酒水.en: This restaurant doesn't allow guests to bring their own drinks.

新兴.zh: 随着互联网的普及，出现了很多新兴职业，比如网络主播。
新兴.en: With the spread of the internet, many new professions have emerged, such as online streamers.

灯笼.zh: 元宵节晚上，孩子们提着灯笼在街上猜谜语。
灯笼.en: On the evening of the Lantern Festival, children carry lanterns in the street and guess riddles.

发炎.zh: 他的嗓子发炎了，说话声音都哑了。
发炎.en: His throat is inflamed, and his voice has gone hoarse.

饮用水.zh: 出门爬山一定要带足饮用水，山上没有卖水的地方。
饮用水.en: Be sure to bring enough drinking water when you go hiking; there's nowhere to buy water on the mountain.

年终.zh: 快到年底了，各部门都在忙着写年终总结。
年终.en: The year is nearly over, and every department is busy writing its year-end review.

汇款.zh: 收到汇款以后，我们会尽快给您发货。
汇款.en: Once we receive your payment, we'll ship your order as soon as possible.

农产品.zh: 这个县的农产品质量好，远销全国各地。
农产品.en: This county's farm products are of high quality and are sold all over the country.

实惠.zh: 这款手机功能齐全，价格也实惠，很受学生欢迎。
实惠.en: This phone is fully featured and affordable, and it's very popular with students.

轮船.zh: 在没有飞机的年代，人们只能坐轮船出国。
轮船.en: In the days before aeroplanes, people could only go abroad by steamship.

一帆风顺.zh: 创业的路不可能一帆风顺，总会遇到各种困难。
一帆风顺.en: Starting a business is never plain sailing; you'll always run into difficulties.

经商@6.zh: 他家祖祖辈辈都在这条街上经商。
经商@6.en: His family has done business on this street for generations.

浓厚.zh: 过年时，街上的节日气氛十分浓厚。
浓厚.en: At New Year, the festive atmosphere on the streets is very strong.

钢笔.zh: 练字的时候，老师要求我们用钢笔，不能用圆珠笔。
钢笔.en: For handwriting practice, the teacher makes us use fountain pens, not ballpoints.

国产.zh: 这部国产电影上映三天，票房就突破了十亿元。
国产.en: This Chinese-made film took in over a billion yuan at the box office within three days of release.

热水器.zh: 洗澡前记得先打开热水器，等水热了再洗。
热水器.en: Remember to turn on the water heater before your shower and wait until the water's hot.

常年.zh: 他常年在外地工作，一年只回家一两次。
常年.en: He has worked away from home for years and only goes back once or twice a year.

山峰.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山峰。
山峰.en: Mount Everest is the highest peak in the world.

方方面面.zh: 开公司要考虑的事情很多，方方面面都得想到。
方方面面.en: There's a lot to consider when starting a company; you have to think of everything.

益处.zh: 多读书的益处很多，它能让人开阔眼界。
益处.en: Reading a lot has many benefits; it broadens your horizons.

下功夫.zh: 只要肯下功夫，没有学不会的东西。
下功夫.en: As long as you're willing to work hard, there's nothing you can't learn.

民歌.zh: 晚会上，她用家乡话唱了一首民歌，赢得了热烈的掌声。
民歌.en: At the party, she sang a folk song in her hometown dialect and won warm applause.

天文.zh: 这座城市新建了一座天文馆，周末很多孩子去参观。
天文.en: The city has built a new planetarium, and many children visit it at weekends.

科普.zh: 博物馆为孩子们举办了一场天文科普讲座。
科普.en: The museum held a popular-science talk on astronomy for children.

朗读@6.zh: 她在比赛中朗读了一首自己写的诗。
朗读@6.en: In the competition she read aloud a poem she had written herself.

遍地.zh: 春天的草原上遍地都是野花。
遍地.en: In spring the grassland is covered with wildflowers.

少儿.zh: 暑假期间，图书馆为少儿读者推出了很多活动。
少儿.en: During the summer holidays, the library put on many activities for young readers.

路况.zh: 下雪天路况不好，开车一定要慢一点儿。
路况.en: Road conditions are bad when it snows, so be sure to drive slowly.

机动车.zh: 近年来，城市里的机动车数量增长很快，交通越来越拥挤。
机动车.en: In recent years the number of motor vehicles in the city has grown fast, and traffic is getting more and more congested.

颈椎.zh: 长期伏案工作的人容易得颈椎病。
颈椎.en: People who work bent over a desk for long periods are prone to neck (cervical spine) problems.

原材料.zh: 这个地区盛产木材，为家具厂提供了丰富的原材料。
原材料.en: This region produces a lot of timber, giving furniture factories plenty of raw material.

胶水@6.zh: 信封没封好，你拿胶水再粘一下。
胶水@6.en: The envelope isn't sealed properly; stick it down again with some glue.

从业.zh: 从业人员必须持证上岗，这是行业的基本要求。
从业.en: Practitioners must be licensed before they start work; that's a basic requirement of the industry.

用功@6.zh: 考试快到了，大家都在图书馆用功读书。
用功@6.en: Exams are coming, and everyone is studying hard in the library.

审美.zh: 随着生活水平的提高，人们的审美眼光也越来越高。
审美.en: As living standards rise, people's aesthetic standards are getting higher and higher.

总计.zh: 把各项费用加在一起，总计花了一万两千元。
总计.en: Adding up all the expenses, we spent twelve thousand yuan in total.

宏大.zh: 电影开头的战争场面非常宏大，看得人热血沸腾。
宏大.en: The battle scene at the start of the film is so epic that it gets your blood pumping.

共计.zh: 本次比赛共计有八百多名选手报名参加。
共计.en: A total of more than eight hundred contestants signed up for this competition.

梅花.zh: 下了一夜雪，院子里的梅花在白雪的映衬下显得更红了。
梅花.en: After a night of snow, the plum blossoms in the courtyard looked even redder against the white.

园林.zh: 这座古典园林里有假山、池塘和长廊。
园林.en: This classical garden has rockeries, ponds and long covered walkways.

近视.zh: 长时间玩手机容易导致近视，要注意保护眼睛。
近视.en: Spending long hours on your phone can lead to nearsightedness, so take care of your eyes.

美观.zh: 包装不仅要美观，更要能保护里面的商品。
美观.en: Packaging should not only look good but, more importantly, protect the goods inside.

灾区.zh: 大批医护人员赶到灾区，为受伤群众治疗。
灾区.en: Large numbers of medical staff rushed to the stricken area to treat the injured.

启事.zh: 公司在网站上发布了一则招聘启事。
启事.en: The company posted a recruitment notice on its website.

马虎.zh: 这可是关系到病人生命的事，一点儿也马虎不得。
马虎.en: This concerns a patient's life, so there's no room for any carelessness.

音节.zh: “老师”这个词有两个音节，第二个是第一声。
音节.en: The word "laoshi" has two syllables, and the second one is in the first tone.

有序.zh: 虽然现场来了上千人，但一切都进行得井然有序。
有序.en: Even though over a thousand people showed up, everything went smoothly and in good order.

相等.zh: 这个三角形的三条边长度都相等。
相等.en: All three sides of this triangle are equal in length.

比重.zh: 在他的家庭开支中，房租占了很大的比重。
比重.en: Rent makes up a large share of his household spending.

受灾.zh: 政府及时向受灾群众发放了食物和帐篷。
受灾.en: The government promptly handed out food and tents to the people affected by the disaster.

灰心@6.zh: 投了几十份简历都没有回音，他有点儿灰心了。
灰心@6.en: He sent out dozens of CVs without a reply and is starting to lose heart.

人均.zh: 这个国家的人均收入在过去十年里翻了一番。
人均.en: This country's per capita income has doubled over the past ten years.

拐弯@6.zh: 车拐弯的时候要减速，注意行人。
拐弯@6.en: Slow down when turning a corner and watch out for pedestrians.

银牌.zh: 只差零点一秒就能拿金牌了，最后他只得到了一枚银牌。
银牌.en: He was just a tenth of a second short of gold and ended up with silver.

养老院.zh: 子女工作太忙，只好把老人送进了养老院。
养老院.en: The children were too busy with work, so they had to put their elderly parent in a care home.

严寒.zh: 为了抵御严寒，北方的房子墙壁都很厚。
严寒.en: To keep out the bitter cold, houses in the north have very thick walls.

古迹.zh: 保护古迹是每个人的责任，请不要在墙上乱写乱画。
古迹.en: Protecting historic sites is everyone's responsibility; please don't write or draw on the walls.

托运.zh: 我们搬家时，把家具交给物流公司托运。
托运.en: When we moved house, we had a logistics company ship our furniture.

难点.zh: 老师把考试中的重点和难点都给我们讲清楚了。
难点.en: The teacher clearly explained the key points and the tricky parts of the exam to us.

产地.zh: 新疆是中国有名的哈密瓜产地。
产地.en: Xinjiang is China's best-known region for growing Hami melons.

补习.zh: 为了考上好大学，很多高中生假期都在参加补习。
补习.en: To get into a good university, many high school students spend their holidays in tutoring classes.

国宝.zh: 这件青铜器是博物馆的镇馆之宝，被称为国宝级文物。
国宝.en: This bronze is the museum's prize piece and is considered a relic of national-treasure status.

研讨.zh: 下周学院将举办一场关于人工智能的学术研讨会。
研讨.en: Next week the school will hold an academic seminar on artificial intelligence.

两岸.zh: 长江两岸灯火通明，夜景非常美。
两岸.en: Both banks of the Yangtze are brightly lit, and the night view is gorgeous.

补课.zh: 因为台风停课两天，学校决定周六补课。
补课.en: Classes were cancelled for two days because of the typhoon, so the school decided to hold make-up classes on Saturday.

保修.zh: 手机还在保修期内，你直接拿到售后服务中心去吧。
保修.en: Your phone is still under warranty; just take it to the service center.

喜事.zh: 看你笑得这么开心，是不是有什么喜事？
喜事.en: You're smiling so much; has something good happened?

晕车.zh: 山路弯弯曲曲的，好几个同学都晕车吐了。
晕车.en: The mountain road was so winding that several classmates got carsick and threw up.

日前.zh: 该公司日前宣布，将在明年推出一款新能源汽车。
日前.en: The company announced recently that it will launch a new-energy vehicle next year.

相传.zh: 这种手艺在当地代代相传，已经有几百年的历史了。
相传.en: This craft has been passed down locally from generation to generation for several hundred years.

由来.zh: 这个地名的由来跟一个古老的传说有关。
由来.en: The origin of this place name is tied to an ancient legend.

母语.zh: 学习外语时，很多人习惯先在心里用母语翻译一遍。
母语.en: When learning a foreign language, many people habitually translate into their mother tongue in their heads first.

楼道.zh: 请不要在楼道里堆放杂物，以免影响通行。
楼道.en: Please don't pile things in the hallway; they get in people's way.

绿化.zh: 为了绿化荒山，村民们每年春天都上山种树。
绿化.en: To green the barren hills, the villagers go up and plant trees every spring.

长短.zh: 人生的意义不在于寿命的长短，而在于活得有没有价值。
长短.en: The meaning of life lies not in how long you live, but in whether you live a worthwhile life.

稿件.zh: 请在本周五之前把稿件发到编辑的邮箱。
稿件.en: Please send your manuscript to the editor's email by this Friday.

声调@6.zh: 普通话有四个声调，再加一个轻声。
声调@6.en: Mandarin has four tones, plus a neutral tone.

参展.zh: 他的油画被选中参展，这让他非常激动。
参展.en: His oil painting was selected for the exhibition, which thrilled him.

毫米.zh: 今天这场大雨的降水量超过了五十毫米。
毫米.en: Today's heavy rain brought more than fifty millimetres of rainfall.

家常.zh: 两位老朋友坐在院子里喝茶，聊着家常。
家常.en: The two old friends sat in the courtyard drinking tea and chatting about everyday family matters.

人工智能.zh: 现在很多客服电话都是由人工智能自动接听的。
人工智能.en: Many customer service calls are now answered automatically by AI.

国情.zh: 外国企业想在中国发展，必须先了解中国的国情。
国情.en: Foreign companies that want to grow in China must first understand the country's conditions.

文具@6.zh: 学校门口有一家小文具店，卖铅笔和本子。
文具@6.en: There's a small stationery shop by the school gate that sells pencils and notebooks.

铜牌.zh: 在三四名决赛中，他战胜了对手，获得了铜牌。
铜牌.en: In the third-place match, he beat his opponent and took the bronze.

民俗.zh: 这个民俗博物馆展示了当地人的婚礼习俗和传统服装。
民俗.en: This folk museum displays local wedding customs and traditional clothing.

成语@6.zh: “画蛇添足”是一个大家都很熟悉的成语。
成语@6.en: "Drawing legs on a snake" is an idiom everyone knows well.

一系列.zh: 搬到新城市后，他遇到了一系列问题，比如找房子、找工作。
一系列.en: After moving to a new city, he ran into a whole string of problems, like finding a place to live and finding a job.

文科.zh: 这所大学以文科见长，中文系和历史系尤其有名。
文科.en: This university is strong in the liberal arts; its Chinese and history departments are especially well known.

不料.zh: 他以为考试很简单，不料最后一道题一点思路也没有。
不料.en: He thought the exam would be easy, but unexpectedly he had no idea how to do the last question.

救灾.zh: 地震发生后，政府立即拨出专款用于救灾。
救灾.en: After the earthquake, the government immediately allocated special funds for disaster relief.

沿海.zh: 每年夏天，沿海地区都会受到台风的影响。
沿海.en: Every summer, coastal areas are affected by typhoons.

升学.zh: 这所高中的升学率很高，几乎所有学生都考上了大学。
升学.en: This high school has a very high progression rate; almost all its students get into university.

下旬.zh: 一般到了十一月下旬，北方就开始下雪了。
下旬.en: By late November it usually starts snowing in the north.

游人.zh: 节假日公园里游人很多，最好早点儿去。
游人.en: The park is crowded with visitors on holidays, so it's best to go early.

粘贴@6.zh: 你可以把这段文字复制下来，粘贴到邮件里。
粘贴@6.en: You can copy this text and paste it into the email.

炒股.zh: 最近股市行情好，连我妈都开始在手机上炒股了。
炒股.en: The stock market has been doing well lately; even my mom has started trading on her phone.

粽子.zh: 奶奶包的粽子里有红枣，又香又甜。
粽子.en: The zongzi Grandma makes have red dates inside; they're fragrant and sweet.

选修.zh: 这门课不是必修课，同学们可以根据兴趣自由选修。
选修.en: This course isn't compulsory; students are free to take it as an elective if they're interested.

毫升.zh: 医生嘱咐他每次服用十毫升，一天三次。
毫升.en: The doctor told him to take ten milliliters at a time, three times a day.

季军.zh: 冠军和亚军都被别的学校拿走了，我们最后只拿到了季军。
季军.en: Other schools took first and second place; in the end we only got third.

场馆.zh: 比赛开始前一个小时，场馆里已经坐满了观众。
场馆.en: An hour before the match began, the venue was already packed with spectators.

肥沃.zh: 东北的黑土地非常肥沃，出产优质大米。
肥沃.en: The black soil of the northeast is very fertile and produces high-quality rice.

打雷.zh: 小时候我一听到打雷就害怕得钻到被子里。
打雷.en: As a child, whenever I heard thunder I'd get scared and hide under the covers.

好客@6.zh: 主人非常好客，非要留我们吃晚饭。
好客@6.en: Our host was very hospitable and insisted that we stay for dinner.

赶忙.zh: 听说孩子在学校受伤了，妈妈赶忙放下工作往学校跑。
赶忙.en: Hearing that her child had been hurt at school, the mother dropped her work and hurried there.

浏览器.zh: 为了安全，最好定期清理浏览器的历史记录。
浏览器.en: For security, it's best to clear your browser history regularly.

拜年.zh: 现在很多年轻人习惯用视频电话给长辈拜年。
拜年.en: Nowadays many young people wish their elders a happy New Year by video call.

水稻.zh: 秋天到了，田里的水稻一片金黄，农民们开始收割了。
水稻.en: Autumn has come; the rice in the fields has turned golden and the farmers have started harvesting.

模特儿.zh: 服装发布会上，模特儿们穿着各式各样的时装走上了舞台。
模特儿.en: At the fashion show, the models walked onto the stage in all kinds of outfits.

名胜.zh: 这座小城虽然没有什么名胜，但生活节奏很慢，很适合度假。
名胜.en: This small town doesn't have any famous sights, but life moves slowly there, which makes it great for a holiday.

好容易.zh: 找了半个小时，好容易才找到一个停车位。
好容易.en: After searching for half an hour, we finally managed to find a parking space.

工序.zh: 这道工序非常关键，稍有差错整个产品就报废了。
工序.en: This step is crucial; the slightest mistake and the whole product has to be scrapped.

旱灾.zh: 连续三个月没下雨，这个地区遭受了百年不遇的旱灾。
旱灾.en: With no rain for three months in a row, the region was hit by its worst drought in a century.

千家万户.zh: 春节晚会通过电视传到千家万户，陪伴大家度过除夕。
千家万户.en: The Spring Festival Gala reaches millions of households on TV, keeping everyone company on New Year's Eve.

常温.zh: 这种药需要冷藏，不能在常温下存放。
常温.en: This medicine needs to be refrigerated; it can't be stored at room temperature.

朝代.zh: 历史上每个朝代都有自己独特的服饰风格。
朝代.en: Every dynasty in history had its own distinctive style of dress.

家家户户.zh: 一到傍晚，村子里家家户户的烟囱里都冒出了炊烟。
家家户户.en: As evening falls, cooking smoke rises from the chimney of every home in the village.

高新技术.zh: 政府鼓励企业加大投入，发展高新技术产业。
高新技术.en: The government encourages companies to invest more in developing high-tech industries.

羽绒服.zh: 这件羽绒服又轻又暖和，下雪天穿正合适。
羽绒服.en: This down jacket is light and warm, just right for snowy days.

衣食住行.zh: 工作以后，我的衣食住行都要靠自己了，不能再依赖父母。
衣食住行.en: Now that I'm working, I have to provide my own food, clothing, housing and transport and can't rely on my parents anymore.

必修.zh: 这门课是本专业的必修课程，不及格就不能毕业。
必修.en: This is a compulsory course for the major; if you fail it, you can't graduate.

上旬.zh: 这批货物预计在下个月上旬到达。
上旬.en: This shipment is expected to arrive early next month.

看得起.zh: 谢谢你这么看得起我，把这么重要的任务交给我。
看得起.en: Thank you for thinking so highly of me and trusting me with such an important task.

戏曲.zh: 爷爷特别喜欢听戏曲，每天都打开收音机听上一段。
戏曲.en: Grandpa loves traditional opera and turns on the radio every day to listen to a bit of it.

海内外.zh: 这次纪念活动吸引了海内外数千名华人参加。
海内外.en: The commemoration drew thousands of Chinese people from home and abroad.

多元.zh: 随着社会的发展，年轻人的价值观越来越多元了。
多元.en: As society develops, young people's values are becoming more and more diverse.

好学.zh: 她从小聪明好学，学习成绩一直名列前茅。
好学.en: She's been bright and studious since childhood and has always been at the top of her class.

汤圆.zh: 妈妈煮了一锅芝麻馅儿的汤圆，大家吃得很香。
汤圆.en: Mom cooked a pot of sesame-filled tangyuan, and everyone ate them with relish.

初等.zh: 这本书只讲初等数学，高中生完全看得懂。
初等.en: This book only covers elementary mathematics, so high school students can follow it easily.

电饭锅.zh: 这个电饭锅有预约功能，早上起床就能吃到热粥。
电饭锅.en: This rice cooker has a delay timer, so there's hot porridge ready when you get up.

小偷儿.zh: 警察很快就抓住了那个偷钱包的小偷儿。
小偷儿.en: The police quickly caught the thief who stole the wallet.

低碳.zh: 为了保护环境，我们应该提倡低碳出行，少开私家车。
低碳.en: To protect the environment, we should promote low-carbon travel and drive our own cars less.

薯片.zh: 薯片好吃是好吃，但热量太高，不能多吃。
薯片.en: Chips are tasty, sure, but they're high in calories, so don't eat too many.

性价比.zh: 买东西不能只看价格，还要看性价比。
性价比.en: When shopping, you shouldn't look only at the price but also at the value for money.

北美洲.zh: 这家公司的产品主要出口到欧洲和北美洲。
北美洲.en: This company mainly exports its products to Europe and North America.

倍增.zh: 听了大家的鼓励，他信心倍增，决定再试一次。
倍增.en: Everyone's encouragement greatly boosted his confidence, and he decided to try again.

不得.zh: 未经允许，任何人不得进入实验室。
不得.en: No one may enter the lab without permission.

材质.zh: 这两个包看起来差不多，但材质不同，价格相差很大。
材质.en: These two bags look about the same, but they're made of different materials, so their prices are very different.

插座.zh: 这个插座坏了，电脑没法充电。
插座.en: This socket is broken, so the computer can't charge.

产出.zh: 企业要想办法提高投入产出比，降低成本。
产出.en: Companies need to find ways to improve their input-output ratio and lower costs.

场次.zh: 今晚八点的场次已经满了，只剩下十点的票了。
场次.en: Tonight's 8 o'clock show is sold out; there are only tickets left for 10.

撤回.zh: 由于受到很多批评，公司撤回了这项新规定。
撤回.en: After a lot of criticism, the company withdrew the new rule.

出力.zh: 他总想为家乡的发展出力，所以大学毕业后回到了老家。
出力.en: He always wanted to contribute to his hometown's development, so he went back after graduating.

存储.zh: 这些重要文件最好存储在云端，以防电脑坏了丢失。
存储.en: It's best to store these important files in the cloud in case your computer breaks and they get lost.

打卡.zh: 这家网红咖啡店每天都有很多年轻人来拍照打卡。
打卡.en: Every day, lots of young people come to this trendy café to take photos and check in.

大幅.zh: 受天气影响，蔬菜价格大幅上涨。
大幅.en: Because of the weather, vegetable prices have shot up.

大洋洲.zh: 这次旅行我们去了大洋洲，参观了新西兰的好几个城市。
大洋洲.en: On this trip we went to Oceania and visited several cities in New Zealand.

点击.zh: 这段视频发布后，点击量很快就超过了一百万。
点击.en: After the video was posted, its view count quickly passed one million.

店铺.zh: 他在网上开了一家店铺，专门卖家乡的特产。
店铺.en: He opened an online shop that sells specialty products from his hometown.

定制.zh: 旅行社可以根据客人的需求定制旅游路线。
定制.en: The travel agency can tailor itineraries to what customers want.

动漫.zh: 这部国产动漫在网上播出后，人气一下子就上来了。
动漫.en: Once this Chinese animated series aired online, its popularity shot up overnight.

对接.zh: 学校积极与企业对接，帮助毕业生找到工作。
对接.en: The school actively partners with companies to help graduates find jobs.

多才多艺.zh: 我们班的班长唱歌、跳舞、写文章样样都行，真是多才多艺。
多才多艺.en: Our class monitor can sing, dance and write; she's truly versatile.

法定.zh: 在中国，男性的法定结婚年龄是二十二岁。
法定.en: In China, the legal marriage age for men is twenty-two.

放飞.zh: 等小鸟的伤养好了，我们就把它放飞了。
放飞.en: Once the little bird's injury healed, we released it.

肺炎.zh: 医生说老人得的是肺炎，需要住院治疗。
肺炎.en: The doctor said the old man has pneumonia and needs to be treated in hospital.

分级.zh: 很多国家对电影实行分级制度，有些电影不适合儿童观看。
分级.en: Many countries have a rating system for films, and some films aren't suitable for children.

分期.zh: 这笔钱我一下子拿不出来，能不能分期还给你？
分期.en: I can't come up with this money all at once; can I pay you back in installments?

高端.zh: 公司决定进军高端市场，推出价格更贵、质量更好的产品。
高端.en: The company decided to move into the high-end market, launching pricier, higher-quality products.

寒冬.zh: 这些流浪猫没有地方住，很难熬过这个寒冬。
寒冬.en: These stray cats have nowhere to live and will struggle to make it through this harsh winter.

好不.zh: 他穿上新军装，骑着高头大马，好不威风。
好不.en: In his new uniform, riding a tall horse, he looked so impressive.

花朵.zh: 孩子们是祖国的花朵，需要我们好好爱护。
花朵.en: Children are the flowers of the nation and need our loving care.

滑行.zh: 他穿上冰鞋，在冰面上轻快地滑行。
滑行.en: He put on his skates and glided lightly across the ice.

怀.zh: 她心怀感激地说：“没有你们的帮助，就没有今天的我。”
怀.en: Full of gratitude, she said, "Without your help, I wouldn't be where I am today."

击败.zh: 在总决赛中，这位年轻选手击败了上届冠军，令人吃惊。
击败.en: In the final, this young player stunned everyone by defeating the defending champion.

加倍.zh: 上次考试没考好，这次他加倍努力，终于考了第一名。
加倍.en: He did badly on the last exam, so this time he worked twice as hard and finally came first.

家居.zh: 这本杂志专门介绍家居装饰，教人怎么布置房间。
家居.en: This magazine is all about home decor and shows you how to arrange your rooms.

较为.zh: 这个地区交通较为方便，适合开工厂。
较为.en: Transport in this area is relatively convenient, which makes it suitable for building factories.

精准.zh: 他的射门又快又精准，守门员根本来不及反应。
精准.en: His shot was fast and precise, and the goalkeeper had no time to react.

款.zh: 这款背包又轻又结实，最近卖得特别好。
款.en: This backpack is light and sturdy, and it's been selling really well lately.

兰花.zh: 这盆兰花开出了淡紫色的花，屋子里满是清香。
兰花.en: This orchid has put out pale purple flowers, and the room is filled with a delicate fragrance.

乐于.zh: 年轻人更乐于接受新鲜事物。
乐于.en: Young people are more willing to embrace new things.

历年.zh: 今年的报名人数创下了历年最高纪录。
历年.en: This year's number of applicants was the highest of any year on record.

链接.zh: 不要随便点陌生人发来的链接，小心被骗。
链接.en: Don't click on links from strangers carelessly; watch out for scams.

两极.zh: 观众对这部电影的评价出现了两极分化，有人很喜欢，有人很讨厌。
两极.en: Audience opinion on this film is polarized: some love it, others hate it.

录用.zh: 很遗憾，您没有被录用，欢迎下次再来应聘。
录用.en: We regret to inform you that you were not selected; you're welcome to apply again in the future.

蚂蚁.zh: 下雨之前，常常能看到蚂蚁忙着搬家。
蚂蚁.en: Before it rains, you can often see ants busily moving house.

免税.zh: 这类小企业可以享受免税政策。
免税.en: Small businesses of this kind qualify for tax exemption.

民宿.zh: 这几年乡村旅游火了，村里很多人把自家的房子改成了民宿。
民宿.en: Rural tourism has taken off in recent years, and many villagers have turned their houses into homestays.

南极洲.zh: 企鹅主要生活在南极洲及其附近的海域。
南极洲.en: Penguins live mainly in Antarctica and the surrounding seas.

南美洲.zh: 亚马孙河流经南美洲的好几个国家。
南美洲.en: The Amazon River flows through several countries in South America.

农田.zh: 一场大雨过后，农田里的庄稼长得更旺了。
农田.en: After a heavy rain, the crops in the fields grew even more vigorously.

扑灭.zh: 森林大火终于被扑灭了，但损失十分严重。
扑灭.en: The forest fire was finally extinguished, but the damage was severe.

清扫.zh: 过年前，家家户户都要把屋子彻底清扫一遍。
清扫.en: Before New Year, every family gives their home a thorough cleaning.

热度.zh: 他对学画画只有三分钟热度，没几天就放弃了。
热度.en: His enthusiasm for painting was short-lived; he gave up after a few days.

热议.zh: 这部电视剧大结局播出后，观众们纷纷在网上热议。
热议.en: After the finale of the series aired, viewers flocked online to debate it.

人山人海.zh: 演唱会还没开始，体育场外面已经人山人海了。
人山人海.en: The concert hadn't even started, but there was already a sea of people outside the stadium.

赛事.zh: 这座城市每年都要举办好几项国际体育赛事。
赛事.en: This city hosts several international sporting events every year.

上进.zh: 这孩子很有上进心，每次考试都想超过上一次。
上进.en: This child is very driven and always wants to beat his last exam score.

摄像头.zh: 开视频会议之前，记得检查一下电脑的摄像头能不能用。
摄像头.en: Before a video meeting, remember to check that your computer's camera works.

生命力.zh: 传统文化只有不断创新，才能保持旺盛的生命力。
生命力.en: Traditional culture can only stay vibrant by constantly innovating.

诗词.zh: 这档节目以比赛的形式让观众感受中国古典诗词的魅力。
诗词.en: This show uses a competition format to let viewers experience the charm of classical Chinese poetry.

实时.zh: 比赛的比分会在大屏幕上实时更新。
实时.en: The score is updated live on the big screen.

书画.zh: 退休以后，王老师开始学习书画，现在已经小有名气了。
书画.en: After retiring, Mr. Wang took up calligraphy and painting, and now he's become fairly well known.

数字化.zh: 随着数字化程度提高，现在去银行办业务的人越来越少了。
数字化.en: As things become more digital, fewer and fewer people go to the bank in person.

水流.zh: 打开水龙头，水流很小，可能是水压不够。
水流.en: When I turn on the tap, only a trickle comes out; maybe the water pressure is too low.

提取.zh: 警方在现场提取到了嫌疑人的指纹。
提取.en: The police lifted the suspect's fingerprints at the scene.

听觉.zh: 长期戴着耳机听大声的音乐，会损伤听觉。
听觉.en: Listening to loud music through headphones for long periods can damage your hearing.

退税.zh: 政府为出口企业退税，减轻了它们的负担。
退税.en: The government gives tax rebates to exporters, easing their burden.

外甥.zh: 姐姐的儿子是我的外甥，他特别喜欢跟我玩。
外甥.en: My older sister's son is my nephew, and he loves playing with me.

万物.zh: 太阳是地球上万物生长的能量来源。
万物.en: The sun is the source of energy for all living things on Earth.

微小.zh: 哪怕是一个微小的进步，也值得表扬。
微小.en: Even a tiny bit of progress deserves praise.

围棋.zh: 人工智能在围棋比赛中战胜了世界冠军。
围棋.en: An AI defeated the world champion in a Go match.

味觉.zh: 这道菜酸甜辣咸样样俱全，给人带来丰富的味觉享受。
味觉.en: This dish is sour, sweet, spicy and salty all at once, a real treat for the taste buds.

文档.zh: 电脑突然死机，我还没来得及保存文档。
文档.en: The computer suddenly froze before I had a chance to save the document.

乌龟.zh: 儿子养了一只小乌龟，每天都给它喂吃的。
乌龟.en: My son keeps a little turtle and feeds it every day.

洗漱.zh: 出门旅行要带好洗漱用品，比如牙刷、毛巾。
洗漱.en: When you travel, remember to bring toiletries such as a toothbrush and towel.

下单.zh: 这件衣服很多人在抢，再不下单就卖完了。
下单.en: Lots of people are snapping up this item; if you don't order now, it'll sell out.

下线.zh: 这款游戏因为用户太少，下个月将正式下线。
下线.en: Because it has too few players, this game will be officially shut down next month.

现存.zh: 据统计，野外现存的大熊猫有一千八百多只。
现存.en: According to statistics, there are just over 1,800 giant pandas left in the wild.

现货.zh: 这本书暂时没有现货，需要预订，大概两周后到。
现货.en: This book is currently out of stock and must be pre-ordered; it should arrive in about two weeks.

心底.zh: 这段往事一直埋在她的心底，从来没跟别人说过。
心底.en: She has kept this part of her past buried deep in her heart and never told anyone.

新媒体.zh: 她在一家公司做新媒体运营，负责管理公众号和短视频账号。
新媒体.en: She works in new media operations at a company, managing its official accounts and short-video channels.

新能源.zh: 太阳能、风能等新能源的发展，有助于减少环境污染。
新能源.en: Developing new energy sources such as solar and wind power helps reduce pollution.

袖子.zh: 这件衬衫的袖子有点儿长，要拿去改一改。
袖子.en: The sleeves on this shirt are a bit long, so I need to get them altered.

血型.zh: 献血的时候，护士问我知不知道自己是什么血型。
血型.en: When I gave blood, the nurse asked if I knew my blood type.

易于.zh: 老师讲课生动有趣，内容也易于理解。
易于.en: The teacher's lectures are lively and interesting, and the content is easy to understand.

有劲.zh: 睡了一个好觉，第二天干活儿特别有劲。
有劲.en: After a good night's sleep, I had loads of energy for work the next day.

元宵.zh: 超市里摆满了各种口味的元宵，有黑芝麻的，还有山楂的。
元宵.en: The supermarket is full of yuanxiao in all sorts of flavors, from black sesame to hawthorn.

月光.zh: 夜深了，皎洁的月光从窗户照进来。
月光.en: It was late at night, and bright moonlight shone in through the window.

占比.zh: 网购在居民消费中的占比已经超过了三成。
占比.en: Online shopping now accounts for more than 30% of household spending.

阵雨.zh: 夏天的阵雨来得快，去得也快，一会儿太阳又出来了。
阵雨.en: Summer showers come and go quickly; the sun was out again in no time.

侄子.zh: 我哥哥的儿子，也就是我侄子，今年考上了大学。
侄子.en: My brother's son — my nephew — got into university this year.

种地.zh: 现在种地也用上了无人机，农民轻松了不少。
种地.en: Farming now uses drones too, which makes life a lot easier for farmers.

中暑.zh: 夏天在太阳底下待太久容易中暑，要多喝水。
中暑.en: In summer, staying in the sun too long can give you heatstroke, so drink plenty of water.

主播.zh: 这位新闻主播声音好听，说话又清楚，观众都很喜欢她。
主播.en: This news anchor has a pleasant voice and speaks clearly; viewers love her.

自律.zh: 成功的人往往都很自律，能管住自己。
自律.en: Successful people tend to be very self-disciplined and able to keep themselves in check.
